summary_zh: RAN1 认为 Solution 1（HARQ feedback disabling）和 Solution 3（aNB 在收到前次 HARQ-ACK 前复用同一 HARQ process）均可行；Solution 1 已在 NR Rel-17 规定，Solution 3 受 UE out-of-order rules 限制，且现行 RAN2 规范在某些情形下可能阻止该行为。各方对两种方案的信令开销、UE 功耗、重传恢复和链路自适应影响存在不同意见；两者被认为可行不决定最终是否规定及采用哪种方案。
text_en:
On the issue of HARQ stalling, the following observations are drawn:
On Solution 1 (HARQ feedback disabling) and Solution 3 (aNB reusing the same HARQ process before receiving HARQ-ACK feedback for the previous transmission):
RAN1 observes that solution 1 was specified in NR Rel-17, and it is clarified in TS 38.300 that “Disabling HARQ feedback allows scheduling a HARQ process before one HARQ RTT has elapsed since last scheduled”. This solution is feasible from RAN1 perspective
From RAN1 perspective, regarding Solution 3, it is feasible to allow usage of the same HARQ process before the HARQ-ACK feedback has been processed by the base station (subject to out-of-order rules at the UE). Current RAN2 specifications for NR, however, may prevent this behavior at least in some cases (e.g. when DRX is configured).
Under solution 3, having HARQ-ACK feedback for every downlink transmission incurs in signaling overhead and corresponding UE power consumption, which is considered by some companies to be unacceptable for some NTN scenarios. Solution 1 would alleviate this issue.
Some companies indicate that the UE power consumption and overhead associated with HARQ-ACK transmission is limited, and that solution 1 removes the information on successful or unsuccessful reception of the TB and may result in recovery through RLC retransmissions which would increase signaling overhead, latency and corresponding UE power consumption. This assumes that, under solution 3, HARQ-ACK information is used for ARQ retransmissions without relying on RLC status report.
Some companies indicate that although Solution 3 does not remove the information on successful or unsuccessful reception of the TB, it will not be useful for triggering HARQ retransmissions, and therefore with solution 3 there is also a possibility of ending up in recovery through RLC retransmissions. This assumes that, under solution 3, HARQ-ACK information is not used for ARQ retransmissions without relying on RLC status report.
Under solution 3, although HARQ-ACK feedback is not used for HARQ retransmissions, some companies indicate that the HARQ-ACK information can be useful for e.g. link adaptation. Some other companies indicate that similar information can be conveyed in an alternative manner (e.g. statistical reporting, dynamic enabling/disabling of HARQ feedback under Solution 1, or disabling of HARQ feedback for some of the HARQ processes).
Some companies indicate that the potential benefits of solution 1 in terms of signaling efficiency and power consumption are not directly related to HARQ stalling. Some companies indicate that solution 1 has been specified in NR to solve the problem of HARQ stalling.
NOTE: The fact that solution 3 and solution 1 are deemed to be “feasible” has no impact on which solution (if any) would be specified.
R1-2606421	Feature lead summary#4 on NTN specific requirements and design	Moderator (Qualcomm Incorporated)

“(28a) Atmospheric loss (dB)”
For Ka-band GEO 20GHz (12.5 degree elevation): 1.2dB
For Ka band GEO 30GHz (12.5 degree elevation): 1.1dB
For Ku band GEO (12.5 degree elevation): 0.2dB
For Ka-band LEO (30 degree elevation): 0.5dB
For Ku-band LEO (30 degree elevation): 0.1dB
NOTE: These losses do not include rain loss. The values are obtained from ITU P.676 figures.
“(28b) Shadow fading margin (dB)” = 0
“(28c) Scintillation loss (dB)”
For GEO (12.5 degree elevation) Ka band, 1.1dB
For LEO (30 degree elevation) Ka band, 0.3dB
For GEO (12.5 degree elevation) Ku band, 0.3dB
For LEO (30 degree elevation) Ku band, 0.2dB
NOTE: This scintillation loss is due to tropospheric scintillation, as described in TR 38.811.
“(28d) Polarization loss (dB)” = 0dB
This is due to matching polarizations between UE and SAN antenna
“(4b-2) / (11-b2) Scanning loss (dB)” is
Calculated based on elevation angle and antenna element pattern gain for both SAN and UE (if they use antenna arrays)
NOTE: RAN1 might need to revisit the agreed antenna element pattern gain.
“(20) Receiver implementation margin (dB)” = 1dB
“(27) Penetration margin” = 0dB
“(28e) Other losses” = 0dB
NOTE: The study of a particular scenario for the link budget template does not imply that, if RAN1 determines a coverage gap for that scenario, it will be studied or specified how to close it.

NOTE: UEs in adverse propagation conditions is per RAN guidance and is documented in TR 38.914 as 0% of users in Case 1 and 4% of users in Case 2.
NOTE: The study of a particular scenario for the link budget template does not imply that, if RAN1 determines a coverage gap for that scenario, it will be studied or specified how to close it.

summary_zh: Rel-20 6G ISAC 性能评估为 baseline cases/configurations 采用表列的最小 UE-UE（2D）距离假设：Sensing UAV、Sensing Human 和 Sensing AGV 对应场景为 1 m。Sensing Vehicle 的 Urban Grid 和 Highway 场景距离由已同意的 UE distribution 确定。
text_en:
For Rel-20 6G ISAC performance evaluation, adopt the following minimum UE-UE (2D) distance evaluation assumption for baseline cases/configurations.
|  | Scenario | Minimum UE-UE (2D) distance |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Sensing UAV | UMa-AV | 1 m |
|  | SMa | 1 m |
| Sensing Human | UMa | 1 m |
|  | Indoor Hotspot (Indoor-office) | 1 m |
| Sensing Vehicle | Urban Grid | Determined by the agreed UE distribution |
|  | Highway | Determined by the agreed UE distribution |
| Sensing AGV | Indoor Factory (SH) | 1 m |

summary_zh: Rel-20 6G ISAC 性能评估中，Sensing AGV 在 Indoor Factory (SH) 的 baseline cases/combinations 采用 clutter density 20%、clutter height 2 m 和 clutter size 10 m。
text_en:
For Rel-20 6G ISAC performance evaluation, for baseline cases/combinations of sensing AGV in Indoor Factory (SH), the following parameters are assumed for clutters.
| Clutter density: | 20% |
| --- | --- |
| Clutter height: | 2 m |
| Clutter size: | 10 m |

summary_zh: Rel-20 6G ISAC object detection/tracking 的 MDP 和 FAP Type 2 按漏检目标数、真实目标数、未关联检测对象数、检测对象总数及相应 drop 数量计算。另要求评估与 5GA ISAC study 相同的 MDP 和 FAP Type-2 定义（FFS）。
text_en:
For Rel-20 6G ISAC performance evaluation, for object detection and/or tracking, the MDP (missed detection probability) and the FAP type 2 (false alarm probability type 2) are calculated as follows:
Missed detection probability
where,
-	 is the number of missed targets in the drop n, i.e., the true target not associated with any detected object.
-	 is the number of true targets in the drop n.
-	 is total number of drops with at least one target per drop.
FFS: same MDP definition as 5GA ISAC study should also be evaluated
False alarm probability Type-2
where,
-	 is the number of detected objects but not associated with any true targets in the drop n.

summary_zh: 应用多个 sensing nodes/pairs 的 data fusion 时，使用融合得到的 jointly determined object(s) 与 true target(s) 做关联，并计算 MDP、FAP Type 2 和 positioning/velocity accuracy。公司需报告从多个节点/配对的检测对象得到融合对象的方法或算法。
text_en:
For Rel-20 6G ISAC performance evaluation, for object detection and/or tracking, when data fusion from multiple sensing nodes/pairs is applied:
Instead of using detected objects per sensing node/pair, the jointly determined object(s) fused from detected objects of multiple sensing nodes/pairs will be used for association between detected object(s) and true target(s), calculating MDP, FAP Type 2 and positioning/velocity accuracy.
Companies to report the method/algorithm to obtain the jointly fused object(s) from detected objects of multiple sensing nodes/pairs.
R1-2605743	Moderator summary #2 on ISAC evaluations	Moderator (CATT)

summary_zh: SAC 评估鼓励公司至少评估并报告 Scope 1（感知测量/结果性能）或 Scope 2（有无感知辅助时的通信性能）；辅助信息可为 ideal、non-ideal 或仿真所得 real sensing measurement/result，并需说明仿真采用类型及非理想因素建模方式。Scope 2 还鼓励采用 AI 10.8.2 通信场景和通信议程中的指标及基线，报告位置/速度信息需求、感知带来的时频资源成本和比较基准等细节。
text_en:
For Rel-20 6G ISAC evaluation on SAC (sensing assisted communication), companies are encouraged to evaluate and report at least one of the following:
Scope 1: Evaluate performance of sensing measurement/result, which will be used to assist communication;
Scope 2: Evaluate performance of communication, with and without assistance of sensing measurement/result. The sensing measurement/result to assist communication can be:
Ideal sensing measurement/result
Non-ideal sensing measurement/result, and company to report how to model error/offset of non-ideal factors for non-ideal sensing measurement/result
Real sensing measurement/result, which is obtained from simulation
Note: companies to report which is used in their simulation.
For Rel-20 6G ISAC evaluation on SAC, for Scope 2:
The communication use case(s) in AI 10.8.2 are encouraged
Companies to report whether the location and/or velocity information of communication UE and/or TRP is needed or not in their SAC algorithm/mechanism
Note: this does not imply specifying exchange of location and/or velocity information between UE and TRP
Companies to report the time-frequency resource cost due to sensing for SAC and necessary details on the definition of the time-frequency resource cost based on TR38.765 as starting point
Comparison with benchmark and benchmark details should also be reported as well as other necessary details if any
Companies are encouraged to use communication-related performance metrics as agreed in communication agendas
Companies are encouraged to use baseline/benchmark mechanism as agreed in communication agendas for comparison; Use of state-of-the-art mechanism without assistance of sensing measurement/result for comparison is not precluded
Companies are encouraged to use additional communication-related evaluation assumptions (if necessary but not discussed/agreed in AI 10.8.1) as agreed in communication agendas
Note: How to draw conclusion/observation is a separate discussion.

summary_zh: SAC Scope 1 考虑 ISAC channel 的 delay/Doppler/angle/power/phase 信息，以及感知重建大表面或墙面的结果；对应指标包括路径参数 RMSE 和重建平面与 specular reflection point 的平均绝对垂直距离。公司需报告路径选择、多个路径的 RMSE 推导及其辅助通信方式；EO type-2 应纳入该环境重建情形的仿真。
text_en:
For Rel-20 6G ISAC evaluation on SAC, for Scope 1, the following sensing measurement/results and corresponding performance metrics are considered:
Delay/Doppler/angle/power/phase related information of the ISAC channel
Performance metric:
RMSE of delay of the path(s) used to assist communication
RMSE of Doppler the path(s) used to assist communication
RMSE of angles (one or more of AOD, ZOD, AOA, ZOA) of the path(s) used to assist communication
RMSE of power of the path(s) used to assist communication
FFS: details on the power of the path(s)
FFS: RMSE of phase of the path(s) used to assist communication
Companies to report how to select the path(s), how to derive RMSE from multiple paths and how such sensing measurement/result of the paths(s) is able to assist communication
Note: when evaluated, companies are not required to report every metric
Enrivonment (large surface, wall) that reconstructed by sensing
Performance metric:
Mean value of absolute perpendicular distance from the sensed specular reflection point to the ground-truth plane
Mean value of absolute perpendicular distance from the ground truth specular reflection point to the reconstructed plane
Note: when evaluated, companies are not required to report every metric
EO type-2 should be modeled in the simulation in this case
Companies are not required to evaluate and report every sensing measurement/result.
Note: In Scope 1, the performance metrics for detecting object for the purpose of SAC are the same as those for object detection and/or tracking, and thus already included in Rel-20 6G ISAC object detection and/or tracking study.
Note 2: How to draw conclusion/observation is a separate discussion.

summary_zh: SAC 评估假设以 object detection/tracking baseline cases/combinations 为起点，并可调整是否投放 sensing target；评估由 EO type-2 建模的大表面或墙面重建时，可额外投放 sensing capable UEs。报告仿真结果时需说明采用的调整及必要细节。
text_en:
For Rel-20 6G ISAC evaluation on SAC, for evaluation assumptions, the evaluation assumptions of baseline cases/combinations of object detection and/or tracking are reused as starting point. In addition, one or more of the following adjustment may be considered:
Dropping of sensing target is optional
In case reconstruction of enrivonment (large surface, wall that modeled by EO type-2) is evaluated, additional sensing capable UEs can be dropped for reconstructing environment
Other adjustment is not precluded
Companies should report the adjustments (if any) with necessary details when reporting simulation results.

Additional tdoc file(s) will also be used to collect companies input in details, which may include but not limited to:
Details on sensing RS/resource

Reason for change: In Rel-19, UEIRI is introduced as a new type of UCI for notifying (ModeA) or requesting a PUSCH resource (ModeB) for UE-initiated/event-driven beam reporting. Whether UE transmits UEIRI on a PUCCH format 0 or format 1 in the PUCCH resource depends on whether the triggering condition of the event(s) for UE-initiated/event-driven beam reporting is met or not. In this case, the information bit of UEIRI is not always included in the PUCCH resource. However, in the current spec, UEIRI is described as a compulsory UCI in the PUCCH resource, which is not correct.
Summary of change: Add the condition “if any” to the information bit for UEIRI where the contents of UCI bit(s) are described in the first paragraph of Section 9.2, TS38.213.

| 9.2 UCI reporting in physical uplink control channel UCI types reported in a PUCCH include HARQ-ACK information, SR, LRR, UEIRI, and CSI. UCI bits include HARQ-ACK information bits, if any, SR information bits, if any, LRR information bit, if any, UEIRI information bit, if any, and CSI bits, if any. Capture the following in the Draft LS response to R1-2605188.
The misalignment between transmission of PRACH at UE side and monitoring of PRACH at NW side may occur in beam hopping operation when RO periodicity is <160ms. Some companies have the view that the misalignment is due to configuration or NW implementation.
The misalignment may also occur in beam hopping operation when RO periodicity is 160ms and cells served by the same hopping beam have overlapping valid PRACH occasions, e.g. due to the aligned SFN and same PRACH time-domain configuration and SSB-to-RO mapping, while the corresponding satellite Rx beam is not active for a footprint at such PRACH occasions.
The draft LS in R1-2606882 is endorsed by changing “kindly” to “respectfully”.
The final LS in R1-2606892 is approved.

summary_zh: Band 和 BCs 是 UE capability signaling size 增加的关键因素；在 RAN1/RAN4 讨论基础上，6G 新概念或特性（如 band group、single cell with multiple carrier）可能改变 band 和 BCs 的定义。
text_en: band and BCs are key factors in the increased UE capability signaling size, however the definition of band and BCs may be changed by new concept/feature in 6G (i.e., band group and single cell with multiple carrier) depending on discussion in RAN1/RAN4.

summary_zh: FS、FSPC 和 FSC 可用于高效指示 band/BC dependent capabilities，但无法覆盖 5G 中所有 baseband dependent capabilities。
text_en: FS, FSPC and FSC are used to efficiently indicate band/BC dependent capabilities but couldn’t cover all baseband dependent capabilities in 5G.

summary_zh: 每个 release/version 中，尤其是 BC 内的 optional capabilities 会增加 UE capability signaling overhead；若考虑 feature level differentiation 或 WGs 提出的 feature groups 间依赖关系，可能有空间减少 optional capabilities。
text_en:
optional capabilities especially in BC in each release/version increases UE capability signaling overhead. There might be room to reduce optional capabilities if we can consider differentiation per feature level or dependency between feature groups from WGs.
[2mins]
Noted
Filtering and RACS (Not treated)
R2-2509032	Discussion on UE capability framework	Deutsche Telekom AG	discussion

summary_zh: CA/DC 的 Band combination capability information 占 capability information size 的主要部分，但现有 RAT/band/cell-group filtering 粒度过粗。提出需要 Per-BC filtering，以避免为当前 serving cell 组合未使用的 BCs。
text_en: Band combination capability information for CA/DC dominates capability information size, but current filtering (RAT/band/cell-group) are too coarse. Per-BC filtering is needed to avoid composing unused BCs on the current serving cell.

summary_zh: 能力查询包含此前要求的 same band filtering 时，UE 应重新组合相同的 band/feature-set 信息，因为 feature set IDs 和 feature set combination IDs 的作用范围是单次报告。
text_en: When capability enquiries including same band filtering which was required before, the UEs should re-compose identical band/feature-set information because feature set IDs and feature set combination IDs are report-instance scoped.

summary_zh: 网络可以预先请求宽范围的 BC capability information，以支持未来 CA/DC 配置；但其中许多信息在已存储能力被丢弃前从未使用。
text_en: The network may request wide BC capability information upfront for future CA/DC configuration, but much of it is never used before the stored capability is discarded.

summary_zh: 连接状态下支持 dynamic UE capability updates 有多种不同动机，应通过对能力变化原因分类来分别研究。
text_en: There are multiple different motivations to support dynamic UE capability updates during the connected state, and these should be studied separately by categorizing the reasons for capability changes.

summary_zh: RAN2 需要确保对“dynamic UE Capabilities changes”的解释一致：它指 UE 无法按已应用配置执行，还是指偏离此前声明的能力。
text_en: RAN2 needs to ensure consistent interpretation of “dynamic UE Capabilities changes”: whether it relates to UE (in)ability to perform according to the applied configuration or previously declared capabilities.

summary_zh: 即使未因 UAI 触发 RRC Reconfiguration，也不排除网络采取响应行为或在 lower layers 进行适配。
text_en: The absence of RRC Reconfiguration in response to UAI does not preclude responsive network behaviour or adaptation at lower layers.

summary_zh: 与 UAI 相关的用例仅涉及 RAN 中配置的临时修改，不影响 CN。
text_en: The use cases associated with UAI involve only temporary modification of the configuration in RAN without impacting CN.

summary_zh: NR 已支持在 lower layers 处理 form factor changes（例如折叠手机），无需改变 UE capabilities。
text_en: NR already supports form factor changes (e.g. folding phones) at lower layers without change of UE capabilities.

summary_zh: 基于 UE Assistance Information (UAI) 的能力限制或更新在 5G 商业化未成功。原文列出的原因包括未考虑 UE 与网络双方利益、难以验证 UE 请求限制能力的真实原因而可能导致不当降能，以及能力限制或更新可能显著影响通信性能并使部分场景难以满足 QoS 要求。
text_en:
The commercialization of capability restriction/updates based on UE Assistance Information (UAI) was not successful in 5G, due to the following issues:
	Lack of consideration of the mutual interests of both UEs and networks.
	The inability to verify the real cause of the UE’s behaviour when requesting capability restrictions, which could lead to misuse, where UEs improperly reduce their capabilities.
	Capability restriction/updates may significantly affect communication performance, making it difficult to meet the QoS requirements in some scenarios.

summary_zh: CMCC 已支持在 UE/chipset 于运营商部署网络中激活功能前，与指定厂商通过 IODT test 验证功能。
text_en: Per the current implementation, to verify the features through IODT test with some given vendors before the UE/chipset activate the features in operator’s deployed network is already supported in CMCC.

summary_zh: 商业环境中存在仅在特定 UE 型号和特定 UE 软件版本上出现的问题。
text_en: In commercial environments, problems exist that only occur on specific UE models and specific UE software versions.

summary_zh: 原文指出，由于这些特定问题，其他用户可能失去质量改进的机会。
text_en: Due to these specific problems, other users may be deprived of opportunities for quality improvement.

summary_zh: 提出制定全球统一且规范化的程序，以跟踪网络和 UE 对功能的部署，并以具约束力的程序确保功能不只是被声明为 mandatory。记录指出，如何定义 binding、跟踪方式及 RAN2 与其他工作组的职责仍需讨论。
text_en:
A globally aligned and normatively specified procedure should ensure features are not just declared as mandatory, but deployment of these (and other features) is tracked in 3GPP with a binding procedure for both the network and the user equipment.
-	LG asks what does binding mean.   ATT thinks that we now mandate the UE but not the network so the intention is to mandate features on the network side as well.
-	Xiaomi asks how the tracking will be done.  ATT thinks we need to define a framework.
-	Mediatek thinks that this can be beneficial if we find a good way to do it.
-	Samsung asks what is the role of RAN2 so we have to look at the whole procedure with all the other WGs.  Oppo agrees with Samsung.   ATT acknowledges that this a joint effort amongst the working groups.
-	Docomo supports these proposals.

summary_zh: 提出定义 basic feature groups，将大量功能作为单个组的组件进行实现、认证和部署，并形成运营商全球统一的最低有意义功能集。对基本组的判定标准及是否会导致大量 mandatory features 存在讨论。
text_en:
Basic feature groups should be defined to ensure implementation, certification, and deployment of large numbers of features as components of a single feature group, rather than specifying a myriad of individual feature groups for a small number, and often a single component. These basic feature groups together define a meaningful, minimum set of features that are globally aligned among operators.
-	Xiaomi asks what is the criteria to determine the basic feature group.   ATT thinks that this needs to be an effort to determine globally what is the minimum set of features.
-	Mediatek is concerned that this may imply that we make a lot of mandatory features, so we should be careful.
-	Samsung thinks that we need to do better with how we define capabilities, but it is not just for minimum capabilities.
Noted
Overhead
BC, FS, FSC, UL/DL decoupling, etc
R2-2508076	UE Capability pain points and considerations	Xiaomi	discussion	Rel-20	FS_6G_Radio

summary_zh: 列出了 5G UE capability framework 的痛点，包括 capability signalling size、非对称 UL/DL capability、非前向兼容的 signalling structure、重复的检索框架、RACS ID 不实用，以及 UE 与网络支持或配置不匹配。
记录提出识别并整理 UE capability 痛点及根因，明确 RAN2 可处理的事项和影响其他工作组的事项，并寻找示例来展示问题。关于向 RAN1/RAN4 发送 LS 仍待下次会议讨论，且需进一步识别 overhead/complexity 的主要来源。
text_en:
For pain point 1-4, RAN2 sends LS to RAN1/RAN4 and ask RAN1/4 to consider pain point 1-3 and root causes in 6G system design requirement for capability signaling size reduction. RAN2 to discuss capability signalling structure simplification in later phase of SI based on feedback from RAN1/4.
-	Lenovo asks what is the intention as painpoints come from other WGs.   Xiaomi agrees and the intention is to agree on the pain points and ask RAN1/4 to avoid them in 6G
-	Ericsson thinks that we can need to discuss the pain points a bit in more details and give them examples.    Xiaomi is hesitant for example but we should think on better way to demonstrate the pain points.
-	ZTE would like to identify which ones are RAN1/4 and we should also focus on the UL and DL.   CATT thinks 1-3 is RAN1/4 and the others can be focused in RAN2.
-	Oppo is reluctant to agree the pain points as they are.
-	Samsung thinks that we can group aspects to different categories, and we need to understand whether RAN4 will introduce new concept.   The granularity and structure can be discussed by RAN2 first.
-	Ofinno thinks that we can just tell RAN1/RAN4 that we have identified overhead issues.
-	Tmobile agrees that BC is a problem and NSA as well, and assume SA is the baseline.
-	Mediatek thinks that is important that RAN1/RAN4 understands that if the capabilities are complex we can’t compress them to a reasonable size.  So we have to influence on what comes to us so the task is easier.   We should target to have an LS by February.
-	ZTE thinks that some pain points have different level of impact to the complexity.  It is better to provide some suggested solutions.   Xiaomi thinks that it won’t work as they are considering different framework.
-	Oppo thinks that RAN4 has to worry about much more than signaling overhead.   We can capture the pain point and which WGs it impacts, but it doesn’t mean that it will change their solution.
-	Vivo thinks we should go one level lower and provide some requirements to them.
-	Ericsson thinks we can give them some detailed inputs and examples.
-	Nokia thinks that after the pain points we can decide what to focus on RAN2.
[3mins]
Noted
Identify and capture the pain point issues (including root causes).   Identify what RAN2 can focus on and which ones impact other WGs.   Find a way to provide examples or demonstrate the identified pain issues to other WGs
FFS next meeting if we send an LS to other WGs

text_en: RAN2 discuss a general guidance in defining multiple UE capabilities for a feature in order to avoid too many optional UE capabilities.

summary_zh: 提出 RAN2 应通过避免重复、合并子变体及组合相互依赖的功能等方式，尽量减少选项和功能数量。
text_en: RAN2 should work on minimizing the number of options/features by avoiding duplications, merging subvariants, joining dependent features, etc.

summary_zh: 提出 RAN2 评估 RACS 方案及 mobility 场景下可能需要的增强，包括将类似 UCMF 的功能转移到 Base Station。相关讨论指出，capability filters 宜限于会显著增加 signalling overhead、可能被许多 UE 支持但仅被部分 PLMN 使用的功能；RACS ID 对减少查询的影响应与其他方案一并评估。
text_en:
RAN2 should evaluate RACS solution and possible enhancements required for mobility case (i.e., shift of the “UCMF-like” functionalities to the Base Station).

R2-2508732	Improvements for UE capabilities	Ericsson	discussion
Observation 1	UE capability filtering is only useful if the UE implements a feature which no gNB in a given PLMN implements or uses. For operating bands this is often the case; for other features typically not.
Observation 2	Using per feature filters tend to increase UE capability re-enquiries.
Proposal 1	Introduce capability filters only for functionality that a) adds considerable signalling overhead and b) is likely supported by many UEs but c) used only by a subset of PLMNs (e.g. frequency bands).
Observation 3	RACS ID can reduce the number of UE capability enquires, but other aspects/solutions can have a higher impact on such reduction and should be prioritized.
[2mins]
R2-2508509	Consideration on 6G UE Capability	ZTE Corporation, Sanechips	discussion	Rel-20	FS_6G_Radio

summary_zh: 保留基于网络请求的基本 UE capability reporting procedure。RAN2 研究优化 filtering mechanism，以支持更细粒度的 UE capabilities 筛选。
text_en: The basic UE capability reporting procedure can be retained from 4G/5G, where the UE reports capabilities based on a network request. But RAN2 to study how to optimize the filtering mechanism to enable additional granularity for the filtering of UE capabilities.

summary_zh: 除显式 UE Capability report 外，还支持基于 UE Capability ID 的报告。RAN2 研究其优化方案，例如通过定义 UE capability sets 部分内容的模板来增强 RACS mechanism。
text_en:
In addition to the explicit UE Capability report, RAN2 should also support UE Capability ID based reporting and should study optimizations for the UE capability ID based reporting (e.g. enhanced RACS mechanism by defining templates for parts of UE capability sets).

summary_zh: RAN2 研究按 band combination 进行 UE capability retrieval 筛选，只获取特定 band combination 的 capabilities，以减少与 band combination 相关的数据量。
text_en: RAN2 to study defining per band combination filtering for UE capability retrieval including only particular band combination capabilities to reduce band combination related size.

summary_zh: RAN2 研究针对已报告 feature set information 的 index-based linkage 和 delta reporting，以避免重复并支持增量更新。UE 可在编制 UE capability reports 时复用 feature set IDs 和 feature set combination IDs，并将其用于其他 bands。
text_en: RAN2 to study an index-based linkage and delta reporting for previously reported feature set information to avoid duplication and support incremental updates. This allows the UE to reuse the reported feature set IDs and feature set combination IDs not only for identical band, but also for other bands when composing UE capability reports.

summary_zh: RAN2 研究 UE 发起的 band combination reporting mechanism，无需显式 network enquiry。该机制由网络预先提供的条件启用。
text_en:
RAN2 to study a UE initiated band combination reporting mechanism without explicit network enquiry, enabled by the network pre-provided conditions.
[2mins]

R2-2508422	On UE capability framework for 6G	NTT DOCOMO INC.	discussion	Rel-20	FS_6G_Radio
Dynamic capability change

summary_zh: 针对对用户体验有重大影响的原因（例如 overheating 和 power saving），研究 UE capability updates framework。UE 可不受 network configuration 限制地报告更新，网络需遵循这些报告，同时尽量减少对 network operation 的影响。
text_en: For reasons which have a significant impact on user experience (e.g., overheating and power saving), study the framework of UE capability updates in which the UE can report it regardless of network configuration, and the network is required to respect those reports, while impact on network operation is minimized.

summary_zh: 针对 overheating 或 power saving 以外原因触发的 capability updates，研究重点是尽量减少 CN involvement 并降低对其他 procedures 的影响。
text_en:
For capability updates triggered by reasons other than overheating or power saving, we study them with a focus on minimizing CN involvement and reducing the impact on other procedures.

Observation 2	Dynamic capability update has several challenges and does not address the main issue regarding temporary problems and constrains in the UE.

Noted

summary_zh: 动态 UE capability update 从 NR UAI 和 RRCReconfigurationComplete (NeedForGap) 已支持的用例开始。也可考虑获得广泛支持的其他用例。
text_en: For dynamic UE capability update, starting with the use cases supported by NR UAI and RRCReconfigurationComplete (NeedForGap). Other use cases identified with wide support can be considered as well.

summary_zh: 预期网络在定义的时间范围内妥善处理 UE 的 UE capability update 请求。这样可确保 transition period 期间网络与 UE 的配置保持同步。
text_en: It is expected that network properly handles UE request on UE capability update within a defined timeline, to make sure that network and UE are synchronized in terms of the configuration during the transition period.

summary_zh: 若 UE 未在规定时间范围内收到更新配置，其行为仍可进一步讨论。下一次会议将识别动态 capability change 的重要用例及其需求（包括理由），并分析 UAI 的痛点；框架应聚焦 RAN capability，不影响 NAS capability。

If UE does not receive an updated configuration from the NW within the timeline, it could be further discussed what the UE behavior is.

Noted
Discussions
-	Qualcomm thinks that UAI is not a solution as it wasn’t a success in 5G, so we can’t fully rely on UAI, we need to understand the pain points.  Xiaomi agrees and there is limitation.   It is controlled by the network whether the UE can report UAI so it doesn’t work.   Also we don’t know what action the network will take.   Ericsson thinks the network control is a separate discussion as even with UEcapabilityenquiry the network is in control.   So we have discuss whether we update the UE capability container as the reconfig can be MAC CE, etc.
-	Oppo thinks that MUSIM is the most important use case.   There are some principles from UAI, for example it doesn’t impact CN capabilities.  But there are some problems with UAI.
-	Nokia thinks we should take a step back and look at what are the requirements of the use cases that require some form of capability change. And we shouldn’t preclude solutions that are based on lower layer.
-	Huawei would like to first understand the issues and should identified root cause.  There are cases where the network has no interest on the change of some of the UAI capabilities.
-	Apple also thinks in addition to overheating and power saving, MUSIM is important.  We should have expectations on how the network reacts.
-	CMCC thinks that the network should be able to control as sometimes the dynamic change may cause network performance degradation.  We should limit which capabilities can be enabled.
-	ZTE thinks that companies should elaborate on whether the reporting to the network indicates that the capability has changed or will change, what are the expectations from the network.   Xiaomi thinks that we also need to respect UE user experience so we have to consider both User and network impact.
-	Huawei thinks that we should limit the impact to RAN and no CN. Samsung thinks that we should keep it open as we may want to discuss the Idle mode as well.
For next meeting, identify important use cases for dynamic capability change.  Identify the requirements for the use cases (including the justification).  Identify pain points of UAI.
The framework should focus on RAN capability and not impact NAS capability

summary_zh: RAN2 研究让 UE 在 UE radio capability 中按 main feature 上报“IOT-ed”的网络厂商名称或 ID 的方案。讨论指出，厂商 ID 上报的处理及 mobility 期间的处理仍有待解决。
text_en:
RAN2 to study solutions where the UE reports “IOT-ed” network vendor names / IDs per main feature, within the UE radio capability.
[2mins]
-	Oppo would like to understand the issue.  Qualcomm thinks that of course the UE vendors want to IOT the feature, but the vendor doesn’t support it.   The UE supports it and all of the sudden the vendor implements.  Oppo thinks that it is not acceptable to have devices that don’t work with some UE and network vendor combinations.
-	Xiaomi shares the spirit but there are some issues that need to be addressed first like during mobility and handling of vendor ID reported.
Noted

summary_zh: 6G 应研究使 network 能够识别 UE 的 model 和/或 software version。
text_en: 6G should study enabling the network to identify the UE's model and/or software version.

summary_zh: 6G 应研究根据 UE 的 model 和/或 software version 控制某项 function 的适用性（enable/disable）。讨论涉及 IODT 问题、厂商和软件版本识别、移动性处理及实现方式等；该条目记录为 Noted，且 Not treated。
text_en:
6G should study enabling the network to control the applicability of a function (i.e., enable/disable) based on the UE's model and/or software version.
[2mins]
Noted
Discussion
-	Oppo would like to understand the issue.  Qualcomm thinks that of course the UE vendors want to IOT the feature, but the vendor doesn’t support it.   The UE supports it and all of the sudden the vendor implements.  Oppo thinks that it is not acceptable to have devices that don’t work with some UE and network vendor combinations.
-	Xiaomi shares the spirit but there are some issues that need to be addressed first like during mobility and handling of vendor ID reported.
-	Tmobile thinks that this is a problem in a field as there some mismatch and features are coming out before they can IODT-ed.
-	Apple thinks that this is really needed and we need two way communication.  BT agrees with TM and Apple.
-	LG is concerned that this will increase the size.
-	CMCC thinks that there is an implementation way.   Huawei agrees IMESV can be used by implementation but it is optional.  We can make it mandatory.    Lenovo explains that there is no guarantee that it has a link to capability, some vendors can do it but not guaranteed.  Huawei thinks that IMESV contains some UE vendor information and software version.   Apple thinks that this assumes that the network is good but the UEs have the problem.  But there are cases in the field where there is something that the network does, and the UE crashes.  ZTE thinks that this is more related to reconfiguration failure, so we can discuss it there.   ZTE agrees with CMCC and Huawei and if we can make it mandatory in 6G it would be great, but we still have implementation based solutions.
-	Mediatek wants to understand the root cause of the IODT issue and don’t understand what feature/function.
-	Vivo has some concerns with introducing 3GPP mechanisms as it may make us lazy as we have backup solution.
-	Samsung also would like to understand the root cause but would like to avoid vendor/implementation specific ID.
-	Ericsson thinks that IMESV is more for the case that the feature is not working for a UE and sometimes there are tons of IMESV that are effected.
-	Nokia thinks that this is a bigger discussion that RAN2 can have.   We have features that are mandatory without signaling and if there are issues with those these identification is quite useful.
-	KDDI thinks that there is a problem.
-	BT thinks that from operator point of view it is important to know what vendor is doing something so we can properly react to the problem.
Noted
Not treated

summary_zh: 6G NTN 可采用 5G NTN 的部署场景（LEO、MEO、GSO）和 payload type 假设；是否研究 GNSS 取决于 RANP 及其他工作组的讨论。RAN2 将研究与 TN 设计共同处理的功能和 NTN 特定功能，包括 HARQ、mobility、initial access、uplink time and frequency pre-compensation、TA reporting、satellite switch with re-sync、beam hopping 和 discontinuous coverage；MBS、dual connection、Carrier Aggregation 和 VLEO 可在 RANP 讨论。
text_en:
1	The basic assumption with 5G NTN deployment scenarios (LEO, MEO, GSO) and payload type can be adopted in 6G NTN.   FFS whether we will study with and/or without GNSS, depending on RANP and other WG discussion first.
2	For 6G NTN, RAN2 will consider at least the following features/procedures to treated together with the TN design (e.g. common features/procedures):
-	HARQ
-	L2 timer handling, e.g., the timer value range should cover both TN and NTN, adaptive UP timer start time based on RTT;
-	Measurement framework (including measurement gap)
-	Mobility framework (including TN and NTN mobility)
-	TAC. e.g., support multiple TACs per PLMN in one cell;
-	SIB acquisition/design
-	PWS (Public Warning System) services over an intended area;
-	Initial access framework (including network type indiciation)
3	At least the following NTN features will be further studied in RAN2 (maybe treated in NTN specific AI).  Focus will be on RAN2 impacts.
-	Uplink time and frequency pre-compensation;
-	TA reporting;
-	Satellite switch with re-sync;
-	Beam hopping.
-	Discontinuous coverage
NOTE:  Common design can be considered if something can be applicable to TN as well later
4	The following features can be discussed in RANP
-	MBS broadcast and multicast via NTN;
-	Dual connection;
-	Carrier Aggregation.
-	VLEO
Not treated

summary_zh: 研究 6G radio interface adaptations，以支持涵盖 VLEO、LEO、MEO、GSO 各轨道的实际 NTN 部署场景，并评估 NTN 特性对 initial access timers、HARQ、mobility management 和 paging 等的影响。讨论中 Thales 表示可先从 LEO、MEO 开始，再考虑 VLEO。
text_en:
Study 6G radio interface adaptations to support practical NTN deployment scenarios across all orbits (VLEO, LEO, MEO, GSO), and evaluate the impact of NTN characteristics (e.g., initial access timers, HARQ, mobility management, paging).
-	Mediatek asks if VLEO will be a common case or whether it should be discussed in RANP.  Thales indicates that we can start with LEO, MEO and later consider VLEO

summary_zh: 6G radio access 从 Day-1 起应研究适用于 NTN 和 TN 的统一 grant-free initial access mechanism，以及支持 network energy savings 并应对 NTN 特定约束的 control plane signaling。讨论涉及高负载时是否采用 RACH-less，以及 network contention 的需要。
text_en:
The 6G radio access shall study from Day-1:
•	A unified grant-free initial access mechanism applicable to both NTN and TN.
•	A control plane signaling adapted to support network energy savings and address NTN-specific constraints (e.g. beam hopping techniques, reduced overhead, etc.)
-	Xiaomi asks if for high load we still go for RACH less.   Thales thinks that we need solution that allow faster connection and it also beneficial for TN.  Xiaomi explains that for high load the network needs to do contention.

summary_zh: 6G radio access 从 Day-1 起应允许根据 service 类型和 operating point，在 user plane 层动态激活或停用 retransmission mechanisms（例如 HARQ）。
text_en: The 6G radio access shall from Day-1 allow to dynamically activate/deactivate the retransmission mechanisms (e.g., HARQ) at user plane level depending on the type of services and operating point

summary_zh: 研究支持 UE 在 Idle 和 Connected modes 下从 TN 移动到 NTN、以及从 NTN 移动到 TN 的 6G procedures。讨论说明该研究是一般性的，也可考虑 NTN 到 NTN 的 5G 到 6G 移动。
text_en:
Study a design for 6G procedures that support mobility from TN to NTN and from NTN to TN for UEs in both Idle and Connected modes.
-	Oppo asks if this is only to 5G or considering 4G as well.   Thales explains this is general but we can consider the NTN to NTN 5G to 6G as well.

summary_zh: 研究支持 6G satellite networks 中 Idle 和 Connected modes 的 NTN-to-NTN mobility mechanisms。研究应涵盖 inter-beam、inter-cell 和 inter-satellite mobility。
text_en:
Study mobility mechanisms for 6G satellite networks (NTN to NTN), for both idle and connected modes. The study should address:
•	Inter-beam mobility
•	Inter-cell mobility
•	Inter-satellite mobility

summary_zh: RAN2 在 6GR study 中按优先级考虑 mobility mechanisms：Time-based 和 Location-based Conditional Handover（CHO）、RACH-less handover、由 MAC 触发的 cell switch mechanism（例如 LTM），以及 group handover。
text_en:
RAN2 to consider the following mobility mechanisms in 6GR study, in order of priority:
•	Time-based and Location-based Conditional Handover (CHO)
•	RACH-less handover
•	Cell switch mechanism triggered by MAC (e.g. LTM)
•	Group handover

summary_zh: 讨论了 6G NTN 的基本假设和功能分类，包括 common essential features、NTN specific essential features 与 NTN specific optional features。建议 common essential features 从 Day 1 起采用 TN 和 NTN 的 harmonized design，NTN specific essential features 可讨论是否从 Day 1 支持，NTN specific optional features 可留待后续 release；具体功能范围仍有不同意见。
text_en:
Study the following essential NTN capabilities for supporting NTN services in 6G:
•	NTN based positioning mechanisms for Positioning, Navigation, and Timing services.
•	Network verified UE location for regulatory services
•	Geo-fencing (e.g. intended service area) for Broadcast, multicast and PWS.
[4 min]
Noted
R2-2508295	Discussion on TN and NTN integration	OPPO	discussion	Rel-20	FS_6G_Radio
Proposal 1	The basic assumption in 5G NTN, e.g., NTN scenarios, payload type, etc., can be adopted in 6G NTN and UE without GNSS capability can also be studied in 6G NTN.
-	Mediatek asks if this means GNSS resilient.
-	Vivo asks if it is both GNSS and without GNSS.  Oppo thinks with should be studied, the discussion is more for the case without GNSS
-	Apple thinks that for RAN2 we should start with GNSS and without we need RAN1 first.
Proposal 2	Define 3 types of features for NTN/TN feature discussions: common essential features, NTN specific essential features and NTN specific optional features.
-	Mediatek thinks it is a good idea to have categorizations.  For common it should be common but with some NTN small optimization.
-	CMCC thinks that all features apply to NTN.  WE should think with NTN features also apply to TN.
-	Interdigital thinks that it makes sense and proposal 6 describes what it is.
-	Qualcomm thinks that we should design TN functionalities and identify what needs to be extended, and those would be common.
-	Sharp thinks we can use this words temporarily but then later revisit, as we may have some things that are NTN specific like ephemeris free but at the end we want the design to be common.
Proposal 3	In 6G NTN, RAN2 consider the following features as common essential features:
Proposal 4	In 6G NTN, RAN2 considers the following features as NTN specific essential features:
-	NTN specific SIB acquisition;
-	Mediatek asks why this is separate, shouldn’t we have a common design.  Thales and Google agrees.
-	Satellite switch with re-sync;
-	ZTE thinks that this is like a group mobility and there may be cases that may be applicable for TN.
-	Ericsson thinks that we don’t know if this is need.  Chair explains that could be concluded that it is not needed as part of study.  Nokia thinks that we need to understand 6G first.
-	Huawei thinks that location based should be NTN specific.  CMCC thinks that location based can be considered common as it may be applicable to both TN and NTN.
-	Uplink time and frequency pre-compensation;
-	Vivo asks why this is in RAN2.  Google thinks that calculation of TA is RAN2.  Xiaomi thinks that RAN1 specifies everything.
-	Discontinuous coverage;
-	Qualcomm and Xiaomi don’t think this should be in the scope as it is for IoT NTN
-	Novamint thinks that this is an essential feature missing.   Amazon also thinks this is important to study.    Nokia agrees as we might not have coverage from day 1.   Interdigital thinks that we need to add store and forward.
-	Samsung thinks that we should assume we have connectivity in 6G.   Interdigital thinks that just like TN it takes time before we have full coverage.  Huawei agrees, initially we have sparse deployment.
-	Oppo also sees benefits to this feature.
-	Qualcomm thinks that this should be a plenary discussion.
Proposal 5	In 6G NTN, the following features belong to specific optional features which can be considered later:
-	MBS broadcast and multicast via NTN;
-	Dual connection;
-	Carrier Aggregation.
Proposal 6	In 6G NTN, RAN2 can handle the defined three NTN feature categories with the follow principle:
-	for common essential features, consider the harmonized design for TN and NTN since day1;
-	for NTN specific essential features, can be discussed whether support them since day1;
-	for NTN specific optional features, can be discussed in later release.
[4 min]
Noted

summary_zh: 确定 eMBB（包括 immersive communication）、Voice、ISAC 和 IoT 的需求需从 Day 1 得到满足和支持；Voice fallback 先在 plenary 讨论。假设 emergency calls、与 emergency call 相关的 positioning（如 ECID）及 PWS 的 regulatory requirements 从 Day 1 满足，并将移动 AI 流量特征列入研究，是否研究 tokenized traffic 尚未确定。
text_en:
1	As per RAN plenary, RAN2 will ensure that eMBB (including immersive communication), Voice, ISAC and IoT requirements are met and supported from Day1.   Voice fallback should first be discussed in plenary.
2	RAN2 assumes that regulatory requirements on emergency calls, positioning associated to emergency call requirement (e.g. ECID) and PWS  should be met from Day1.   RAN2 chair should highlight to plenary in status report that input may be required for the requirements and discuss whether to update SI description.    Wait for RAN input for further positioning requirements.
3	We will study the traffic characteristics of mobile AI traffic for both UL and DL (together with NR Rel-20).  FFS whether tokenized traffic is studied
4	Wait for RANP discussion on whether other services are supported.  The agreements from RANP will be taken as baseline for our RAN2 discussions
Device types
R2-2508617	Discussion on device types and forward compatible design	Huawei, HiSilicon	discussion	Rel-20	FS_6G_Radio

summary_zh: 确定 6G radio protocol 应将满足 mobile broadband services 的需求作为高优先级。
text_en: 6G radio protocol must meet the requirements of mobile broadband services as a high priority.

summary_zh: 确定 Voice service 必须在 6G standalone architecture 中得到支持。IoT、sensing 和 AI applications 等其他服务从 Day 1 获得支持，需有明确的 market needs 和 use cases 作为依据。
text_en: Voice service must be supported in 6G standalone architecture. For other services such as IoT, sensing and AI applications, clear market needs and use cases are required to justify their support from Day-1.

summary_zh: 预计 token consumption 将快速增长。
text_en: The token consumption is expected to grow rapidly.

summary_zh: 6G study phase 中，RAN1、SA1 和 SA2 正在研究 tokenized AI 的 traffic characteristics，以及各工作组可能受到的 standard impacts。
text_en: In the 6G study phase, RAN1, SA1 and SA2 are studying the traffic characteristics of the tokenized AI and the potential standard impacts in each working group.

summary_zh: Tokenized AI 被认为是 NTN network 的一项有前景的服务，其原因是 transmission bit rate 较低，并且对 voice 和 video 的 packet loss 具有 resilience。
text_en: Tokenized AI is a promising service for NTN network due to the reduced transmission bit rate and the resilience to the packet loss for voice and video.

summary_zh: Tokenized AI 的 traffic pattern 中，一个 source file（如 video frame、picture 或 text）可用于生成多个 tokens。用于 tokenization 的 source files 至少包括 non-real-time 和 real-time audio/video、picture 与 text，token 的 arrival rate/interval 等 traffic pattern 依赖 source file 的 traffic pattern。
text_en:
The tokenized AI has the following traffic pattern:
o	One source file (e.g. video frame/ picture/ text) can be used to generate a number of tokens.
o	The source files for tokenization include at least non-real-time and real-time audio/video, picture and text.
o	The traffic pattern (e.g. arrival rate/interval) of token has dependency on the traffic pattern of the source file.

summary_zh: Tokenized AI 的 transmission requirements 包括 error-tolerance，即无需所有 tokens 都正确传输；不同 tokens 具有不同的 transmission reliability requirement，例如 token error rate。
text_en:
The tokenized AI has the following transmission requirements:
o	Error-tolerance: Not all tokens need to be transmitted correctly.
o	Importance: Different tokens have different transmission reliability requirement (e.g. token error rate)

summary_zh: 提出 6G RAN computing resources deployment 有三种不同选项，并应进一步研究。
text_en: There are three different options for computing resources deployment in 6G RAN. These three options should be further studied.

summary_zh: 6GR 应从 Day-1 优先支持 mobile broadband 和 voice services，同时采用共同设计以支持广泛服务，避免要求单独解决方案。讨论中，Samsung 将“优先”解释为其他服务不影响 eMBB 性能。
text_en:
The 6GR study should prioritize mobile broadband and voice services from Day-1 while aiming for a common design that supports a wide range of services without requiring separate solutions.
[2 min]
-	Xioami asks what does prioritize mean.  Samsung clarifies that prioritize just means that eMBB performance is not impacted because of other services.
-	Vivo asks about voice fallback.  Xioami thinks that’s related to migration.    Qualcomm thinks that the fallback is part of the mobility and it is more related to handover.
-	Lenovo asks if this applies to NTN.
Noted
Regulatory and FWA

summary_zh: 6GR 应满足 emergency voice calls、positioning 和 PWS 的所有 regulatory requirements。Nokia 提出至少支持 ECID 和 emergency broadcasts，且要求应来自 A1。
text_en:
6GR shall be able to fulfil all regulatory requirements on emergency voice calls, positioning and PWS.
-	Apple asks what are those requirements and who determines.   Nokia thinks that at least we should support ECID and emergency broadcasts and it should come from A1.

summary_zh: 应向 6GR 提供 FWA devices 的特定特征（例如较大的 RF components、external power supply），并在设计中加以考虑，以优化对 FWA services 的支持。
text_en: the specific characteristics of FWA devices (e.g. larger RF components, external power supply…) shall be made available to and taken into account by 6GR for an optimised support of FWA services.

summary_zh: RAN WGs 应等待 SA4 完成 Media Aspects for 6G Systems 研究后，再启动与 AI traffic 相关的讨论，其中包括但不限于 tokenization。

RAN WGs should wait for SA4 to conclude its study on Media Aspects for 6G Systems before initiating any discussion related to AI traffic (including but not limited to tokenization).

text_en:
RAN2 should study the support of new services, e.g., ISAC, AI/ML-based services, token communication and immersive communication, taking NW & UE energy consumption and User experience (QoS/QoE) improvement into consideration.

R2-2508106	Traffic characteristics of tokenized AI	OPPO, CSCN, China Unicom	discussion	Rel-20	FS_6G_Radio

summary_zh: 关于 tokenized AI traffic 的研究存在不同意见：有观点主张等待 SA4 的结论，也有观点主张与非 tokenized AI traffic 一并研究。下次会议将了解是否存在 RAN2 specific requirement 及需向 SA4 提出的具体问题。
text_en:
RAN2 studies the traffic characteristics of tokenized AI service.
[2 min]
Discussion
-	Nokia, Ericsson, Samsung thinks that we shouldn’t discuss tokens until SA4 tells us otherwise.   The tokens are for application layer and it is not related to reliability of the air interfaces.  Lenovo agrees with Nokia and it is not even clear what the tokens will look like, so we should wait.
-	Xiaomi, Mediatek, Ericsson, thinks that we should just focus on AI traffic and not tokenization.   MEdiatek thinks that this is about future cases that don’t actually exist.  And we have other working groups that look into this and the topic is very immature at this point in time.
-	Vivo thinks that we can study tokenized together with non-tokenized as it is quite similar.  Even without SA4 reply RAN1 started the tokenized traffic study.   Apple agrees that it is just a sub-set of mobile AI and we should start it from SA.
-	Interdigital is not sure what SA4 is going to tell us as token data is opaque and we can’t use that to increase the granularity. text_en: For the existing use cases in 5G, RAN2 study should identify at an early stage, functionality that can be reused from 5G as a baseline to minimize the additional work in these areas (e.g. for SON/MDT, TSN, Slicing – depending on SA2 output etc)

summary_zh: 针对 AI 和 sensing 的新及增强 6G 用例，RAN2 study 应支持 AI based enhancements，同时确保有无这些增强时系统均能 optimal operation。待 RAN1 initial design 稳定后，应设计 signalling，以支持 UE based sensing modes 用于 sensing services 和 sensing assisted communication。
text_en:
For the new and enhanced 6G related use cases for AI and sensing, RAN2 study should focus on the following:
-	Enabling AI based enhancements for 6GR including existing and new use cases, whilst ensuring that the system operation is optimal both with and without these AI based enhancements

text_en: Requirements of new and existing services shall only be discussed in RANP. RAN2 should focus on the services which have been agreed in RANP (Mobile broadband, Immersive Communication, Massive Communication (IoT), Sensing, AI, Voice, Regulatory services). Requirements on new services, e.g., Digital twin, Non-Terrestrial Network, Aerial, FWA, Vehicles, Mission Critical Communication, Positioning and/or Navigation, TSN, HRLLC, shall be discussed in RANP.

summary_zh: 对于 network AI data collection、sensing、mobility、paging、UP、capability 等 E2E architecture 相关 features，RAN2 study 以 UE->RAN->CN 的 general architecture 为 baseline。无需重复讨论其他 WGs 涉及的 RAN/CN architecture，例如 CU/DU split、P2P、SBI 和 new core。

agenda_title: Functionality for User Plane and related functional requirements
summary_zh: 大多数 NR UP functions 被认为是连接 L2 以上 upper layers 与 physical layer 所必需的。
text_en: Most of NR UP functions are considered essential to connect between upper layers above L2 and physical layer.

agenda_title: Functionality for User Plane and related functional requirements
summary_zh: NR UP protocol stack 存在多组重复功能。
text_en: NR UP protocol stack has multiple sets of duplicated functions.

agenda_title: Functionality for User Plane and related functional requirements
summary_zh: 考虑到 6GR 将支持的 service types，radio bearer 和 logical channel 仍可能有助于满足 latency、error recovery 等特定要求。
text_en: Considering the service types will be supported by 6GR, radio bearer and logical channel could still be helpful to fulfil the specific requirements like latency, error recovery, etc.

agenda_title: Functionality for User Plane and related functional requirements
summary_zh: NR 中引入了多种 compression mechanisms，包括 ROHC、UDC 和 EHC；这些机制虽独立引入，但具有共同点。
text_en: In NR, multiple compression mechanisms, i.e., ROHC, UDC, EHC. ROHC were introduced independently, but those are all compression mechanisms which have commonalities.

agenda_title: Functionality for User Plane and related functional requirements
summary_zh: 在 5G 中，每个 PDCP SDU 生成的 MAC-I 会带来额外 signalling overhead，并占用 UE processing capability，从而影响 UE transmission bit rate。
text_en: In 5G, the MAC-I generated for each PDCP SDU causes extra signalling overheads and UE processing capability (i.e. impacting the UE’s transmission bit rate).

agenda_title: Functionality for User Plane and related functional requirements
summary_zh: Data concatenation 可能导致大小可变、bit positions 不固定的 headers，不利于硬件处理。
text_en: Data concatenation can lead to variable-sized headers with varying bit positions that are not hardware-processing friendly.

agenda_title: Functionality for User Plane and related functional requirements
summary_zh: Data concatenation 可能增加 segment handling 和 reassembly delays。
text_en: Data concatenation can lead to increased segment handling and reassembly delays

agenda_title: Functionality for User Plane and related functional requirements
summary_zh: 同一 SN 用于 ARQ 与 (re-)segmentation 功能，以及 security 与 re-ordering 功能，有利于降低 L2 overhead 并提升效率。
text_en: Same SN used for both ARQ & (re-)segmentation functions and security & re-ordering functions is beneficial for L2 overhead reduction and efficiency improvement.

agenda_title: Functionality for User Plane and related functional requirements
summary_zh: 在 NR 中，单个 code block (CB) 失败可能延迟其他 CB 中 PDU 的交付；在 TB 大得多的 6G 中，这一问题可能更严重。
text_en: In NR, failure of a single code block (CB) can delay the delivery of PDUs in other CBs. This problem can be more serious in 6G with its much larger TBs.

agenda_title: Functionality for User Plane and related functional requirements
summary_zh: 在 TB 中包含关于 MAC CEs 或 MAC subPDUs 的 metadata，可以帮助接收端加快 TB 处理。
text_en: Including metadata about MAC CEs or MAC subPDUs in a TB can help the receiver speed up processing of the TB.

agenda_title: Functionality for User Plane and related functional requirements
summary_zh: 6G 中的 MAC CEs 可以采用更结构化的设计，以实现高效处理并满足预期更严格的 6G timing requirements。
text_en: MAC CEs in 6G can be designed in a more structured way to enable efficient processing and meet the stricter timing requirements expected in 6G.

agenda_title: Functionality for User Plane and related functional requirements
summary_zh: NR UP headers 的长度可变，尤其是在 MAC 和 RLC 中，这不利于硬件实现。
text_en: NR UP headers are variable size especially in MAC and RLC which is not hardware-friendly.

agenda_title: Functionality for User Plane and related functional requirements
summary_zh: 导致 header length 动态变化的因素包括 RLC 中 segmentation 的有无，以及 MAC 中的 LCID 和 L field。
text_en: The factors that cause the header length to change dynamically are as follows: the presence or absence of segmentation in RLC, and the LCID and L field in MAC.

agenda_title: Functionality for User Plane and related functional requirements
summary_zh: 统一 header length 的一种简单方式是始终采用较长的 header；但应避免这样做，因为这会增大 Message 3 等消息的尺寸，而这些消息是 coverage bottlenecks。
text_en: A simple way to unify header lengths is to always adopt the longer header; however, this should be avoided as it would increase the size of messages such as Message 3, which are coverage bottlenecks.

agenda_title: Functionality for User Plane and related functional requirements
summary_zh: 在 NR 中，通过 RACH partitioning 提前指示 feature combinations 会导致 RACH resources 的利用非常低效。
text_en: In NR, early indication of feature combinations through RACH partitioning leads to very inefficient use of RACH resources.

agenda_title: Functionality for User Plane and related functional requirements
summary_zh: 在 NR 中，RACH resources 难以适应接入负载的短期变化，常导致高争用和接入失败。
text_en: In NR, RACH resources do not adapt well to short-term variations in access load, often resulting in high level of contention and access failures.

agenda_title: Functionality for User Plane and related functional requirements
summary_zh: 6GR 应在 UP protocol stack 的高层支持 QoS flows（或由 SA2 设计的 sub flows）到 UL 和 DL radio bearer 的映射，以及 security protection、data PDU 的 sequence numbering、ROHC Header and Data compression、延迟 PDU 的 timer-based discard 和 duplicate detection and discard。原文还指出 Header compression 应根据 plenary 暂缓，data compression 是 UDC 且尚未商业化；ZTE 认为 data compression 也可适用于 DL，且不意味着需要对所有内容启用。
text_en:
6GR shall support the following functionality in a higher layer(s) in UP protocol stack:
-	Mapping between QoS flows (or sub flows if/as designed by SA2) to a radio bearer in UL and DL
-	Security protection, Sequence numbering of data PDUs, ROHC Header and Data compression, and timer-based discard for delayed PDUs
-	Header compression should be parked based on plenary and data compression is UDC and it is not commercialized.    Maybe there are some compression for those.  ZTE thinks that data compression can also be applicable to DL.  Also it doesn’t mean we need to enable this for everything.
-	Duplicate detection and discard

agenda_title: Functionality for User Plane and related functional requirements
summary_zh: 6GR 应在 UP 协议栈的低层支持按物理层 grant 大小分段、逻辑信道优先级处理与复用、调度请求，以及带或不带软合并的传输和重传（HARQ、ARQ）。
text_en:
6GR shall support the following functionality in a lower layer(s) in UP protocol stack:
-	Segmentation of packets based on physical layer grant size
-	Logical channel prioritization and multiplexing, Scheduling requests (SR/BSR like functionality)
-	Transmission and retransmission with and without soft combining (HARQ and ARQ)
[2 min]
Noted
R2-2508217	6GR User Plane Functionality	Sharp	discussion	Rel-20	FS_6G_Radio

agenda_title: Functionality for User Plane and related functional requirements
summary_zh: 列出了被视为 6GR UP 必需基本功能的 NR UP 功能，包括数据传输、序列编号、重复检测与丢弃、PDU 丢弃、重传、分段与重组、MAC 复用与解复用、优先级处理、压缩、安全协议及有序和无序交付。
text_en:
The following NR UP functions are considered as required essential 6GR UP functions:
- Data transfer
- Sequence numbering
- Duplicate discarding/duplicate detection
- PDU discard
- Retransmission (HARQ, ARQ)
- Segmentation/reassembly
- MAC multiplexing and de-multiplexing
- Priority handling (between UE, between LCHs/RBs, between resources, etc)
- Compression (ROHC, UDC, EHC)
- Security protocol (both integrity protection and ciphering)
- In-order delivery (including reordering) and out-of-order delivery
[2 min]
Noted
R2-2508233	6GR UP Functions	CATT	discussion	Rel-20	FS_6G_Radio

agenda_title: Functionality for User Plane and related functional requirements
summary_zh: 提出 6G Day1 至少应支持所列 UP 功能，具体支持方式可进一步研究。清单涵盖 QoS flow 与 DRB 映射、SN 维护、压缩、安全、丢弃、重复处理、交付顺序处理、重分段、L2 ARQ、复用、调度信息报告、HARQ 和 LCP。
text_en:
At least the following UP functions should be supported in 6G Day1 and how to support these functions can be further studied:
-	Mapping/remapping between QoS flow(s) and a DRB,
-	SN maintenance,
-	Header compression and decompression (ROHC and EHC),
-	UDC,
-	AS security ((de)ciphering and integrity protection/integrity verification),
-	SDU discard,
-	L2 PDU duplication,
-	Reordering and in-order delivery,
-	Out-of-order delivery,
-	Duplication discarding/detection,
-	(Re)segmentation,
-	L2 ARQ retransmission,
-	(De)multiplexing,
-	Scheduling information report,
-	HARQ,
-	LCP.

agenda_title: Functionality for User Plane and related functional requirements
summary_zh: 提出 QoS（重）映射、SN 维护、重复丢弃、（重）分段和（解）复用等功能应在 UP 中支持且不可禁用；并列出 UP 至少支持的数据传输、安全、序列编号、头压缩、SDU 丢弃、重复检测与丢弃、有序和无序交付、重排序、分段与重组、逻辑信道优先级处理与复用、调度信息报告及传输和重传。
text_en:
The functions should be supported in UP and cannot be disabled including: QoS (re)mapping, SN maintenance, duplication discarding, (re)segmentation, and (de)multiplexing.
[2 min]
Noted
UP will at least support the following functionalities
Data transfer
Mapping of QoS flow(s) (or what SA2 may come up with) to a radio bearer in UL and DL
Security protection (in coordination with SA3), Sequence numbering, Header compression (e.g. ROHC, etc based on plenary discussion),
SDU discard
Duplicate detection at the receiver side and discard
In-order and out-of-order delivery.  Reordering.
(re)Segmentation of packets and re-assembly
Logical channel prioritization and multiplexing/demultiplexing
Scheduling information reporting
Transmission and retransmission (e.g. HARQ and ARQ like)
NOTE: Details of these functionalities will be further discussed later and the list is not exclusive
NOTE: functions related to RAN1 aspects will be added and considered later on.

agenda_title: Functionality for User Plane and related functional requirements
summary_zh: 提出可将多个 PDCP SDU 拼接为单个 PDCP PDU。讨论涉及目标服务、硬件适配、grant 预测、MAC-I 开销，以及拼接后再分段可能带来的时延和内存缓冲需求。
text_en:
Multiple PDCP SDUs can be concatenated to a single PDCP PDU.
[2 min]
-	Xiaomi asks what specific service you are targeting and wonders if this is hardware friendly and the UE has to predict the grant.   Oppo is referring to many small packets so we have to consider the overhead of MAC-I.  The UE doesn’t need to predict anything and the number of packets to be concatenated can be pre-configured.  Qualcomm ask then does it mean that it will be concatenated and then segmented.   MEdiatek thinks that this is a big problem, latency performance, memory buffer requirements etc.
Noted
R2-2508124	On essential functionality for 6G data transfer	MediaTek UK	discussion	Rel-20	FS_6G_Radio

agenda_title: Functionality for User Plane and related functional requirements
summary_zh: 提出 6G 用户面协议栈的数据处理单位仍保持为逐包粒度，与 NR 相同。
text_en:
As in NR, the unit of data handling in the 6G user plane stack remains at a per-packet granularity.
[2 min]

R2-2508310	UP functionalities and requirements	Nokia, Nokia Shanghai Bell	discussion	Rel-20	FS_6G_Radio

agenda_title: Functionality for User Plane and related functional requirements
summary_zh: 建议在高数据率、短到达间隔或时延要求宽松等有明确收益的场景研究 6GR packet concatenation，同时尽量减少对低层运行的约束并保留 QoS 和优先级隔离。还提出研究发送侧逐包预处理；讨论记录了拼接的处理开销、时延、硬件加速器利用及安全相关考量，并决定待 UP 协议和安全理解进一步完善后再讨论拼接。
text_en:
For scenarios with clear gains (e.g. high-rate, short inter-arrival, or relaxed latency traffics) investigate packet concatenation in 6GR that minimises operational constraints on lower layers and preserve QoS/prioritisation separation.
[2 min]
Noted
R2-2508472	User Plane Function Assessment in 6GR	Ericsson	discussion	Rel-20	FS_6G_Radio
Observation 3	Pre-processing capability on transmitter side is essential to achieve the 6G target of minimizing processing and memory transfers.
Observation 4	Grouping of packets for joint pre-processing leads to delays and cannot efficiently utilize hardware accelerators optimized for typical MTU sizes.
Proposal 5	When studying protocol functionality in 6G, also consider implementations based on per-packet pre-processing on transmitter side.
[2 min]
Noted
Discussion
-	Lenovo thinks that it makes sense only in some scenarios, for example when you have huge chunks of packets at the same time and you need to predict what the grant is and it doesn’t come for free.   Nokia also thinks good to study but there are things to take into account
-	Docomo is open to discuss but agree with Mediatek and Ericsson.  Ciphering and integrity protection takes a lot of processing resourcing.
-	Apple thinks that concatenation is very useful especially when there are all these small packets that come to UE buffers we need to process them each individually and this is a lot of overhead and processing.
-	CMCC and Vivo supports the concatenation
-	Qualcomm has the same view as Mediatek, and points out that this is dependent on integrity protection if done the same way as 5G and this might change.
-	Samsung thinks that there is a way to have fix header with concatenation and the main benefit is to minimize the number of L2 headers.  Samsung thinks that we are only using a portion of the hardware accelerator.
-	Huawei thinks that this only useful for small packets and the gain is mainly for processing.  There is very little concatenation gain.
-	Xiaomi agrees with the other chipset vendors and if we concatenate we are increasing complexity.  Also we need to predict the traffic.
-	LG thinks that there isn’t much gain.  Ciphering is the same and the only benefit is the MAC-I field as it is included only 1.  To concatenate we have to add other headers so there is no gain.   Then the issue is that we have to segment.
-	Ofinno thinks that we need to consider resource efficiency.
-	ZTE supports to study this especially for FWA which has been very successful, as we will have tons of small packets.   LG thinks that this is only a MAC-I issue, so we can discuss selective removal of MAC-I.  ZTE thinks that this is not nice.  Nokia also thinks that this is important for FWA and this reduces the number of time you have to call the function.   Qualcomm doesn’t think we can take data from multiple UEs in the same security context.   ZTE explains that there is a single Uu for the client that is multiplexing multiple UEs.
Come back to concatenation after some further progress on UP protocol and understanding of security

text_en:
1	Initial study on application/service awareness in RAN and UE should focus on identifying traffic characteristics/requirements common among the target 6G use cases and exploring whether/how it can be made available to RAN and UE in a generalized framework (as much as possible). R2-2508300	6G QoS, QoE, and Service awareness	Nokia, Nokia Shanghai Bell	discussion	FS_6G_Radio

summary_zh: RAN 支持感知动态流量特征，例如周期性/突发性、最大突发大小、高吞吐量和低时延，以实现更高效的资源分配与调度。
text_en: The RAN supports awareness of dynamic traffic characteristics—such as periodicity/burstiness, maximum burst size, high throughput, and low latency—to enable more efficient resource allocation and scheduling.

summary_zh: Multi-modal communication 被视为 6GR 中有前景的新兴应用之一。NR 尚未充分处理多模态会话中多个流（如 haptic、audio、video）的传输协调（包括 intra-UE 或 inter-UE 情况），以及 haptic traffic 的高效传输。
text_en: Multi-modal communication is foreseen as one of the promising emerging applications in 6GR, while coordination of the transmission among multiple flows (e.g., haptic, audio and video) within a multi-modal communication session, including intra-UE or inter-UE cases, and the efficient transmission of haptic traffic, are not yet well addressed in NR.

summary_zh: GenAI service flow 的流量特征和需求可能在不同 bursts 之间及随时间显著变化。
text_en: The traffic characteristics and requirements of GenAI service flow may vary significantly across different bursts and over time.

summary_zh: 与 JPEG 等传统图像格式相比，discrete image tokenizers 可在具有更好感知质量的同时减少传输图像大小，但代价是高失真。当前最先进的图像生成模型很少使用 discrete image tokenizers，主要使用 VAE 作为 image tokenizer。
text_en: Compared with traditional image formats like JPEG, discrete image tokenizers can reduce the transmitted image size while having better perceptual quality, at the cost of high distortion. Discrete image tokenizers are rarely used in state-of-the-art image generation models, which mostly use VAE for image tokenizer.

summary_zh: 当前 AI 模型通常在 server side 执行 AI tokenization；对 image generation model，将 image 和 video 的 AI tokenization 移至 UE side 不会减少流量，而对 image understanding model 会显著增加流量，且 processing offloading 收益可忽略。此举还增加 tokenizer model 更新和 client-server version compatibility 等复杂性。
text_en: In current usage of AI models, AI tokenization is performed at the server side. For image and video, moving AI tokenization to UE side does not reduce the traffic compared with transmitting image / video directly for image generation model while increase the traffic significantly for image understanding model, and the gain of processing offloading is negligible. There is increased complexity like update of tokenizer model and version compatibility between client and server.

summary_zh: 使用单一 radio bearer 承载 UE 的所有服务会导致接收端所有服务发生 head-of-line blocking。
text_en: The use of a single radio bearer to transport all services for a UE as is typical in the field, leads to head-of-line blocking of all services at the receiver.

summary_zh: 6G 的目标应用（如 XR、mobile AI）具有相似的流量特征，例如分组之间存在依赖关系和重要性差异。
text_en: Target applications in 6G (e.g. XR, mobile AI) exhibit similar traffic characteristics, such as dependency and different importances among packets.

summary_zh: 从调度和资源管理角度看，最重要的是流量属性和 QoS requirements，而不是生成流量的应用类型。
text_en: From a scheduling and resource management standpoint, what matters most are traffic attributes and QoS requirements, rather than the type of applications that generate the traffic.

summary_zh: 由于 UE 承载应用并终止协议栈各层的所有协议，许多场景下 UE 可获得大量 QoE 信息，从而直接跟踪应用状态。
text_en: For many cases, a lot of QoE information is available at the UE on account of hosting the application as well as terminating all protocols across the stack. This allows close and straightforward tracking of the application state.

summary_zh: UE 可调整许多 L2 protocol parameters，且对 NW operation 影响很小或没有影响。
text_en: Many L2 protocol parameters can be adapted by the UE with little or no impact of NW operation.

summary_zh: 5G NR 使用 QoS profiles 和 QoS rules 将数据包映射到合适的 QoS Flows 和 DRBs。
text_en: In 5G NR, QoS profiles and QoS rules are used to map packets to appropriate QoS Flows and DRBs.

summary_zh: 原文指出，目前没有开发新 QoS framework（例如新的 QoS granularity）的具体且紧迫需求。
text_en: There is no specific and urgent requirements to develop new QoS framework such as new QoS granularity for 6GR.

summary_zh: 原文指出，NR QoS model 缺少 per-packet 或 per packet-group granularity。
text_en: NR QoS model lacks per-packet or per packet-group granularity

summary_zh: 原文指出，NR QoS model 缺少在 RAN 中将数据包动态映射到 packet treatment 的能力。
text_en: NR QoS model lacks dynamic mapping of packets to packet treatment in RAN

summary_zh: RAN 支持感知动态 traffic characteristics，包括 periodicity/burstiness、maximum burst size、high throughput 和 low latency，以便更高效地分配资源和进行调度。
text_en: The RAN supports awareness of dynamic traffic characteristics—such as periodicity/burstiness, maximum burst size, high throughput, and low latency—to enable more efficient resource allocation and scheduling.

summary_zh: 原文指出，需要通过动态 QoS adaptation 支持 GenAI service。
text_en: Dynamic QoS adaptation to support GenAI service is needed.

summary_zh: 讨论提出在 6GR 中研究 immersive communications 和 AI mobile traffic 的 traffic characteristics，包括 non-integer periodicity、delay sensitive、jitter、multi-modal service、PDU set transmission 和 small packet。与会方还提出考虑 data bursts、等待 SA4，以及在研究 procedures 时留意这些特征。
text_en:
Study the following traffic characteristics in 6GR for immersive communications and AI mobile traffic:
-	Non-integer periodicity,
-	Delay sensitive,
-	Jitter,
-	Multi-modal service,
-	PDU set transmission,
-	Small packet.

-	Mediatek thinks we should wait for SA4.
-	Ericsson thinks that the study already provides some of the characteristics.
(Not treated) Token traffic and service – already discussed Monday

summary_zh: 原文提出，6GR 应研究并识别新服务及其 traffic characteristics 和对应 requirements，并在 6G Day-1 design 中加以考虑。列举的服务包括 immersive communication、GenAI 和 lightweight AI/AR glasses；观察还指出 token-based communications 可容错，且不同 token 的重要性因 modality 和其在 traffic stream 中的位置而异。
text_en:
6GR should study and identify the following new services with traffic characteristics and corresponding requirements. These characteristics and requirements should be considered in the 6G Day-1 design to ensure that the system can efficiently support and fulfil the needs of such services:
-	Immersive communication service: synchronization for multi-modal service, critical latency and vary burst size for haptic traffic;
-	GenAI: QoS requirements may vary significantly across different bursts and over time;
-	New service on lightweight AI/AR glasses: trade-off between power saving and high performance.
[2 min]
R2-2508137	Discussion on QoS, QoE and Service-awareness in 6G	Huawei, HiSilicon	discussion	Rel-20

summary_zh: 6G UP functionality 的设计应考虑 AI services 的 requirements 和 characteristics，例如 error tolerance 及不同 tokens 的可变重要性。原文还指出，E2E latency 对 immersive communications (IC) 的用户体验至关重要，且其要求可在单个 IC application 内随时间变化。
text_en:

Observation 2-2:	The E2E latency is critical for ensuring good user experience in IC services. However, the E2E latency requirement can be time-varying even within a single IC application.

summary_zh: 原文提出研究 6G immersive communications traffic 的 E2E latency requirement。原文还指出，基于 real-time video traffic characteristics 定义的现有 R18/R19 XR enhancements，不能复用于 R20 将研究的 non-real-time mobile AI traffic。

summary_zh: 依赖 HARQ coordination 可能加快 RLC recovery loop。RLC Sequence Number-window based mechanism 可保证最终纠正所有 HARQ errors，且使 NW 能在 latency、spectral efficiency、power、overhead 和 processing 等 design KPIs 之间权衡。

summary_zh: 在 NR 中，发送 BSR/DSR MAC CE 前需通过 SR 或 RACH 经历多个步骤和信令交互以获取 UL grant。这会增加 UL transmission latency。
text_en: In NR, several steps/signalling interactions are required to acquire the UL grant for BSR/DSR MAC CE transmission, i.e., via SR or RACH, which increases UL transmission latency.

agenda_title: Scheduling, retransmissions and uplink scheduling information
summary_zh: Contention-based UL transmissions 不应成为发送 SR/BSR 的唯一选项，因为其时延不确定，并可能取决于 transmission occasions 的周期性、contention levels 等因素。
text_en: Contention-based UL transmissions should not be the only option for sending SR/BSR, as its latency is not deterministic and can depend on several factors, such as periodicity of transmissions occasions, contention levels, etc.

agenda_title: Scheduling, retransmissions and uplink scheduling information
summary_zh: BSR 和 DSR 存在重复，导致 signalling overhead，甚至造成 inefficiency。

text_en: The legacy LCP procedure leads to LCH starvation, resource inefficiency, and inflexibility in handling dynamic traffic requirements—particularly for delay-sensitive applications.

agenda_title: Scheduling, retransmissions and uplink scheduling information
summary_zh: 一致认为 ARQ 支持 sequence number-based L2 recovery，并研究基于 HARQ process status、由 transmitter side 更快触发 ARQ retransmissions 的机制，先从 UL 开始，也可考虑 DL。RAN2 认为 gNB 提供显式 UL HARQ process status 有益，其具体细节待进一步研究。
text_en:
Send an LS to RAN1 to take the following design requirements into consideration:
2.	HARQ feedback designed to be robust to misinterpretation
3.	HARQ feedback made available to the UE for UL transmissions
Noted
Discussion
-	LG asks why we need SN if we have HARQ feedback.   Interdigital explains that there are cases where this is needed, including NTN where there may be no HARQ.
-	Samsung thinks that this should be an optional feature.   Sharp thinks we should only support one mechanism.
-	Lenovo agrees that explicit HARQ status is beneficial.   Interdigital agree and for configured grant there is no explicit feedback.  Qualcomm agrees that we may need the status but we need to first discuss and then if we agree then we can tell RAN1.
-	Oppo explains that the UE only know if the packet has to be retransmitted but not if it was successful.  Apple agrees.  We should tell RAN1 that this is beneficial for RAN2 so please implement it.
-	Nokia also thinks that it makes sense to tell the UE why the packet is dropped.   Vivo wonders why we need to bother RAN1 as MAC CE.
-	Sony thinks that feedback would create overhead
-	Huawei thinks that RAN1 has introduced explicit feedback for CG
-	Ericsson thinks that L1 signaling should be used and we should bother RAN1.
-	LG agrees that we should be careful because for CG we would be increasing resource inefficiencies.
Agreements on HARQ - ARQ
1	Assume that sequence number-based L2 recovery mechanism is supported for ARQ
2	Study mechanisms for faster ARQ retransmissions at the transmitter side based on HARQ process status (e.g. whether the TB was successful or not).   Start with UL and can consider DL.
3	From RAN2 perspective, it is beneficial to have explicit UL HARQ process status from gNB for this purposes.  FFS on the details of explicit UL HARQ process status.
