summary_zh: Dynamic capability应避免因重新生成 supported BC list 而增加开销，并通过报告实际状态的 UE capability 兼顾 UE 与网络利益；网络可根据 UE capability 变化决定配置，也可考虑同时指示变化根因。
text_en: Dynamic capability 1) will not increase overhead caused by re-generation of the supported BC list, 2) can reach mutual interests of both UEs and networks by reporting state-of-fact UE capability, the configuration(s) can be up to network implementation by respecting to the change of UE capability, 3) can consider to indicate the root cause of capability change together with the changed capability.

summary_zh: 将 capabilities 分散在多个规范中被认为费力，并导致差异，进而造成产品实现错误。
text_en: Spreading capabilities across multiple specifications has shown to be laborious and resulted in discrepancies that led to incorrect product implementations.

summary_zh: UE radio capabilities 可能非常庞大，超过单条 UL RRC message 的允许大小。
text_en: UE radio capabilities can be very large and can exceed the allowable size of a single UL RRC message size.

summary_zh: 在 5G 中，UE capabilities 以较为扁平且全面的集合上报，但没有所有设备共享的明确定义最低基线，导致市场碎片化和 IoT 测试过多。
text_en: In 5G, UE capabilities were reported as a largely flat and comprehensive set, without a clearly defined minimum baseline shared by all devices, leading to market fragmentation and excessive IoT testing.

summary_zh: 在 5G 中，UE capability signalling 会报告完整 capability information，即使多数设备通常都支持大量相同特性。
text_en: In 5G, UE capability signalling reports the full capability information, even though a large number of features are commonly supported in most devices.

summary_zh: 在 5G 中，UE capabilities 采用紧密耦合、深层嵌套的结构（如 per-band 和 per-band-combination capabilities），限制了通用 capability information 的复用，并导致不同频段和组合重复传送相同值。
text_en: In 5G, UE capabilities were signalled using tightly coupled and deeply nested structures (e.g. per-band, per-band-combination capabilities), which limited reuse of common capability information and caused repeated signalling of identical values across bands and combinations.

summary_zh: RAN2 同意已识别出可能造成 signalling overhead 和 complexity 的问题，包括 capability signalling size 大、network filtering 低效、RACS 不实用，以及大量未部署或未商业化的可选特性。
text_en:
RAN2 agrees the following problems identified that can cause signalling overhead and complexity:
-	Problem 1: Significant capability signalling size
-	Problem 2: Inefficient network filtering
-	Problem 3: Impractical RACS
-	Problem 4: Massive optional features that are not deployed/commercialized
Problem 1

summary_zh: RAN2 同意 Problem 1（significant capability signalling size）的根因包括：不同频段或 band combinations 间重复或冗余上报、UL Tx switching capability reporting 的复杂度和开销，以及 FeatureSetCombination 复用不足。
text_en:
RAN2 agrees the following root causes identified for Problem 1 ‘significant capability signalling size’:
-	Problem 1: Significant capability signalling size
	(19/19) Root cause 1: With the understanding that finer granularity cannot be avoidable according to different UE implementation for some features, Duplicated/redundant signalling was reported due to the same capability value shared across different bands and/or band combinations (e.g., due to inefficient BC structure (e.g., multiple bandwidth classes, fallback groups, etc), some band/BC sharing the same capability, improper use of finer granularity, etc);
	(19/19) Root cause 2: Complexity and overhead of UL Tx switching capability reporting (e.g., duplicate band combination list and BC capabilities between normal CA BC and UL Tx Switching, ambiguity of fallback rules, introduction of LBCA in later release, etc);
	(17/17) Root cause 3: Infrequent-reused FeatureSetCombination (e.g., due to loss of flexibility to reuse small sets of FeatureSet, etc).
-	Oppo thinks that BC should be decided by RAN4.  Xiaomi agrees but from a signalling point of view that is a root cause, so we need to discuss how to address it.
-	ZTE thinks that root cause 1 combines everything together, but we should prioritize the issue and maybe better to divide in two parts.
-	Nokia also thinks that we should prioritize and what to focus on first.

summary_zh: 针对 Problem 1，RAN2 同意研究跨频段或 band combinations 复用相同值、避免 UE envelop limitation 的 finer granularity 和过度分类、减少 xDD/FRx 差异能力的冗余上报，以及统一 spectrum aggregation capability framework。另同意研究可跨多个频段或组合复用的重复 FeatureSet 结构；DL/UL Decoupling 的能力信令讨论因无共识而延期。
text_en:
For Problem 1, RAN2 agrees the following study areas in RAN2:
	(19/19) With the understanding that finer granularity cannot be avoidable according to different UE implementation for some features, study methods/principles and signalling reduction gain to 1) simplify reporting of capabilities with same value across bands/band combinations, 2) avoid using finer granularity for UE envelop limitation and 3) avoid overclassified capability. The basic concept of band/band combination (including BW class, FBG, etc), feature design, RF requirement, UE capability granularity of RAN1/4 features are up to RAN1/4, RAN2 to focus on signalling structure design;
	(19/19) Study how to reduce redundant capability reporting for capabilities with xDD/FRx difference, depending on whether feature(s) with xDD/FRx will be introduced in 6G by RAN1/2/4;
	(19/19) Study a unified spectrum aggregation capability framework (e.g., for CA, UL Tx switching, LBCA with switching, etc). The feasibility of unified framework of spectrum aggregation is up to RAN1/4.
	Study methods to reuse reporting of capabilities if the same capability applies for both normal CA BC and UL Tx switching.
	(17/17) Study an efficient structure that can be extensively reused by multiple bands/band combinations whenever needed, where this structure represents a group of repeated FeatureSet: RAN2.

Ericsson doesn’t think that this is RAN4/RAN1.  It is related to signaling and we need to look into it, otherwise no one else will look at it.  Once we have found out the details and which previous decisions led to capability size increase.

summary_zh: RAN2 将研究 6G Day 1 是否支持 RACS 的收益及可行性；若支持，RACS-ID 应可灵活复用且不覆盖 UE 的全部 capabilities，RACS-like solution 应降低协调挑战和维护负担。研究内容包括 RACS ID 粒度、基于 RACS 的 capability 检索框架，并在需要时与 SA2 协调。

Agreements on UE capability framework
1.   RAN2 agrees the following problems identified that can cause signalling overhead and complexity:
-	Problem 1: Significant capability signalling size
-	Problem 2: Inefficient network filtering
-	Problem 3: Impractical RACS
-	Problem 4: Massive optional features that are not deployed/commercialized
2. 	Problem 1: Significant capability signalling size
-	Root cause 1: With the understanding that finer granularity cannot be avoidable according to different UE implementation for some features, Duplicated/redundant signalling was reported due to the same capability value shared across different bands and/or band combinations (e.g., due to inefficient BC structure (e.g., multiple bandwidth classes, fallback groups, etc), some band/BC sharing the same capability, improper use of finer granularity, etc);
-	Root cause 2: Complexity and overhead of UL Tx switching capability reporting (e.g., duplicate band combination list and BC capabilities between normal CA BC and UL Tx Switching, ambiguity of fallback rules, introduction of LBCA in later release, etc);
-	Root cause 3: Infrequent-reused FeatureSetCombination (e.g., due to loss of flexibility to reuse small sets of FeatureSet, etc).
3.	For Problem 1, RAN2 agrees the following study areas in RAN2:
-	With the understanding that finer granularity cannot be avoidable according to different UE implementation for some features, study methods/principles and signalling reduction gain to 1) simplify reporting of capabilities with same value across bands/band combinations, 2) avoid using finer granularity for UE envelop limitation and 3) avoid overclassified capability. The basic concept of band/band combination (including BW class, FBG, etc), feature design, RF requirement, UE capability granularity of RAN1/4 features are up to RAN1/4, RAN2 to focus on signalling structure design;
-	Study how to reduce redundant capability reporting for capabilities with xDD/FRx difference, depending on whether feature(s) with xDD/FRx will be introduced in 6G by RAN1/2/4;
-	Study a unified spectrum aggregation capability framework (e.g., for CA, UL Tx switching, LBCA with switching, etc). The feasibility of unified framework of spectrum aggregation is up to RAN1/4.
-	Study methods to reuse reporting of capabilities if the same capability applies for both normal CA BC and UL Tx switching.
-	Study an efficient structure that can be extensively reused by multiple bands/band combinations whenever needed, where this structure represents a group of repeated FeatureSet, considering uplink and downlink separation in BC signalling and feature set combination.
4.	RAN2 agrees the following root causes identified for Problem 2 ‘Inefficient network filtering’
-	Root cause: 5G network filtering didn’t provide sufficient/appropriate information to UE for 1) filtering capabilities with common interests between network and UE and 2) reducing capability size effectively.
5.	For network filtering, RAN2 agrees the following study areas:
-	 Study proper finer filtering to reduce capability signalling size in single report, considering the balance between signalling size and re-enquiry: RAN2
-	Study the solutions to avoid UE omitting network interested capabilities when capability signalling size is more than UL RRC message (including when segmentation is supported): RAN2
-	RAN2 waits for clear definition of 1) 6G band/band combination, 2) features to be supported in 6G and 3) device type to be supported in 6G, and then studies on the above study areas.
6	RAN2 to study the benefit considering the followings:

	RACS-ID should be flexible to be reused and avoid covering all capabilities of a UE;
	RACS-like solution should reduce coordination challenges and maintenance burden;

	Proper granularity of RACS ID
	Retrieval framework of RACS-based capability
-	Coordination with SA2 if needed.
7	RAN2 agrees the following root causes identified for Problem 4 ‘Massive optional features that are not deployed/commercialized’:
-	Root cause: Multiple options are introduced to the same functionality and too many optional components defined for single feature/function.
-	To solve problem 4, RAN1/RAN2/RAN4 should strictly follow ‘minimizing the adoption of multiple options for the same functionality’ as in 6G SID
8	IODT and commercialization discussions are moved to the plenary, as they are outside of RAN2 scope.
9.	RAN2 will further discuss how and if to prioritize and how to proceed with the work…
10.	Based on progress decide to send LS to RAN1/4 once RAN2 has sufficient progress. RAN1/4 6G study should be taken into account based on RAN1/4

summary_zh: Dynamic capability 支持因 overheating、power consumption constraints 和 hardware requirements 变化（例如 MUSIM、IDC、AI/ML processing unit）而改变 UE capabilities；Table 1 作为 RAN2 讨论和识别 6G capability change justification 与 requirements 的起点，其他 use case 尚待研究。
text_en: Dynamic capability supports changes of UE’s capabilities for the use cases associated to overheating, power consumption constrains, and changes on the hardware requirements (e.g., MUSIM, IDC, AI/ML processing unit, etc). If so, Table 1 is used as starting point (baseline) for RAN2 to discuss/identify justification and requirements for capability change in 6G. FFS on other dynamic capability use case.

summary_zh: RAN2 确认 UAI 不足以报告 UE capability change：UE 上报受网络配置控制，网络收到 UAI 后应有的行为未明确，UAI 报告的是 RRC configuration preferences 而非 capability change，且按 feature 上报。
text_en:
RAN2 confirms UAI is not sufficient for UE’s capability change reporting considering the following pain points:
-	(1) UE reporting is controlled by network (i.e., UE is only allowed when configured by network),
-	(2) UE’s expectations of the network behaviour upon reception of UAI message is unclear (i.e., unspecified) and the concerned problem cannot be resolved,
-	(3) UAI provides preferences on RRC configurations instead of capability change,
-	(4) UAI reporting is per feature.

summary_zh: Dynamic capability update 需要考虑 network control 与 UE constraints/implications 的权衡，并通过四项研究领域定义网络和 UE 行为：网络依据更新能力重新配置或取消配置及未遵循更新的后果、是否向 RAN 和/或 CN 上报、handover 与 cell-reselection 时的流程和 retrieval framework，以及上报格式。RAN2 同意至少从 overheating 和 MUSIM 两类主要 use case 开始研究，但不排除其他 use case。
text_en:
Dynamic capability update needs to 1) consider track-off between network control and UE’s constrains/implications and 2) define behaviour for both network and UE, by addressing the above Study Areas 1-4:
-	Area 1: Expected network behaviour to reconfigure/de-configure according to UE updated capability, and consequence of not following dynamic capability change, including UE behaviour(s) if dynamic capability update is not respected/responded by network;
-	Area 2: Whether dynamic capability is reported to RAN only or CN as well;
-	Area 3: Procedure of dynamic capability and its retrieval framework during handover and cell-reselection;
-	Area 4: Reporting format of dynamic capability, e.g., separate parameter IEs, container, or UE radio capability ID.

Discussion
-	Huawei thought the action point was to discuss the use cases and similar to ericsson overheating and MUSIM are the critical use cases.   UAI is technically feasible but we can address the problem of UAI.
-	Oppo also agrees that MUSIM and overheating are critical.  But we have AI/ML that we haven’t fully understood the problem.   Xiaomi explains that we have discussed applicability reporting and this we can consider sending this indication via capability.

-	CMCC thinks we should discuss the detailed parameters and whether it is AS or SA too.
-	Jio supports that this capability should be supported for CN.
-	Mediatek thinks that we shouldn’t narrow down the discussion on only two use cases as we should think of possible use cases in the future as we may run into the same problem as 5G in future.   Samsung agrees with Mediatek.
-	Xiaomi agrees that we have two categories – 1) scheduler related (e.g. UE overheating) and 2) hardware/RF change  (e.g. MUSIM).   Sony thinks we can start with use cases and separate the discussion on the mechanism needed for it.   Ideally we would have the same solution and not different ones for different use cases.
-	Qualcomm thinks that we need to discuss on what the UE expects from the network.
-	Apple understands the desire to limit but we should address the issues with UAI.
-	CATT agrees to limit the usecases and start with UAI.  We should discuss how we can verify what the UE is indicating.  Mediatek reminds everyone that the KPIs of the UE would suffer so it wouldn’t unnecessarily report things.  So we should trust the UE, we should categorize, what the UE can do and network has discretion and cases where the UE has a limitation on what it can support.
Agreements on dynamic UE capability
Start the study at least considering two main use cases, overheating and MUSIM.  This doesn’t mean that other use cases will not be studied.

summary_zh: 应用 MAC security 可能使 MAC PDU 增加约 1–5 octets；是否还需 encryption 带来的额外开销，应向 SA3 询问。
text_en: Applying MAC security will likely add ~1-5 octets to the MAC PDU size, but whether any additional overhead from encryption is needed should be asked from SA3.

summary_zh: RAN2 应告知 SA3 哪些 MAC CEs 对系统运行更为“fundamental”，例如与 connection setup and maintenance 相关的 MAC CEs。
text_en: RAN2 should inform SA3 which MAC CEs are the most ”fundamental” to the system operation than others (e.g. MAC CEs related to connection setup and maintenance).

summary_zh: 评估 MAC security 的影响时，需要考虑 MAC CE security 带来的 latency。
text_en: The latency from MAC CE security needs to be accounted for when considering impact of MAC security.

summary_zh: 已规范的 real-time MAC CEs 很少，目前仅识别出 BSR、DSR 和 PHR。
text_en: There are very few real-time MAC CEs specified: Only BSR/DSR/PHR are identified.

summary_zh: 实现 MAC security 有多种方式，且技术上均可行；应选择哪种选项组合取决于 RAN2 和 SA3 的分析。
text_en: While there are several ways to realize MAC security, all of them are technically feasible and which combination of options to choose depends on analysis by both RAN2 and SA3

summary_zh: 可识别一组 latency-critical MAC CEs，并应优先进行 security evaluation，以便在规范阶段推进时向 SA3 更新 5G 与 6G MAC CEs 的差异。
text_en: A set of latency-critical MAC CEs can be identified and should be prioritised for security evaluation, with the intention to update SA3 on the differences between 5G and 6G MAC CEs as they develop in the normative phase.

summary_zh: 列出的 latency-sensitive MAC CEs 是可能制定安全要求的重点对象，包括 BSR、PHR、Timing Advance、Configured Grant Confirmation、LTM 命令、PUCCH Spatial Relation 和 UE-specific PDCCH/PDSCH 的 TCI 状态指示或激活/去激活。
text_en:
The following MAC CEs are of particular interest for possible security requirements due to their latency sensitivity:
•	BSR
•	PHR (multiple variations for single/multiple entry, multiple TRPs, etc.)
•	Timing Advance and Absolute Timing Advance (deadline based on the HARQ turnaround time)
•	Configured Grant Confirmation and Multiple Entry Configured Grant Confirmation
•	LTM Cell Switch Command and Enhanced LTM Cell Switch Command
•	LTM Candidate Timing Advance Command
•	PUCCH Spatial Relation Activation/Deactivation
•	TCI State Indication for UE-specific PDCCH
•	TCI States Activation/Deactivation for UE-specific PDSCH

summary_zh: 部分 MAC CE（如 BSR、PHR、TA）需要在 security establishment 之前发送。
text_en: Certain MAC CEs (e.g., BSR, PHR, TA) need to be sent before security establishment.

summary_zh: RAN2 和实现团队需要了解 6G 中 MAC CE security protection 的预期复杂度，并确认 RRC connection 期间依赖 symmetric security algorithms 是否足够。
text_en: RAN2 and implementation teams need to understand the anticipated complexity of MAC CE security protection in 6G, and in particular to know whether it is sufficient during an RRC connection to rely on symmetric security algorithms.

summary_zh: 在 TB construction 后期才可能确定是否将 MAC CE 纳入 transport block，这可能影响某些设计中的 security processing 时序。
text_en: Inclusion of a MAC CE in a transport block may be determined late in the TB construction, which may affect the timing of security processing in some designs.

summary_zh: 小型 MAC CE 和尺寸受限场景引发了 security overhead 方面的顾虑（若相关 MAC CE 适用），该问题应提交 SA3 关注。讨论还提出梳理 MAC CE 是否 time critical、是否需在 security 前发送，并权衡其时限预算。
text_en:
Small MAC CEs and size-constrained cases raise a concern about security overhead (if applicable to the concerned MAC CEs), which should be brought to SA3’s attention.

summary_zh: UL 发送侧的 MAC CE security operations（encryption 和/或 integrity protection）引入的处理时延应尽量降低，以避免相较现有 Uu timeline 造成性能影响。

summary_zh: DL 接收侧的 MAC CE security operations（integrity verification 和/或 decryption）引入的处理时延应尽量降低，以避免相较现有 Uu timeline 造成性能影响。

summary_zh: 从 RAN2 角度看，聚焦于对系统接入所需 system information 的 integrity protection 是合理的，目标是检测 false base station。
text_en: From RAN2 perspective, it looks reasonable to focus on integrity protection of system information that is required for access to the system, targetting false base station detection.

summary_zh: 受 message space constraints 限制，部分基础 system information 在接收时可能不适合保护。RAN2 可询问 SA3，是否接受在后续 SIB 接收 signature 并事后校验等方法。
text_en: Some fundamental system information may be impractical to protect at the time of reception due to message space constraints, but RAN2 can inquire if other methods such as receiving a signature in a later SIB and checking it after the fact would be acceptable for SA3.

summary_zh: 从 RAN2 角度看，可允许 UE 建立 temporary 或 provisional connection，以验证最初接收的 system information；但 RAN2 无法评估该方案从 SA3 角度是否有效。
text_en: From RAN2 perspective, it may be feasible to allow a temporary or provisional connection for the UE to validate the initially received system information, but RAN2 cannot evaluate if such a solution is valid from SA3 perspective.

summary_zh: 从 RAN2 角度，dedicated delivery of SIBs 应由 connected mode security 覆盖，因此此情境无需特定的 SI protection scheme。
text_en: From RAN2 perspective, dedicated delivery of SIBs should be covered by connected mode security, making any specific SI protection scheme unnecessary in this context.

summary_zh: 在 5G NR 中，system information broadcast 容易受到 False Base Stations 带来的潜在威胁。
text_en: In 5G NR, system information broadcast is prone to potential threats from False Base Stations.

text_en: Both PDCP and RLC have their own SNs because they serve different functional purposes at different protocol layers.

summary_zh: NR RACH procedures 的复杂性来自不同 RACH type 分别定义流程造成的冗余、RACH partitioning 带来的资源选择复杂性，以及 RACH fallback 的复杂检查。
text_en: NR RACH procedures are complicated due to 1/ redundancy caused by separate procedures defined for different RACH type; 2/ resource selection complexity introduced by RACH partitioning; 3/ complicated checks for RACH fallback.

summary_zh: 2step RACH 对低时延连接建立和小数据传输具有明显优势。
text_en: 2step RACH offers clear benefits for lowlatency connection setup and smalldata transmission.

summary_zh: 应在 RACH partitioning 框架基础上考虑缓解 RA overload 的机制。
text_en: Mitigation mechanisms for RA overload should be considered on top of the RACH partitioning framework.

summary_zh: RACH resource adaptation 不必限于 additional RACH resources，也可应用于 6G 中配置的任意 RACH resources。
text_en: RACH resource adaptation does not need to be limited to additional RACH resources and can be applied to any RACH resources configured in 6G.

summary_zh: 提出研究支持更大的 Msg3/MsgA size 的可能性，以实现更快且更适当的 initial setup。
text_en: It would be beneficial to study the possibility of supporting a larger Msg3/MsgA size to enable faster and more appropriate initial setup in 6G.

summary_zh: 在 NR 中，通过 RACH partitioning 提前指示 feature combinations 会导致 RACH resources 使用效率很低，并使 signaling 过于复杂。
text_en: In NR, early indication of feature combinations by RACH partitioning leads to very inefficient use of RACH resources and overly complex signaling.

summary_zh: 在 NR 中，RACH resources 难以适应接入负载的短期变化，常导致高争用和接入失败。
text_en: In NR, RACH resources do not adapt well to short-term variations in access load, often resulting in high level of contention and access failures.

summary_zh: AS layer 的 HOL blocking 可能源于多种 traffic 映射到同一 DRB 并由同一 queue 处理，或不同 DRB 的 traffic 被复用到同一 TB。后者会使映射到解码失败 CB 的 traffic 阻塞映射到成功解码 CB 的 traffic 交付。
将 service flows 映射到不同 DRB 的现有方案无法解决同一 DRB 内一个 service flow 对其他 service flows 的 HOL blocking。该方案缺乏 scalability 和 flexibility，并导致 high latency 与 high signalling overhead。
text_en: The HOL blocking issue of one service flow to other service flows in the same DRB cannot be resolved by existing solution of mapping service flows to different DRBs, as it is not scalable, flexible, and results in high latency and high signalling overhead.

summary_zh: 在 NR 中，单个 code block (CB) 失败可能延迟其他 CB 中 PDU 的交付；由于 6G 的 TB 更大，该问题可能更严重。
text_en: In NR, failure of a single code block (CB) can delay the delivery of PDUs in other CBs. This problem can be more critical in 6G with its much larger TBs.

summary_zh: 在 TB 起始处包含有关 MAC CEs 或 MAC subPDUs 的 metadata，可帮助接收端加快 TB 处理。
text_en: Including metadata about MAC CEs or MAC subPDUs at a start of a TB can help the receiver speed up processing of the TB.

summary_zh: NR 的 SDAP layer 需要投入 operational effort，以确保 handover 期间正确转发数据；发生 QoS flow remapping 时，也无法保证 in-order delivery。
text_en: The SDAP layer in NR requires operational effort to ensure proper data forwarding during handover and does not guarantee in-order delivery when QoS flow remapping occurs.

summary_zh: NR 中的 SDAP Rmap 和 RQoS mechanism 会增加 user plane processing overhead 与 latency。
text_en: The SDAP Rmap and RQoS mechanism in NR increases the user plane processing overhead and latency.

summary_zh: QFI marking 是一项简单功能，可合并到其他 protocol layer 中。
text_en: QFI marking is a simple function and can be merged into other protocol layer.

summary_zh: 认为 Reflective QoS 在 6GR 中效率不高。
text_en: Reflective QoS is not efficient in 6GR.

summary_zh: RAN2 将研究如何增强 6G 的 PDCP/RLC discarding mechanisms（如可行），以处理 per-packet discard timer 可能丢弃 application bursts、且不考虑 QoE 是否改善的问题。还指出不随 path latency variations 调整的 single static timer 对控制 application delay 过于粗略。
提出 6G User Plane 设计需考虑卫星载荷的 SWaP 约束，并针对全量或部分 6G RAN 功能在星上的 regenerative payload 优化协议开销。还提出为 NTN extended RTT 定义 user plane timers，并支持按 service type 动态启停 user plane retransmission mechanisms。
text_en:
Designing the satellite link for very low error rates minimizes the need for retransmission mechanisms at user plane level that can be turned off, reducing complexity and resource use without impacting end-to-end reliability.
Proposal 1	The 6G User Plane shall be designed to take into consideration the satellite’s constraints SWaP (Size, Weight and Power) on board:
	Regenerative payload with full 6G RAN on board: Optimize the memory and computational footprints of the user plane protocols
	Regenerative payload with partial 6G RAN functions on board (6G RAN architecture split): Optimize the number of interactions between the user plane protocols
Proposal 2	The user plane timers of the 6G radio access shall be defined to accommodate extended RTT for NTN scenarios
Proposal 3	The 6G access radio protocol shall support all specific features defined for 5G NR-NTN including the dynamic activation and deactivation of retransmission mechanisms at user plane level, depending on the service type.

summary_zh: Real-time mobile AI traffic 的流量特征与 XR applications 的流量模型相似：具有周期性，但 burst size 高度可变，并有严格的时延要求。
Non-real-time mobile AI traffic 与 legacy eMBB traffic 特征相似，同时具有非周期、突发、UL 负载较高等特点，并使用 HTTP 和 TCP/QUIC、短时连接更多。其 delay budget 灵活，但 latency 对用户体验至关重要。
R20 mobile AI service 和研究结果可复用于 6G 的场景均考虑上行流量；下行 AI 流量可在 6G 讨论中进一步分析。
text_en: Uplink traffic is considered for both R20 mobile AI service and the results of the study could be reused for 6G. The downlink AI traffic could be further analyzed in the 6G discussion.

summary_zh: Non-real-time uplink mobile AI traffic 依赖 TCP 或 QUIC/UDP 等可靠传输。
text_en: The non-real-time uplink mobile AI traffic relies on reliable transport such as TCP or QUIC/UDP.

summary_zh: 与传统上行流量传输（如 FTP upload）不同，mobile AI services 主要是交互式服务，时延会直接影响用户体验。
text_en: Unlike traditional uplink traffic transmission (e.g., FTP upload), mobile AI services are predominantly interactive, meaning that the latency directly affects user experience.

summary_zh: Interactive AI、Agentic AI 和沉浸式流量（包括 conversational XR 实时通信）会产生上行突发、对时延敏感且速率变化的流量模式。从系统效率角度看，其 latency、data arrival time 和 inter-burst time interval 等特性带来挑战。
text_en: Interactive AI, Agentic AI and immersive traffic including real-time communication for conversational XR introduce challenging traffic patterns (uplink bursty, delay-sensitive, and of varying bitrate, latency, data arrival time and inter-burst time interval) from a system efficiency perspective.

summary_zh: Interactive AI 服务流量主要以上行为主且对时延敏感。其数据会话包含周期性和/或不规则的 UL data bursts，payload size 和 inter-burst interval 可变。
text_en: Traffic associated with interactive AI-based services is predominantly uplink-heavy and latency-sensitive, with data sessions characterized by periodic and/or irregular UL data bursts exhibiting variable payload sizes and inter-burst intervals.

summary_zh: 带有 AI assistance 的 interactive real-time services 会产生 delay-critical uplink data bursts。bounded latency 和 high reliability 是其关键性能要求。
text_en: Interactive real-time services with AI assistance generate delay-critical uplink data bursts, for which bounded latency and high reliability are key performance requirements.

summary_zh: 应优先高效支持具有 low、deterministic latency 的 delay-critical UL bursts。
text_en: Efficient support for delay-critical UL bursts with low, determistic latency should be a priority.

summary_zh: AI traffic 的传输特性包括突发和非周期流量模式、多模态数据类型、增强可靠性，以及严格的端到端时延和往返时延要求。
text_en: Transmission characteristics of AI traffic include burst and non-periodic traffic patterns, multi-modality for diverse data types, enhanced reliability, and strict end-to-end latency and round-trip time requirements.

summary_zh: Mobile AI traffic 具有很强的异构性和多模态特征。它无法用单一或静态流量模型描述。
text_en: Mobile AI traffic exhibits strong heterogeneity and multi-modalities and cannot be characterized by a single or static traffic model.

summary_zh: 面向 Rel-18 和 Rel-19 XR traffic 的现有 RAN mechanisms 和 QoS handling，可能无法高效支持以上行为主且多模态的 AI traffic。
text_en: Existing RAN mechanisms and QoS handling for Rel-18 and Rel-19 XR traffic may not efficiently support uplink-heavy and multi-modal AI traffic.

summary_zh: AI 应用和 transport protocols 的快速演进会导致 AI traffic patterns 难以预测且频繁变化。
text_en: The rapid evolution of AI applications and transport protocols leads to unpredictable and frequently changing AI traffic patterns.

summary_zh: Agentic AI traffic 需要持续连接，并要求时延和可靠性可预测。这会限制 UE 节能的机会。
text_en: Agentic AI traffic requires sustained connectivity with predictable latency and reliability, which limits UE opportunities to save power.

summary_zh: Mobile AI services 越来越多地运行于与同一用户关联的异构多设备之间，而非局限于单个 UE。
text_en: Mobile AI services increasingly operate across heterogeneous multi-devices associated with the same user, rather than being confined to a single UE.

summary_zh: 现有系统假设和业务模型主要以 UE 为中心，未能充分体现 multi-device AI services 的特征与需求。
text_en: Existing system assumptions and traffic models are largely UE-centric and do not fully capture the characteristics and requirements of multi-device AI services.

summary_zh: 6G mobile AI 聚焦 AI-native communication mechanisms，包括通过 tokenizer localized deployment 实现 token communication、以 tokens 作为最小传输单元并直接连接下游 AI 应用处理 AI traffic。另一类是基于 AI codec 的 AI source compression traffic service，例如 TR 22.870 中的 Grace。
text_en: 6G mobile AI focuses on the  AI-native communication mechanisms,  including token communication by tokenizer localized deployment, using tokens as the minimum transmission unit and directly connecting to downstream AI application processing AI traffic. Another type is the AI source compression traffic service based on AI codec, e.g. Grace in TR 22.870.

summary_zh: 作为 5G-A R20 AI traffic 的 Chatbot 通常使用非常短的数据包，包括 data packets 和 ACK packets。
text_en: Chatbot, as a 5G-A R20 AI traffic, typically use very short data packet sizes, including both data packets and ACK packets.

summary_zh: TR 22.870 中的 GenAI services 具有 QoS-dynamic 和 delay-sensitive 特性。数据突发可能周期性或非周期性到达，具有高数据速率和变化的数据量。
text_en: GenAI services as provided in the TR 22.870 are QoS-dynamic and delay-sensitive. The data burst may arrive periodically or a-periodically with high data rate and varying volumes.

summary_zh: 评估结果显示，tokenized AI codec traffic 具有 error-tolerance：并非所有 tokens 都需要正确传输。不同 tokens 的 transmission reliability requirement（例如 token error rate）也不同。
text_en:
The evaluation results given in this contribution and [3][4] show the following features for the (tokenized) AI codec traffic:
	Error-tolerance: Not all tokens need to be transmitted correctly.
	Importance: Different tokens have different transmission reliability requirement (e.g. token error rate)

summary_zh: RAN#110 同意，RAN 域内关于 AI traffic characteristics 的工作应集中在一处，由 RAN2 主导，以避免碎片化和重复，并听取 SA4 对 AI traffic characteristics 的反馈。
text_en: RAN#110 agreed that RAN is to “ensure that any work on AI traffic characteristics in the RAN domain takes place in one place only (led by RAN2) to avoid fragmentation and duplication with feedback from SA4 on AI traffic characteristics”.

summary_zh: Tokenized AI communication 引入独特复杂性。若缺少 SA4 的基础 media framework，可能导致碎片化设计，无法恰当考虑 source files 的分解方式。
text_en: Tokenized AI communication introduces unique complexities. Proceeding without the foundational media framework from SA4 could lead to a fragmented design that fails to properly account for how these source files are decomposed.

summary_zh: 目前尚不清楚 tokenized AI traffic 与 non-tokenized AI traffic 是否具有不同的业务特征。
text_en: It is not clear whether tokenized AI traffic and non-tokenized AI traffic have different traffic characteristics.

summary_zh: Mobile AI traffic 涵盖 conversational interactions、agentic/task-execution workflows 等多种服务类型；conversational services 可通过 text、image 和 video 等多种模态实现。目前最普遍的是 text-based conversational LLM（chatbot-style）traffic。
text_en: Mobile AI traffic spans multiple service types including conversational interactions, agentic/task-execution workflows, etc. Within conversational services, interactions may be realized across multiple modalities, namely, text, image, and video. Among these, text-based conversational LLM (chatbot-style) traffic is currently the most prevalent.

summary_zh: 在保持复杂度处于合理低水平的同时，构建能忠实体现 conversational、multi-turn GenAI traffic 的业务模型并非易事。
text_en: It is a non-trivial task to develop a traffic model that faithfully captures conversational, multi-turn GenAI traffic while keeping the complexity at a reasonably low level.

summary_zh: Conversational GenAI traffic model 应与现有 3GPP traffic models 一致，并采用既有统计方法表示 packet inter-arrival times 和 packet/burst sizes 等关键特征。
text_en: A traffic model for conversational GenAI traffic should be consistent with existing 3GPP traffic models, leveraging established statistical methods to represent key characteristics such as packet inter-arrival times and packet/burst sizes.

summary_zh: 为支持忠实且实用的实现，模型宜为单向，同时考虑相反方向；模型应可配置为分别生成 UL 或 DL flows 的 traffic。
text_en: To facilitate a faithful and practical implementation, it is desirable for the model to be unidirectional while keeping the opposite direction in consideration, i.e., configurable to generate traffic separately for UL or DL flows.

summary_zh: 现有 3GPP traffic models（如 FTP models 和 XR model）无法体现 conversational GenAI traffic 的突发、多轮交互模式。
text_en: Existing 3GPP traffic models, e.g. FTP models and XR model do not capture the bursty, multi-turn interaction pattern of conversational GenAI traffic.

summary_zh: RAN2 确认 mobile AI traffic 可大致分为两类：实时流量（如 conversational audio、augmented reality）和非实时流量（UE 与 server 间交换 text、image、audio/video clips 等对象）。
RAN2 采用为 XR 开发的 traffic models，作为 real-time mobile AI traffic 的基线。
text_en: RAN2 adopt the traffic models developed for XR as the baseline for real-time mobile AI traffic.

summary_zh: Non-real-time mobile AI traffic 可建模为使用 HTTP 和 TCP/QUIC 的 eMBB flow，具有更高 UL load、更多短连接和较小但灵活的 delay budget。
text_en:
Non-real-time mobile AI traffic can be modeled as eMBB flow using HTTP and TCP/QUIC, with higher UL load, more short-lived connections, and small but flexible delay budget.
-	Vivo asks how to determine the real time vs. non-real time and we understand that most traffic is non-real time.   Qualcomm thinks that conversational is real-time.
-	Nokia thinks that there are applications that use both and the real challenge is what the application will do and haven’t been able to categorize and we aren’t sure how to identify what the UL will do.  Qualcomm acknowledges that within the same application the traffic does change from time to time but there are proprietary mechanisms to determine the type of traffic.
-	ATT thinks that in reality the real-time traffic is not real real time they are still best effort traffic.   The traditional eMBB modelling is not sufficient.   Qualcomm explains that translation service has to have a strict delay requirement otherwise it is not very useful.     Theoretically eMBB models can be a good starting point.
-	XR type of traffic would it have congestion control and rate adaptation.   Qualcomm thinks that it depends from use case to use case.
-	Lenovo asks what are the impact of short lived connections in RAN2.   Qualcomm explains that by short it means shorter that the usual connection and one of the areas for us to look at is how to meet the latency of this applications.
Noted

summary_zh: 确认 R20 mobile AI 讨论（也可能适用于 6G AI 讨论）的流量特征：聚焦非实时服务的 uplink traffic；application layer packet 可分成多个 packet 并分批到达 AS buffer；mobile AI service 是具有 latency requirements 的交互式服务。
text_en:
Confirm the following traffic characteristics for R20 mobile AI discussion, which could also be applicable for 6G AI traffic discussion:
(a)	Focus on the uplink traffic for the non-real-time mobile AI service
(b)	Application layer packet for mobile AI could be fragmented to multiple packets and arrive in the AS buffer in multiple batches
(c)	Mobile AI service is interactive service with latency requirements

summary_zh: 研究基于上述流量特征的 latency reduction enhancements。讨论指出服务的时延与抖动需求各异，且可讨论 end-to-end latency。
text_en:
Study the enhancements for latency reduction based on the traffic characteristics above.
-	Nokia is concerned that if we focus on non-real time we will exclude the rest of the market.    Huawei explains that for real time the service cares about latency and jitter but for non-real time it has to be reliable but not as much about latency.   If we do any enhancements we should focus on single modality.   We can’t exclude because even a real time service is doing some non-real time and the RAN should be able to deal with highly dynamic traffic.
-	Apple also agrees that latency is the most important but what we are observing it is not about the air interface but rather the inference in the cloud.   We should understand the type of latency budget and does it really matter from user experience point of view if we reduce air latency by 50%.   Huawei explains that if the segment is very large then the packet has to be segmented and the air interface latency is a big component.  We can also define and discuss the end-to-end latency.

summary_zh: L2 支持具有不同数据量和 inter-burst interval 的 delay-bound data bursts，并以资源高效方式处理，例如避免过度配置 radio resources。
text_en:
L2 supports delay-bound data bursts of varying volumes and inter-burst interval in a resource efficient manner (e.g., without over-provisioning of radio resources).
-	Nokia thinks this is a good approach as it doesn’t focus on specific services.
-	Xiaomi asks what is the difference between PDU set in XR and what is the impact and expect the UE to do, provide assistance information.   Interdigital explains that the system can be designed that the burst information is provided so the network is aware of the bursts.
-	Qualcomm asks 1) at which layer is the burst defined and the delay bound and 2) how do you define delay bound budget on objects given how the codecs work.    Interdigital thinks that it is related to service awareness and how we can identify the bursts inside and that can be done via implementation or API (not necessarily by standards means).   For the delay budget we need to understand how the information can be made available.
-	Oppo asks what you have in mind for delay bound.   Interdigital thinks that the delay bound is referring mainly to the UL burst as DL is more to network in the end.
-	Lenovo explains that for XR Rel-19 we provided some bursts information from the network to the gNB.  Are we envisioning something similar.  Itnerdigital explains that it could be one way.

summary_zh: 记录了 Mobile AI 传输特征供 6GR 研究进一步考虑，包括首个 DL 响应包及每个 AI task session 的 UL 上传和 DL 响应需要低时延，以及 UL/DL 可变的 packet loss tolerance。原文还记录了首包延迟可能来自 application layer，以及 AS 如何识别首包的问题。

-	low latency transmission for first response packet, at least for DL

summary_zh: RAN2 同意研究 Mobile AI 流量的 UL heavy、突发且对时延敏感（同一应用内时延要求可变）、round trip delay 重要，以及同一应用内流量特征高度可变等特征，并分别考虑 UL 和 DL。RAN2 将研究 UL 和 scheduler 支持这些特征/要求所需的机制，向 SA4 通报假设并等待其 tokenized traffic 讨论进展后再进一步提问。
text_en:
RAN2 is asked to study mechanisms to accommodate burst and non-periodic traffic patterns, multi-modality, enhanced reliability, strict end-to-end latency and round-trip time for AI traffic beyond existing 5G functionalities for XR.
Noted
[2 min]
Discussion
-	Ericsson thinks that at least we should highlight what is different from eMBB.
-	Huawei thinks that we need to look at the aspects that will impact our L2 design and classifying real time vs. non real time.
-	Mediatek thinks it is a difficult task to predict the future but we see some characteristics, like it is UL heavy, bursty and delay bound is difficult to achieve.
-	ZTE thinks that we need to consider UL and DL separately and the way it was proposed in interdigital proposal makes sense and the problem is that they are variable inter-arrival points and we need to understand how the RAN will know.  ZTE asks if the application layers map to different layer protocol and maybe we can identify them.   The real difference is the fast switching.
-	LG also thinks that we should focus on the difference between XR, what’s important is to support the mix of the two services, burstiness is one characteristic and varying delaying bound in the same application and error tolerance mixture.  CMCC agrees
-	ATT has observed that there is a large type of traffic that is best effort.   Some application may be UL heavy and some not.   We cannot say that this looks exactly like XR.
-	Ericsson thinks that we should consider thinks like congestion control and we would go down in rate which wasn’t the case in XR.
-	Apple thinks that round trip delay is important and one thing that is different that time to generate the content is highly variable depending on the task.
-	Vivo thinks we need to study which part for XR will be reused as starting point.   Vivo thikns that companies have different understanding of real time vs. non-real time.
-	Futurewei thinks that the delay is not as bad as XR and the main challenge is UL and aperiodicity and the switching.  The short lived connection is not part of the characteristics.
-	Nokia thinks we have 3 aspects 1) SA4 should tell us what the traffic looks like 2) we need to understand what mechanism we need to deal with AI traffic 3) how we apply this mechanisms and whether we need to go below the QoS flow and the current mechanisms we can’t distinguish.
-	Qualcomm thinks that the round trip delay is not only dependent on RAN2 as it depends on many things.
-	Lenovo thinks that the key question is the UE aware of these characteristics and SA2 may also need to be involved.
-	Ericsson as part of the study would like to understand the benefits from the scheduler perspective.
-	Xiaomi indicates that a single application can have multiple connections, up to 100 connection.   Qualcomm thinks that there is nothing new compared to today.   ZTE thinks that there is no impact and we just see multiple QoS flow.
-	Meta is not sure about the rate adaptation as this is not unique to mobile AI.   Ericsson thinks that variability results from code rate changes.  Mediatek thinks that rate adaptation is important.
-	Nokia thinks UL is more important to start in RAN2 as DL is more a network aspects.  ZTE thinks that this information  needs to be provided to gNB from CN.
-	Huawei thinks SA2 is responsible for QoS requirements (variable characteristics, delay etc) and SA4 is more responsible for codecs (traces that show packet size, delay budget, packet success rate and packet arrival interval).
-	Interdigital thinks that we can wait for SA2 until we have QoS discussion and understand what we want.  Nokia agrees and for SA4 they are in charge of the traffic characterics.
For traffic modelling, RAN2 is responsible for traffic characteristics and will provide the characteristics to RAN1
Agreements on mobile AI
To study AI mobile traffic RAN2 will consider the following
-	UL heavy
-	data bursts and delay bound/sensitive (varying delay requirement within same application)
-	round trip delay is important
-	highly variable traffic characteristics within same applications (e.g. bursts, volume, delay, inter-arrival time, reliability, connection duration, etc).
RAN2 will study what is needed for the UL and scheduler to support such type of characteristics/requirements.   Consider UL and DL separately.
Notify SA4 of our assumptions and ask for feedback if needed
Wait for SA4 to progress tokenized traffic discussion before we ask further questions.
For 5GA R20 discussion, take the agreements above as a baseline.  Focus should be on UL, avoid SA2 impacts and discuss further which requirements should be considered.

summary_zh: 将 text-based conversational GenAI traffic model 作为 6G AI/ML mobile traffic evaluations 的起点。

summary_zh: 定义 conversational GenAI mobile AI traffic model，采用单向 UL/DL 形式，分别规定 UL 和 DL traffic profiles，并由共享的 session/turn process 管理。
text_en: Define a conversational GenAI model for mobile AI traffic in a unidirectional UL/DL form, where UL and DL traffic profiles are specified separately but governed by a shared session/turn process

summary_zh: conversational GenAI model 由 mean turns/session、mean think time、prompt 和 response size distributions、first-byte delay distribution，以及 streaming chunk/cadence parameters 参数化。
text_en: The conversational GenAI model is parameterized with the following parameters: mean turns/session, mean think time, prompt size distribution, response size distribution, first-byte delay distribution, and streaming chunk/cadence parameters.

summary_zh: conversational GenAI model 的 baseline evaluations 使用 geometric、exponential、shifted lognormal/lognormal with truncation 等默认统计分布族，参数保持可配置。
text_en: Default statistical distribution families, e.g., geometric, exponential, shifted lognormal/lognormal with truncation, are used for baseline evaluations of conversational GenAI model, with parameters left configurable.

summary_zh: 模型可选地增加 multimodal extension，并沿用相同的 session/turn framework。音频和视频建模为分块字节流，包括 audio frames 和 video segments。
text_en:
Optionally, a multimodal extension can be added to the model. The multimodal extension reuses the same session/turn framework, with audio/video modeled as chunked byte streams (audio frames, video segments).

summary_zh: RAN1 已就 extended XR 的 traffic model 达成一致。
text_en: RAN1 has reached the traffic model for extended XR.

summary_zh: R18 XR 引入基于 FEC characteristic 的 QoS level information，用于粗略指示 QoS flow 中的 PDU Set 是否具有 integrity requirement。
text_en: R18 XR introduced QoS level information based on the FEC characteristic, to coarsely indicate whether the PDU Set from the QoS flow exhibits the integrity requirement.

summary_zh: 在 FEC-assisted immersive communication 中，只有当缺失 PDUs 的比例超过预定义阈值时，PDU set 才会解码失败。
text_en: In FEC-assisted immersive communication, an PDU set can only fail to be decoded if the ratio of missing PDUs exceeds a predefined threshold.

summary_zh: 原文指出，Legacy DG/CG 对 haptic data 的传输可能效率不高，因为其 PDB 严格、突发大小不可预测且周期性不规则。
text_en: Legacy DG/CG may be not efficient for the transmission of haptic data which have stringent PDB, unpredictable burst size and irregular periodicity.

summary_zh: 原文指出，haptic data 的传输可能影响 video 和 audio 的传输，并降低资源效率。
text_en: The transmission of haptic data may impact the transmission of video and audio, and decrease the resource efficiency.

summary_zh: 原文指出，在现有 scheduling mechanism 下，存在 haptic traffic 时网络容量可能下降。
text_en: Under the existing scheduling mechanism, the network capacity may be decreased if there is haptic traffic.

summary_zh: 原文指出，E2E latency 对确保 IC services 的良好用户体验至关重要。
text_en: The E2E latency is critical for ensuring good user experience in IC services.

summary_zh: 原文指出，multi-modal traffic 的 immersive communication 被视为 6GR 中有前景的新兴应用之一。在 NR 中，尚未充分处理 multi-modal communication session 内多个 flows（如 haptic、audio 和 video）的传输协调，包括 intra-UE 和 inter-UE 场景。
text_en: Immersive communication with multi-modal traffic is foreseen as one of the promising emerging applications in 6GR, while coordination of the transmission among multiple flows (e.g., haptic, audio and video) within a multi-modal communication session, including intra-UE or inter-UE cases, has not been well addressed in NR.

summary_zh: 原文指出，作为 immersive communication 组成部分的 haptic 具有低时延、高可靠性、低 jitter 和非周期性流量到达等特征。NR 尚未充分评估 haptic，也未充分处理 haptic traffic 的高效传输。
text_en: Haptic as an integral part of immersive communication, which is characterized by low latency, high reliability, low jitter and aperiodic traffic arrival, has not been thoroughly evaluated and the efficient transmission of haptic traffic has not been well addressed in NR.

summary_zh: 原文指出，运行于 lightweight glasses 和 AI capable UEs 的新兴服务对节能和 QoS 有并发要求，例如较低时延和较高数据速率。
text_en: The emerging services running on lightweight glasses and AI capable UEs impose concurrent requirements for power saving and QoS such as comparably low latency and high data rates.

summary_zh: 原文指出，mobile AI service flow 的流量特征和要求可能在不同突发之间及随时间显著变化。
text_en: The traffic characteristics and requirements of mobile AI service flow may vary significantly across different bursts and over time.

summary_zh: 原文指出，涉及 NAS/NG signalling 的传统 QoS adaptation procedures 不适用于 QoS 要求快速变化的 AI/XR applications。
text_en: Traditional QoS adaptation procedures involving NAS/NG signalling are not well suited for AI/XR applications that involve rapid changes of QoS requirements.

summary_zh: 原文指出，NR QoS framework 的一个问题是，它依赖第三方提供启动流程所需的 SLA information。
text_en: One issue of the NR QoS framework is that it relies on third-party to provide the SLA information necessary to initiate the process.

summary_zh: 6GR QoS framework 应支持 user-operator 直接交互，并尽量减少对 external parties 的依赖。
text_en: 6GR QoS framework should enable direct user-operator interaction, minimizing reliance on external parties.

summary_zh: 除 GBR 和 non-GBR 外，可以定义一种新的 QoS flow type，为一系列 QoS parameters 提供保证。
text_en: In addition to GBR and non-GBR, a new QoS flow type could be defined which can provide guarantee over a range of QoS parameters.

summary_zh: 负载下的 best-effort uplink scheduling 会导致过高的 burst latency；缺少 burst-aware 或 QoS mechanisms 时，与 continuous uplink traffic 的竞争会显著延迟 burst completion。
text_en: Best-effort uplink scheduling results in excessive burst latency under load indicating that contention with continuous uplink traffic significantly delays burst completion in the absence of burst-aware or QoS mechanisms.

summary_zh: High-priority QoS 可降低 burst latency，但会牺牲 radio resource efficiency，使 uplink resources 接近饱和，并且难以扩展到 multi-UE 或 high-load 环境。
text_en: High-priority QoS minimizes burst latency at the expense of radio resource efficiency i.e., at the cost of near-saturation of uplink resources and hard to scale in a multi-UE or high-load environment.

summary_zh: RAN-level service awareness 可超越传统 GBR-based QoS approaches 的限制，为具有异构且高度动态 traffic characteristics 的 AI-based 和/或 immersive applications 提高 radio resource utilization 效率。
text_en: Support for RAN-level service awareness can go beyond the limits of traditional GBR-based QoS approaches in terms of efficient radio resource utilization for AI-based and/or immersive applications with heterogeneous, highly dynamic traffic characteristics.

summary_zh: 在 immersive XR 等部分 6G use cases 中，同一 traffic flow 内的 packets 不一定具有相同的 reliability target。
text_en: In some 6G use cases such as immersive XR, the packets on the same traffic flow do not necessarily have the same reliability target.

summary_zh: 在 Generative AI 和 tethering-based Immersive XR 等部分 6G use cases 中，air interface delay budget 可动态变化，以满足 end-to-end latency requirement。
text_en: In some 6G use cases such as Generative AI and tethering-based Immersive XR, the air interface delay budget may be dynamically changed to ensure the end-to-end latency requirement can be satisfied.

summary_zh: 当具有不同 in-sequence delivery requirement 的多个 traffic flows 映射到同一 DRB 时，接收端共用的 reordering timer 可能导致部分 packets 被不必要地延迟。
text_en: When multiple traffic flows with different in-sequence delivery requirement are mapped to the same DRB, some packets may be unnecessarily delayed due to a common reordering timer at the receiver side.

summary_zh: NR 的 QoS and traffic classification framework 通用且灵活，可适用于许多不同类型的 traffic。待 SA2 提供进一步输入前，RAN2 可假设沿用同一 framework。
text_en: The QoS and traffic classification framework in NR is general and flexible to many different types of traffic. RAN2 can assume the same framework applies pending further input from SA2.

summary_zh: legacy QoS and resource management framework 可能无法高效支持 mobile AI、XR 和 immersive communications 等 6G applications；这些应用会根据 user behavior、application context、link quality 等改变 traffic 和 QoS requirements。
text_en: The legacy QoS and resource management framework may not be able to efficiently support 6G applications such as mobile AI, XR and immersive communications, which can change their traffic and QoS requirements based on user behavior, application context, link quality, etc.

-	Nokia thinks that for FEC what SA2 has observed that if you drop the packet the receiver can interpret it as an error and think it is congestion and tx will increase coding.    Huawei thinks this is for the case where you know there are some redundant packets and anyways there is congestion that’s why we need to drop.  Ericsson agrees with Nokia.  Interdigital explains that SA4 has concluded that it is useful to have FEC and in case of congestion it would be ok to use that information on prioritizing what is dropped and it is ok with the application as there are congestion.   If there is no congestion they would need to work further to see how to tell the tx.   Qualcomm thinks that it is useful but not visible to RAN and it should be possible for RAN to provide better support.  For FEC RAN can do more and potentially diversify how the packets are treated as today we treat them the same.
-	Ericsson thinks in RAN2 we discussed and concluded it wasn’t very useful.  Huawei thinks it was because of lack of time.   Mediatek thinks we can study but we may conclude that it is not really necessary.

Huawei thinks that can be a solution but the initial assessment is that current CG is not sufficient to satisfy haptics.

R2-2600960	Considerations on RAN-level QoS,QoE framework and Service-awareness RAN	CMCC	discussion	Rel-20	FS_6G_Radio
Observation 1a: The high asymmetry of GenAI traffic, coupled with its stringent requirements for low-latency uplink transmission, may necessitate the 6G User Plane to support fine-grained, application-assisted traffic identification. The error tolerance and importance differences of AI-native traffic may affect the UP's retransmission and packet discard.
Observation 1b: Immersive and multi-modal service generates heterogeneous, bursty, and tightly synchronized traffic with strict latency and reliability demands, thus exceeding the capability of current 5G QoS frameworks to provide consistent E2E experience across modalities.
Observation 1c: Haptic and tactile service generates frequent small packets at high update rates with ultra-low latency, very high reliability requirements, and aperiodic timing due to the inherent unpredictability of human behaviour, presenting unique traffic characteristics.
Observation 1d: Holographic communication traffic can be characterized by sustained high throughput with correlated homogeneous multi-view flows and stringent flow synchronization requirements, challenging existing transport and QoS mechanisms in RAN.
Observation 1e: Connected and cooperative autonomous driving service generate mixed traffic with stringent latency and reliability requirements for safety-critical control data and occasional high-throughput payloads, challenging the static QoS models for 6G.
Observation 1f: Large-scale industrial automation traffic exhibits periodic high-frequency control loops, event-driven bursts, and stringent reliability needs, requiring communication patterns that current 5G QoS mechanisms cannot fully guarantee across dynamically varying loads.

∙	Asymmetry data stringent latency requirement but capable of error tolerance,

∙	Multiple heterogenous/homogenous data flow, tightly synchronized flows and stringent latency and reliability requirements.

summary_zh: RAN2 可考虑三种为同一 traffic flow 中的 packet 动态提供差异化 radio treatment 的方案：QoS flow 映射多个 DRB、DRB 关联多个 RLC/LCH，或 DRB 配置多组参数并由发送端选择。
text_en:
RAN2 can consider the following options to dynamically provide differentiated radio treatments for packets on one traffic flow:
	Option 1: A QoS flow may be associated to multiple DRBs, and the transmitter can select the DRB to transmit a packet from this QoS flow.
	Option 2: A DRB may be associated to multiple RLCs/LCHs, and the transmitter can select the RLC/LCH to transmit a packet from this DRB.
	Option 3: A DRB may be configured with multiple sets of parameters, and the transmitter can switch the parameter set to transmit a packet from this DRB.

summary_zh: Contention-based UL transmission 的 upper-layer design 有若干方面取决于 physical layer designs。
text_en: Several aspects in the upper-layer design for contention-based UL transmission depend on physical layer designs.

summary_zh: 缺少 CB PUSCH 专用统计信息（如 average collision ratio）时，难以准确评估其性能或配置最优性。
text_en: Without CB PUSCH-specific statistics like average collision ratio, it is challenging to accurately evaluate its performance or configuration optimality.

summary_zh: 不同 traffic models 对 CB PUSCH collision rates 的影响不同，因此模拟需要采用多种模型。
text_en: Traffic models will affect CB PUSCH collision rates differently, reinforcing the need for diverse models in simulations.

summary_zh: UE 数量与 CB-PUSCH resource pool 大小共同直接影响 CB-PUSCH 资源上的碰撞率。
text_en: The number of UEs, together with the CB-PUSCH resource pool size, directly affects the collision ratio on CB-PUSCH resources.

summary_zh: 单个 UL data burst 中，UE 可发送多次 SR 和 BSR 报告以指示 data SDU 到达；这会增加 signaling overhead 和 scheduling delay。
text_en: The UE can transmit multiple SR and BSR reports to indicate data SDU arrivals within a single UL data burst, resulting in increased signaling overhead and scheduling delay.

summary_zh: 具有不同 service requirements 的 flows 可通过不同的 HARQ transmission parameters 获得更好的服务，例如 MCS 和重传次数。
text_en: Flows with different service requirements can be better served with different HARQ transmission parameters (e.g. MCS, number of retransmissions)

summary_zh: 由于 XR 和 mobile AI 等 delay sensitive traffic 增多，NR 中的 LCP procedure 可能不足以支持 6G 中更多样化的 traffic。
text_en: The LCP procedure in NR may not be sufficient in supporting more diverse traffic in 6G, due to increased presence of delay sensitive traffic such as XR and mobile AI.

summary_zh: application context awareness 和 adaptive QoS 等新的 6G use cases 要求 LCP 比 NR 更具适应性。
text_en: New 6G use cases such as application context awareness and adaptive QoS require LCP to be more adaptive than NR.

summary_zh: 5G 的“two-phase” LCP process 具有明确结构：第一阶段确保 mandatory 和 deterministic QoS，第二阶段处理 best-effort resource optimization。
text_en: The 5G "two-phase" LCP process provides a clear structure: the first phase ensures mandatory and deterministic QoS, and the second phase handles best-effort resource optimization.

summary_zh: 依赖 static priority 和 PBR configurations 的 legacy LCP mechanism，在处理动态 traffic profiles 和 context-aware QoS requirements 时不够灵活。
text_en: The legacy LCP mechanism, relying on static priority and PBR configurations, leads to inflexibility in handling dynamic traffic profiles and context-aware QoS requirements.

summary_zh: 提议向 RAN1 征询 contention-based UL transmission 的物理层问题，包括冲突时 UE 的识别、冲突后的重传处理及 payload size 范围。讨论中对仿真范围和职责有不同意见，并提及资源效率、blind decoding complexity、端到端时延以及 SR 作为评估基线或回退机制等事项。
text_en:
Ask input from RAN1 on the following physical-layer aspects of contention-based UL transmission:
-	how UEs are identified when there is a contention;
-	how retransmission after a contention is handled;
-	Range of payload size. 
[3 mins]
Noted
Discussion
-	Qualcomm is concerned to have RAN2 run a full blown simulation.  It is common sense the contention based has the benefits and drawback.    ZTE agrees with Qualcomm and we should cooperate with RAN1 as early as possible, payload size.   IT would be good to have some comparison.  Ericsson thinks that we need to consider resource efficiency and blind decoding complexity.   RAN2 should do this analysis especially for end-to-end latency.   We can just agree to some high level assumptions.
-	ESA explains that we introduced CB for msg3 in IoT NTN.   We did a simulation in RAN2 but we can coordinate a bit with RAN1.
-	Nokia thinks that we have some simulation activities and the traffic model would impact and not sure whether we have the expertise.   Interdigital thinks RAN1 should be involved for some aspects but it doesn’t mean they are the only group.
-	Xiaomi thinks that RAN2 can’t do such simulations.    Ericsson doesn’t think they can model protocol aspects and end-to-end considerations.
-	Apple thinks that full scale simulation may not be needed but RAN1 should be involved.
-	Vivo thinks that even the methodology needs to be done by RAN1.
-	LG thinks that the simulations should be in RAN2 as it is related to QoS but RAN1 input is needed.
-	Mediatek thinks that the drawback can be controlled by the network.   RAN1 can provide some input but only what RAN2 determines needs.
-	Samsung thinks that there are other ways like finer granularity CG.   Sharp thinks we can start the simulation to at least check if CB has clear benefits and consider the other schemes.   Vivo thinks that RAN1 is discussing other SR based solutions.
-	ZTE thinks that the one thing missing in LTE is NTN which has long RTT times.
-	Qualcomm thinks that if we use both SR like and CB based scheme, there is no point of doing evaluation.
-	ZTE thinks that we’d have to understand what things we’d need to do to make it more efficient
-	Ericsson thinks that we shouldn’t have two solutions.  Mediatek agrees.

The NW can triggered the HARQ retransmission whenever it wants, so there is not RAN2 reasons for this.   LG agrees as the UE doesn’t know why the network dropped the packet.  Huawei agrees too and the robustness of HARQ robustness is RAN1 issue.

summary_zh: 数据传输研究应覆盖 MO 和 MT 场景下的 long-cycle、delay insensitive 服务及 bursty、delay-sensitive 流量，并考虑 signaling overhead、power saving 和 latency requirement。提案列出 6G RRC Inactive 的功能，包括保存 UE AS context、使用 identifier 定位上下文、通过 Paging 到达 UE、基于 UE 的 mobility，以及尽可能与 RRC Idle 对齐的系统信息获取等；该提案被 noted。
text_en:
1	For data transfer, the study should consider both long-cycle, delay insensitive services (e.g. low end IoT) and bursty and delay-sensitive traffic, for both MO and MT cases.   Signaling overhead, power saving, latency requirement should be taken into account.
Functionality of inactive state/sub-state
R2-2600248	RRC Inactive state for 6G	Ericsson	discussion	Rel-20
=> Revised in R2-2601127
R2-2601127	RRC Inactive state for 6G	Ericsson, LG Uplus	discussion	Rel-20
Proposal 1	6G RRC Inactive supports the following functionality:
•	UE AS context stored in UE and network enabling fast transition to RRC connected state with reduced signalling
•	An identifier (such as I-RNTI or similar) used to identify and locate the stored UE context
•	Paging used to reach the UE at incoming DL data/signalling (FFS if its RAN or CN paging)
•	UE based mobility based on cell selection/re-selection as aligned as much possible with RRC Idle
•	System information acquisition and other procedures (e.g. PLMN selection) also aligned as much as possible with RRC Idle
Noted
R2-2600942	Discussion on 6G RRC states	CMCC	discussion	Rel-20	FS_6G_Radio

summary_zh: 6G Inactive/sub-state 支持 UE 和 RAN 两侧保存 UE AS context，并使用 signaling 在下行数据或信令到达时联系 UE，以及使用 identifier 定位已存储的 UE context。还支持 UE based mobility，UE 无需每次切换小区时通知网络或报告测量；是否需要及如何实现 pre-configuration 增强仍需进一步研究。
text_en:
6G Inactive/sub-state supports the following functionality
1	UE AS context in both UE and RAN
2	Signaling used to reach the UE at incoming DL data/signalling (FFS details)
3	An identifier used to identify/verify (if needed) and locate the stored UE context
4	UE based mobility is supported.  The UE doesn’t need to notify the network every time it changes cells and it doesn’t need to report measurements.   Study further whether the enhancement with pre-configuration is needed and how it works.

summary_zh: 对于 periodic traffic，网络可以通过 C-DRX 处理。
text_en: For periodic traffic, network can handle it well using C-DRX.

summary_zh: 对于 bursty 但 non-delay-sensitive traffic，使用 C-DRX 或将 UE 转入 IDLE 没有严重问题。
text_en: For bursty but non-delay-sensitive traffic, there is no serious problem to use C-DRX or transfer the UE to IDLE.

summary_zh: 对于 bursty and delay-sensitive traffic，sub-state 或（增强的）INACTIVE 可能有用。
text_en: For “bursty and delay-sensitive” traffic, sub-state or (enhanced) INACTIVE could be useful.

summary_zh: bursty and delay-sensitive traffic 的具体场景及其未来市场需求规模仍不明确。
text_en: What is the scenario with “bursty and delay-sensitive” traffic and how much demand fosr the scenario in future market is still unclear.

summary_zh: RRC_INACTIVE 可降低 uplink-triggered small data 的开销，但下行受 paging cycle（不小于 320ms）以及 SDT mechanism 的数据大小和持续时间限制。因此，它难以满足要求约百毫秒时延的 bursty services。
text_en: RRC_INACTIVE can reduce the overhead for uplink-triggered small data. However, downlink is limited by the paging cycle(no less than 320ms) and the constraints on data size and duration in the SDT mechanism. Therefore, it is difficult to meet the needs of bursty services that require latency around hundred-millisecond level.

summary_zh: connected sub-state 可通过 L1/L2 signaling 实现快速转换，使网络和 UE 利用 traffic gaps 节能，同时满足约百毫秒级 QoS 要求。
text_en: The connected sub-state enables fast transitions via L1/L2 signaling, allowing network/UE to use traffic gaps for energy saving while still meeting QoS requirements around hundred-millisecond level.

summary_zh: 在 5G 中，RNA、RNA update procedure 和 RAN-paging 的使用，都是为支持移动性和 UE 可达性而产生的要求，以支持新的 RAN-managed RRC_INACTIVE state 提供 signaling 优化并尽量减少对 core network 的影响。
text_en: In 5G, the use of RNA, RNA update procedure and RAN-paging are all results of having to support mobility and UE-reachability in order to support this new RAN-managed RRC_INACTIVE state providing signalling optimizations and to minimize impacts to core network.

summary_zh: 在 5G 中，引入 RRC_INACTIVE 状态避免了在 RRC_IDLE 中管理 UE AS context，也避免了在 RRC_CONNECTED 中采用单独的 UE-controlled mobility 方案。
text_en: In 5G, introduction of RRC_INACTIVE state avoided having to manage UE AS context in RRC_IDLE and avoided having a separate UE-controlled mobility solution in RRC_CONNECTED.

summary_zh: 5G RRC_INACTIVE 中，在 RAN paging 之外增加 CN paging，以提高 UE reachability 的可靠性。
text_en: For 5G RRC_INACTIVE, CN paging in addition to RAN paging is to increase the reliability of UE reachability.

summary_zh: RNA concept、RNA update procedure、RNA-level UE tracking、RAN paging 和 RRC_INACTIVE 期间的 UE context transfer 都是支持 RRC_INACTIVE 状态的密切相关概念。原文指出这些事项影响 RAN2、RAN3 和 SA2，需要协调研究。
text_en: RNA concept, RNA update procedure, RNA-level UE tracking, RAN paging and UE context transfer while in RRC_INACTIVE are all closely related concepts to support RRC_INACTIVE state impacting RAN2, RAN3 and SA2 that requires a coordinated study.

summary_zh: 6G RRC-INACTIVE UE 需要类似 I-RNTI 的标识符，其定义涉及跨工作组依赖，可能需要 RAN3 的初步分析。
text_en: I-RNTI like identification is required for 6G RRC-INACTIVE UEs and the identifier definition has cross workgroup dependancy and initial analysis from RAN3 may be required.

summary_zh: UE based mobility 的细节仍未确定，包括是否基于 cell (re)selection 或其他 mobility mechanisms。
text_en: The details of UE based mobility is still open, i.e., whether it is supported based on cell (re)selection or other forms of mobility mechanisms.

summary_zh: RAN2 将先澄清 sub-state 或 (enhanced) INACTIVE 的目标场景，再讨论解决方案细节。
text_en: RAN2 to clarify the target scenario for sub-state or (enhanced) INACTIVE before discussing details of the solutions.

summary_zh: RAN2 将确认 sub-state 或 (enhanced) INACTIVE 是否适用于 bursty 和 delay-sensitive traffic，并研究相关流量场景。对于该方案是否适用于 UL 和 DL，原文仅记录了 ZTE 的提问。
text_en:
RAN2 to confirm that the sub-state or (enhanced) INACTIVE is useful for bursty and delay-sensitive traffic, and to study what is the scenario with the traffic.
-	ZTE asks if this is applicable to both UL and DL.
Noted

summary_zh: RAN2 将研究两类场景：针对 long-cycle、delay-insensitive services，简化并增强 RRC_INACTIVE state 并结合 SDT mechanism；针对高频、短包间隔的 burst traffic，研究 RRC_CONNECTED sub-state。讨论中主席提醒聚焦于仅引入 1 state/sub-state 的解决方案。
text_en:
RAN2 studies RRC states in two different scenarios:
For long-cycle, delay-insensitive services, focus on simplifying and enhancing the RRC_INACTIVE state combined with the SDT mechanism;
For high-frequency burst traffic with short packet intervals(e.g., hundred-millisecond level), study RRC_CONNECTED sub-state.
Noted
Discussion
-	LG explain the long history and hopes that we can develop a useful inactive state.
-	Huawei thinks that we should study the two use cases - long-cycle, delay-insensitive services and high-frequency burst traffic with short packet.  Mediatek agrees that for data transfer we target low end IoT and we cover higher frequency burst traffic with efficient data transfer.
-	Fraunhofer thinks that we should cover periodic traffic
-	ZTE thinks that another target should be signaling overhead.
-	Qualcomm thinks power saving is important and wonders what is the difference with WUS.
-	Futurewei asks if we are considering having two solutions for these types of traffic.   Chair reminds everyone that we need to focus on solutions that only introduce 1 state/sub-state
-	Vivo and CATT thinks that bursty and delay insensitive.

summary_zh: Energy Efficient Sub-state 面向 RRC_CONNECTED 中无数据传输的场景，特征包括预配置 cell-list 及其配置、UE based mobility、通过 L1/L2 signaling 实现低状态转换时延、低 UP resumption latency，以及用于网络和 UE 节能的 UL/DL WUS。讨论说明无需 RRC message，并提到 L1/L2 可触发网络唤醒。
text_en:
The Energy Efficient Sub-state, applicable for scenarios with no data transmission in RRC_CONNECTED, which is characterized by:
•	A pre-configured cell-list and pre-configuration for the cells therein.
•	UE based mobility (e.g., cell reselection or conditional reselection similar to C-LTM).
•	Low state transition latency via L1/L2 signaling.
-	Interdigital asks how L1/L2 signaling provide low state transitioning or is it the pre-configuration/context that provides the low transitioning.   CMCC explains that this means that RRC message is not required.
-	Qualcomm asks if this is for both UL and DL.   CMCC explains that L1/L2 can trigger network to wake up.
-	ZTE asks whether this includes the security as you need security for state transition.
•	Low UP resumption latency.
•	UL/DL WUS for energy saving for both NW and UE.
-	CATT asks what is the meaning of no data transmission.  CMCC explains that in sub-state there is no need for data transmission.  Mediatek asks who determines there is no data transmission, like is there an inactivity timer.  CMCC explains that it is like C-DRX.
Noted
R2-2600543	RRC_INACTIVE state functionalities	Nokia	discussion	Rel-20	FS_6G_Radio

summary_zh: RAN2 将研究 6G 中的以下事项：RRC_INACTIVE 的 UE identification 选择、paging architecture 与 UE mobility handling 的交互、RRC_INACTIVE UE 跨 RAT 小区重选时的 RRC state 转换，以及 PLMN reselection。
text_en:
RAN2 to study the following areas in 6G: a) choice of UE identification in RRC_INACTIVE, b) interaction between paging architecture and UE mobility handling, c) RRC state transition upon inter-RAT cell reselection by RRC_INACTIVE UE, and, d) PLMN reselection by RRC_INACTIVE UE.
Noted

summary_zh: 将“NW-controlled UE based” mobility mechanism（如 CHO/C-LTM like cell switch）作为 6GR CONNECTED mode Substate 研究的候选方案。小区切换由 UE 根据 NW 提供的候选小区配置触发，切换后 UE 通知其已接入新小区。
text_en: Consider "NW-controlled UE based" mobility mechanism (e.g. CHO/C-LTM like cell switch) as a candidate solution in the study for 6GR Substate in CONNECTED mode, where the execution of cell switch is triggered by the UE based on candidate cell configurations by the NW and UE notifies its access to the new cell after cell switch.

summary_zh: CONNECTED mode 的 Sub-state 到数据交换的快速转换可由 UE 监测 NW 的 DL scheduling，或 UE 请求 NW scheduling 并监测 UL scheduling 来实现。讨论涉及连接态省电、UE based mobility、测量与报告，以及是否需要 UE 通知网络；相关机制仍有待研究。
text_en:
In the study on Sub-state in CONNECTED mode, the fast-transition from "Sub-state" (i.e. no on-going traffic) to data exchange can be performed as follows:
	UE wakes up and monitors its DL scheduling from the NW for the first DL data arrival; or
	UE requests NW scheduling and monitors UL scheduling from the NW for the first UL data arrival.
-	Vivo thinks that this seems to be more related to power saving in connected state.   Xiaomi thinks that if we have efficient power saving mode in connected we don’t need inactive.
-	Offino asks if we have Nw-controlled UE based mobility does this mean we need to have RAN requirements on the measurements etc.   Xiaomi thinks that we can reduce the frequency of reporting for the sub-state.
-	Ericsson asks if the UE informs the network.  Why do we need an sub-state this sounds like RRC connected.
-	Huawei thinks we have to solutions – CHO like and cell reselection like.
-	ZTE thinks that the fundamental difference is that for cell reselection the network doesn’t need to be made aware, for CHO is a handover.
-	Lenovo thinks that we are not enhancing anything that the UE has to inform the network everytime it changes.  Also RRC connected needs RRM.
-	Nokia thinks that whether it is sub-state or inactive the main power saving benefit is from the UE based mobility.   Qualcomm agrees and also the requirements from RAN4 are different and it is better for the power.
-	Vodafone thinks that the main difference is that there is some preparation for cells but when the UE does the mobility it is relaxed.
-	Oppo thinks that measurements should be something to investigate in this sub-state.   There are other solutions where the UE doesn’t have to report to the network everytime there is a change.
-	CATT also thinks that the UE based mobility is the baseline.  It is simple for INACTIVE, but for sub-state the camp thinks that we are already connected so we need some form of mobility.
-	Interdigital thought that until today inactive and sub-state were similar but it appears that for sub-state we need to send the network measurements.  So if the sub-state remains a valid option the solution should be that the UE doesn’t have to notify the network everytime.
-	Xiaomi thinks that we can leave whether the UE notifies the network as FFS.
-	ZTE also thinks that the other main power saving is whether the UE is doing RRM.  CHO is being discussed in mobility so we need to first have that discussion.
Noted

Observation 6	For small data transmission in 6G, it would be better to discuss and agree on the requirements rather than using the NR functionality as baseline.
Proposal 6	Small data transmission in 6G is studied based on the principles below:
a.	The target use case should apply to all transmissions, not only IoT.
b.	Data transfers should have small overhead for radio resource efficient transmission.
c.	Early indication in Msg1 should be avoided, if possible.
d.	Network should be in control of conditions for small data transmission in 6G RRC Inactive.

summary_zh: 为支持 UE controlled mobility 下的 small data transmissions，RAN 和 UE 应至少保留 AS security context（包括安全密钥及移动时刷新安全的材料）、特定区域内用于唯一识别 UE 的 UE ID，以及支持通过 DRB 和/或 SRB 进行小数据传输的基本 RB configuration。
text_en:
The RAN and UE should retain at least the following UE context to enable small data transmissions with UE controlled mobility:
a.	AS security context (including security keys and material to refresh the security upon mobility)
b.	A UE ID with which RAN can uniquely identify the UE within certain area
c.	Basic RB configuration to enable small data transmission over DRB and/or SRB

summary_zh: 在 UE-controlled mobility 期间，如果没有数据交换，网络无需获知 UE 在 configured area 内的每次小区变化。
text_en: During UE-controlled mobility, when there is no data to exchange, the network does not need to be informed of individual cell changes within a configured area

summary_zh: RRC structure 研究涵盖 delta signalling、conditional presence、common and dedicated configuration、ID based linking 和 parallel lists，目标包括减少歧义与实现错误、支持局部配置修改、表示 UE 完整配置并保持 UE 与 NW 同步。后续工作将讨论覆盖这些研究范围的 ASN.1 示例，比较 delta signalling 方案，并评估初始配置及 delta-configurations 的消息大小。
text_en:
Delta signaling
1.	Investigate how to make the rules for delta signalling more explicit inside the signalling structure and thereby less ambiguous and less error prone to implement including the case of inter-node mobility.
2	In the context of delta signalling, investigate especially how to improve the definition and extensibility of (AddMod/Release) lists.
3	Ensure that delta signalling allows the network to modify/replace parts of the configuration without resending also large unmodified parts of the configuration.
4	Ensure that the signalling structure can represent the UE’s entire current configuration (which the UE might have received in several “deltas”), e.g. for inter-node signalling in case of inter-node handover.
Conditional Presence
5	Investigate how to specify configuration constraints unambiguously and clearly distinguish from delta signalling.
Common and dedicated configuration
6	Avoid splitting the connected mode configuration into common- and dedicated branches unless necessary to express dependencies between the UEs dedicated configuration and information provided in MIB/SIB.
ID based linking
7	Investigate how to use ID-based linking of configuration components while avoiding unfavourable signalling overhead and lack of readability.
Parallel Lists
8	Seek for consistent means to specify and extend lists in and overhead-efficient and implementation-friendly manner.
What to do next
-	Ericsson as rapporteur thinks we can now move to the phase where we discuss and see examples for all the bullets.   Xiaomi thinks that already during the email discussion there are already tools proposed in the email discussion.
-	Oppo thinks that companies have different views about the solutions and it is not clear whether we can go to another phase of email discussion.
-	Huawei thinks that companies have provided principles but when reading them it is not clear what they mean so companies need to provide clear examples.   Nokia agrees and we need to get to practical details.   Worry is that we come to next meeting and companies may not understand what was the intention.
-	Vivo thinks that we should also prioritize amongst the issue.
-	Apple thinks that we should expand the scope to include the efficiency of initial and reconfiguration.  Qualcomm agrees that we should discuss the partial configuration and how to synchronize etc.
[POST133][006][6G] ASN.1 discussion  (Ericsson)
Intended outcome:
-	Present and discuss example ASN.1 snippets addressing the agreed study scope.
-	At least in the context of delta signalling: Compare solutions e.g. with respect to their ability to setup, change, maintain and release branches at different levels (including lists), maintaining synchronization between UE and NW after several reconfiguration, ....
-	Consider aspects such as “unambiguity”, “robustness”, “maintainability”, “extensibility”, “readability”, “ease of use” from specification- and implementation perspective.
-	Generate example encodings and assess the solutions’ impact on message size for initial- and delta-configurations.
