summary_zh: FeatureSet ID大小和FSC List保留两种候选方案：缩小FeatureSetDownlink/UplinkID，或采用short/long可变长度；细节留待WI stage-3决定，RAN2 SI阶段不再讨论。RAN2还将基于真实NR capability container比较Category 1/3/8方案的收益与限制，并研究Category 6 compression的收益；RACS ID是否继续使用尚无共识，RAN based ID可进一步研究。
text_en:
1   For Size of FeatureSet ID and FSC List capture the following two solutions as candidate options in TR, the details will be decided in WI stage-3. No further discussion on this topic in RAN2 SI phase:
Solution 1. Reduce the size of FeatureSetDownlink/UplinkID
Solution 2. Variable FeatureSetDownlink/UplinkID length (short/long)
2	Wait for RAN4 progress on whether UE reports capabilities per RF chain instead of per band/BC.
3	RAN2 to study the benefit of compression solution (i.e., Category 6) later after some progress on the outcome of capability signalling design of Category 1-3/8.
4	RAN2 agrees to take category 1/3/8 and corresponding solutions as starting point to further compare gains/limitations of each solution based on real life NR capability container (including clarification on solutions if needed).
CATEGORY 1: Common capability reporting for a group of bands/band combinations/carriers that have the same capabilities [Study Area: 1, 2, 3] (12/12 companies)
Solution 1: Group signalling for the same capability set(s) without changing capability granularity level
-	For ‘per BC’ capability
	Example capabilities: repeated per BC capabilities
-	For ‘per band’ capability
	Example capabilities: repeated per band capabilities
Solution 2: Feature Set at band combination level
-	For ‘per BC’ capability
	Example capabilities: repeated baseband per BC capabilities
-	For ‘per band and per BC’ capability
	Example capabilities: MIMO codebook capabilities
Solution 4: Coarse granularity
Solution 4-1: Move to Coarse capability granularity level
-	From ‘per BC’ granularity to ‘per UE’ granularity for some UE envelop capabilities
	Example capabilities: e.g., csi-RS-IM-ReceptionForFeedbackPerBandComb, simultaneousCSI-ReportsAllCC
-	From ‘per band pair per BC’/ ‘per BC’ to ‘per UE’ granularity
	Example capabilities: e.g., switching period, including srs-SwitchingTimesListNR, uplinkTxSwitchingPeriod, switchingPeriodForFDD-SDL
Solution 4-2: Use envelop signalling for the following capabilities
-	For ‘per FSPC’ capability
	Example capabilities: e.g., maxNumberMIMO-LayersCB-PUSCH, maxNumberSRS-ResourcePerSet, maxNumberMIMO-LayersNonCB-PUSCH, supportedModulationOrderUL, maxNumberMIMO-LayersPDSCH, etc
-	For ‘per FS’ capability
	Example capabilities: e.g., DMRS parameters (oneFL-DMRS-TwoAdditionalDMRS-DL, additionalDMRS-DL-Alt, twoFL-DMRS-TwoAdditionalDMRS-DL, oneFL-DMRS-ThreeAdditionalDMRS-DL), supportedSRS-Resources
Solution 5: Band combination signaling optimization, e.g., including remove redundant BC for BW classes (assuming signalling of BW class is still needed), etc.
CATEGORY 3: Increase the reusability of FeatureSetCombination and UL/DL decoupling [Study Area: 3] (7/12 companies)
Solution 1.	Use separate FeatureSetCombinations for UL and DL for each BC
Solution 2.	Keep FeatureSetCombination for both UL and DL, while allowing indicate once for FS DL and a list of FS UL
Solution 3.	Create a mapping structure indicating valid UL-DL capability combination supported by a UE
Solution 4.	Remove FeatureSetCombination ID completely. Use FSC directly in BC.
CATEGORY 8: ‘Same-as-previous’
Solution 1: Use ‘same-as-previous’ method
-	For ‘per band’ capability
-	For ‘per FS’ capability
-	For repeated FeatureSet ID within FSC.
6	Inform RAN4 after some further progress on UE capabilities about the RAN2 identified redundant capability signalling caused by BC definition capabilities and hope RAN4 could take RAN2 study outcome (either consider BCS4/5 as baseline or use UE envelop limitation for supportedBandwidth) into consideration when discussing BC definition.
7	RAN2 has no consensus on whether RACS ID (i.e. CN based ID, same as 5G, ID is defined to represent full set of UE capabilities) will be still used in 6G considering coordination challenges and network maintenance burden (i.e., storage issue).  It is up to SA2 to further discuss this.
8	RAN2 can further consider/study RAN based ID, how it works, and what information is represented by this ID.
9	Companies to report the following information to compare gains/complexity of each solution:
-	Baseline UE capability log of eMBB UE used for gain analysis
-	Capability container size
-	Total number of BC
-	Total number of band
-	Number of bands with repeated capabilities in bits for each redundant group (detailed examples are welcomed)
-	Number of BCs with repeated capabilities in bits for each redundant group (detailed examples are welcomed)
-	Number of featureSet and FeatureSetCombination (including FeatureSetUL/DL)

summary_zh: 确认现有 NR UAI 机制在所有用例中的问题，包括网络可能不支持或未启用该功能、UE 无法获知网络是否及如何处理请求，以及网络不了解 UE 未指定的自主行为。研究允许部分用例在无网络预配置时触发 capability update、更新内容、响应消息与响应时限；power saving、foldable phones 和 IDC 列为补充用例。
text_en:
Do not capture a distinction between “families” of capability change use cases for now.
Confirm for all use cases the at least the following pain points of the existing UAI mechanism in NR:
The network may not support the UAI functionality and/or may not enable it for the UE.
There is no direct response from the network and no certainty that the network will address the UE’s request for a change.  Because of network and overall system considerations, the network may need flexibility to address the problem differently from what the UE requested, which makes it difficult for the UE to know what the outcome of the request was.
The network is unaware of unspecified UE autonomous behaviours (fallback, etc), resulting in KPI degradation and connection failures, and making it difficult for the network to identify the root cause of the problem.
Aim for a solution where the UE is allowed for some use cases to invoke the capability update mechanism without prior network configuration.  This proposal does not imply what the network will do with the update.   FFS what features/use cases and what circumstance/conditions.
Study how to send the UE capability update, including the complete capability container or specific UE dynamic capability container/parameter.   FFS if we have different behaviour/parameters affected for different use cases.
A response message to the capability update is defined for all use cases.  FFS what message is used and what information is provided to the UE.
Study timeline within which the UE expects a response to the capability update.  FFS what is the UE behaviour when no response is received.
Power saving, foldable phones and IDC are considered as additional use cases for capability update study.    Additional use cases can be discussed in the future as their requirements become clear, and the capability change framework should strive for forward compatibility for such use cases.
Not treated

text_en:
RAN2 to study the benefit of compression solution (i.e., Category 6) based on outcome of capability signalling design of Category 1-3/8.
CATEGORY 6: Compression
Solution 1.	Compress UE capability message, for example, Deflate, etc.

Xiaomi thinks that we should wait and use the agreed formats to do an analysis, as if we do analysis based on current signalling it would show a lot of benefits but if we do things better the gains may be different.

summary_zh: 目标是统一 UE capability change signalling procedure，以支持报告 UE envelope capabilities 变化及特定 RF-或 hardware-related capabilities 变化。该目标不意味着所有用例影响相同的 capability fields。
text_en:
Aim for a unified signalling procedure for change of UE capabilities that can accommodate indications of both a change in UE envelope capabilities and a change in specific RF- or hardware-related capabilities.  This does not imply that all use cases will affect the same capability fields.
-	Huawei thinks it is not clear what is unified and we shouldn’t rush.   Xiaomi explains that this is just for reporting and UE behaviour.   Ericsson is also not clear what is the gain for this unified behaviour.

summary_zh: 确认现有 NR UAI 机制的两个问题：网络可能不支持或未为 UE 启用 UAI，且没有网络直接响应，UE 无法确定网络是否会处理其变更请求。讨论中还提出，UE 自主 fallback 可能让 UE 行为不可预测。
text_en:
Confirm for all use cases the following pain points of the existing UAI mechanism in NR:
The network may not support the UAI functionality and/or may not enable it for the UE.
There is no direct response from the network and no certainty that the network will address the UE’s request for a change.  Because of network and overall system considerations, the network may need flexibility to address the problem differently from what the UE requested, which makes it difficult for the UE to know what the outcome of the request was.
-	ZTE thinks that are NW side pain points that are not listed, like the autonomous fallback.  When the network doesn’t address the UE concern a pain point is that the UE will do something unpredictable.

summary_zh: 提出所有用例中的 UE 均可在无网络预配置时触发 capability update，但网络如何处理该更新未作规定。讨论意见涉及网络性能与控制、网络不支持时的开销、适用用例范围，以及避免 UE 在发送指示前进行自主行为。
text_en:
The UE is allowed for all use cases to invoke the capability update mechanism without prior network configuration.  This proposal does not imply what the network will do with the update (see P8).
-	CMCC doesn’t agree that it should be done without network configuration as it will impact network performance.
-	Huawei thinks that one option is to make it mandatory for both the network and the UE, but we don’t discuss now, but it will also depend on the use case.
-	Docomo is concerned that there are cases where the UE may update capability but the network doesn’t even support.  In these cases it is a complete overhead.    But some optimization can be considered.
-	Qualcomm thinks that we need to support this proposal otherwise we need to accept UE autonomous behaviour which is a pain point.   Do you think it is better to not know what the UE is doing.
-	Ofinno thinks that we can at least consider this just for some capability and not all use cases.    Xiaomi also supports and it doesn’t mean this is mandatory.   This principle has been agreed for positioning already and it works.
-	Mediatek doesn’t think this is a discussion on optional or mandatory.
-	Samsung thinks that we need to solve the 5G problem and this is the first step.  Otherwise we have the same situation.
-	Ericsson thinks that this can be considered for some cases and it is too soon to make such decisions.   Nokia agrees.
-	ZTE thinks that we need to add restrictions that the UE is not allowed to do autonomous fallback and the network should at least be able to configure timers if there are timers.
-	Tmobile also thinks that the network needs to control the behavior.
-	LG thinks that a network response should be expected by the UE and this way we can avoid autonomous fallback.
-	Lenovo thinks that proposal 4 makes sense but we do be careful with the issue from Docomo and we should also do it along with P8. And the network should have some intention to rectrify the situation.
-	Mediatek thinks that if we have a configuration of capability change then we will have autonomous fallback.
-	ZTE would really hope that the UE won’t do any autonomous UE behaviour before sending this indication.    Xiaomi thinks that we didn’t consider it in RRC configuration failure that the UE will not do autonomous fallback before capability change.    Mediatek thinks that we can’t yet decide as we need to understand how the full solution works as they don’t want the UE to explode.

summary_zh: 讨论将更新后的完整 capability container 作为请求 capability update 的指示方式。部分公司支持该方式，另有意见指出完整上报会占用容量并带来开销，并提出 UE 也可提供 preferred configuration。
text_en:
Discuss whether sending an updated version of the complete capability container is an agreeable approach to indicating the need for a capability update.
-	Qualcomm and LG agrees with this approach.
-	Docomo has two concerns, 1) reporting whole capability impacts capacity and it is a lot of overhead and also wonders if the UE has to do the full configuration or just delta.   CMCC and CATT has similar concerns.
-	CATT thinks that the UE can also provide preferred configuration.

summary_zh: 提出为所有用例定义 capability update 的 response message，具体使用何种消息仍待讨论。意见包括网络可指示是否会处理请求，以及避免使用 reject。
text_en:
A response message to the capability update is defined for all use cases.  FFS what message is used.
-	Lenovo thinks that this is important
-	ZTE thinks that sometimes the UE capability is for the future so the network may not need to give a response as it is impacting a future configuration and it should be up to the network how to react.
-	Ericsson thinks that even for proactive case the network can reply and it is just indicating whether the network will address it or not.
-	Huawei also thinks that this is a good start, but we don’t need to discuss the details for example this will be addressed or it won’t because of other consideration.    And if there is a reject then this may give the UE the ability to do a fallback.  Samsung thinks that it is not a reject it is just allowing the UE to fallback.
-	Samsung and Oppo would like to avoid reject.

summary_zh: 将 power saving 列为 capability update 的补充用例。
text_en: Power saving is considered as an additional use case for capability update.

summary_zh: 将 IDC 列为 capability update 的补充用例；讨论提到可为 IDC 使用标准化方案。
text_en:
IDC is considered as an additional use case for capability update.
-	Huawei asks why IDC as implementation specific solution is already used and 3GPP is not impacted.  Samsung thinks that we can now use a standardized solution that works for IDC.

summary_zh: 尚在讨论折叠手机是否需要 capability update，以便正确处理。Samsung 认为应按其他用例处理；Oppo 认为这是瞬时变化，可作为 MIMO change 处理；Xiaomi 认为网络应知道这是 UE capability change 所致。
text_en:
Further discuss whether capability update is needed for proper handling of foldable phones.
-	Samsung thinks that this should be handled similar to the other use cases.
-	Oppo thinks that this is an instantaneous change and it can be handled as a MIMO change.   Xiaomi thinks that it would be good for the network to know that this is because of UE capability change.

summary_zh: 未来可在其他用例的需求明确后讨论这些用例。capability change framework 应力求对这些用例保持 forward compatibility。
text_en: Additional use cases can be discussed in the future as their requirements become clear, and the capability change framework should strive for forward compatibility for such use cases.

agenda_title: Functionality for Upper User Plane and related functional requirements
summary_zh: 观察到 separate layer design 可能存在 robustness 问题：fake PDCP PDUs 可故意更新 RLC variables，阻止 authentic packets 后续处理。
text_en: A potential robustness issue for separate layer design is observed that fake PDCP PDUs may update RLC variables deliberately and block authentic packets to be processed later.

agenda_title: Functionality for Upper User Plane and related functional requirements
summary_zh: 通过合并 PDCP 和 RLC，re-ordering、window maintenance、status report 和 SDU discard 等重复功能可设计得更高效。
text_en: The duplicated functions, such as re-ordering, window maintenance, status report and SDU discard, can be designed in a more efficient manner by merging PDCP and RLC.

agenda_title: Functionality for Upper User Plane and related functional requirements
summary_zh: 在 merged layer 中，security function 可识别 fake PDUs，并阻止其故意更新 ARQ state 和 SN status variables。这样 authentic packets 后续到达时仍可处理。
text_en: In merged layer, fake PDUs could be idenfitied by security function and will not update ARQ state and SN status variables deliberately. Authentic packets can still be processed when received later.

agenda_title: Functionality for Upper User Plane and related functional requirements
summary_zh: RAN2 应研究以下场景中的 single sequence numbers：无 CU-DU split 且无 Dual Connectivity；有 CU-DU split 且无 Dual Connectivity；有 CU-DU split 且可能有 Dual Connectivity，例如 RANP 讨论的 FR1/FR2 non-collocated deployments。
text_en:
RAN2 should study the issue of single sequence numbers for the following scenarios:
Scenario 1: Assuming no CU-DU split (or equivalent) and no Dual Connectivity.
Scenario 2: Assuming CU-DU split (or equivalent) and no Dual Connectivity.
Scenario 3: Assuming CU-DU split (or equivalent) and possible Dual Connectivity, e.g., for FR1/FR2 non-collocated deployments discussed by RANP.

agenda_title: Functionality for Upper User Plane and related functional requirements
summary_zh: 在 RLC header 中重复 common SN 是冗余的，并会增加开销和 header processing complexity。
text_en: Repeating the common SN in the RLC header is redundant and increases both overhead and header processing complexity.

agenda_title: Functionality for Upper User Plane and related functional requirements
summary_zh: 现场数据表明，携带 NACK 的 RLC Status PDU 中，RLC Status PDU 截断问题较为常见。
text_en: Field data shows that the issue of truncation of RLC Status PDU is common for NACK-carrying RLC status PDUs.

agenda_title: Functionality for Upper User Plane and related functional requirements
summary_zh: 截至 Rel-18，DRB 的 RLC 运行于两种模式：RLC UM 在 RLC 层将时延最小化但不提供可靠性保证；RLC AM 提供 100% 可靠性，但 RLC 时延无界（PDCP discard timer 除外）。
text_en: Up to Rel-18, RLC for DRBs operated in two modes: 1) RLC UM: Minimized latency with no reliability guarantees at RLC level. 2) RLC AM: Operates at a 100% reliability with unbounded RLC latency (except for PDCP discard timer).

agenda_title: Functionality for Upper User Plane and related functional requirements
summary_zh: RLC segmentation 会在发送端和接收端造成处理瓶颈：发送端无法进行 pre-processing，接收端则会在 reassembly 时受阻。
text_en: RLC segmentation creates a bottleneck of processing both at transmitter and receiver. The transmitter cannot apply pre-processing. The receiver gets blocked at reassembly.

agenda_title: Functionality for Upper User Plane and related functional requirements
summary_zh: 在高数据速率下，RLC segmentation 不增加收益，因为 TB 已可一次承载数百个 IP packets。
text_en: RLC segmentation does not add any benefit at high data rates as TBs can already carry hundreds of IP packets in one piece.

agenda_title: Functionality for Upper User Plane and related functional requirements
summary_zh: RLC segmentation 仅适用于低数据速率链路。
text_en: RLC segmentation is only needed for low data rate links

agenda_title: Functionality for Upper User Plane and related functional requirements
summary_zh: 将多个 QoS flows/traffic flows 映射到单个 DRB，可能因 PDCP reordering 导致 HOL blocking。
text_en: Mapping multiple QoS flows/ traffic flows to a single DRB may cause HOL blocking due to PDCP reordering.

agenda_title: Functionality for Upper User Plane and related functional requirements
summary_zh: 静态 PDCP reordering 机制不适用于具有动态 QoS 的服务特性。
text_en: The static PDCP reordering mechanism is not suitable for service characteristics with dynamic QoS.

agenda_title: Functionality for Upper User Plane and related functional requirements
summary_zh: 5G PDCP reordering 机制在 DL 峰值吞吐量下会导致较高的 Rx 内存需求，且无法适应 QoE。
text_en: 5G PDCP reordering mechanism causes high Rx memory requirements at DL peak throughput and lacks ability to adapt to QoE.

agenda_title: Functionality for Upper User Plane and related functional requirements
summary_zh: 5G 静态 PDCP discard timer 机制存在两项问题：逐包定时器可能丢弃 application bursts，且不考虑 QoE 是否改善；单一静态 timer 无法适应路径时延变化，控制 application delay 的能力较粗略。
text_en:
5G static PDCP discard timer mechanism leads to the following issues:
-	Per-packet discard timer leads to discarding of application bursts without considering if this leads to improvement of degradation of QoE.
-	Single Static timer that does not adapt to path latency variations provide a very coarse tool for controlling application delay.

agenda_title: Functionality for Upper User Plane and related functional requirements

-	Qualcomm agrees that we should study the scenarios, and not consider split before 5G.
-	Apple thinks that redundant functionality removal is not linked with layers.
-	Huawei thinks that companies need to provide feasibility of merged layer in different architecture options and if it works.

summary_zh: 提出研究面向 Mobile AI、XR 等流量的 dynamic QoS，涵盖应用在 QoS flows 间切换、QoS flow 属性变化及同一 QoS flow 内 PDUs（PDU sets）具有不同 QoS 属性等场景；同时继续研究 UL/DL burst information 的检测与提供方式，并研究增强 uplink scheduling mechanism。作为讨论基线，UE/aNB 至少按 QoS flow 粒度接收上层/CN 数据，并支持到 RB 的 1:1 和 N:1 灵活映射。

For some scenarios (will complete later).
-	From RAN2 point of view, as baseline for discussion we assume UE/aNB receives packets from upper layers/CN at least QoS flow granularity.  At least, support flexible mapping to RBs (1:1 and N:1).  FFS other mechanisms (e.g. RAN handling granularity,1:N etc).
RAN dynamic QoS
-	Observation from RAN2 point of view: Some 6G services like Mobile AI and XR, may have stringent requirements on QoS metrics (e.g., latency, packet loss rate) and the QoS requirements may be dynamically variable.  The existing static QoS mechanism is inherently incapable of adapting to such dynamicity.
-	Study RAN2 aspects of dynamic QoS from RAN2 perspective, in at least the following scenarios (e.g. for XR and mobile AI traffic):
An application may dynamically switch its traffic between a set of QoS flows
A QoS flow may dynamically change one of its QoS attributes
PDUs (PDU sets) within the same QoS flow may have varying QoS attributes
RAN awareness
-	RAN awareness of burst information (e.g. size of burst and time information) for both UL and DL is beneficial.  Continue study on how to detect and provide this information.  For RAN2, focus on UL.  For DL, some coordination with SA2 is required.
-	Service characteristic awareness information (e.g. 5G XR-like information awareness) would be beneficial.  FFS which information and how it is done.  Some coordination with SA2 and SA4 is required.

summary_zh: 6G 预期支持多样且动态、QoS requirements 随时间变化的流量，因此需要低时延和高效的 QoS adaptation mechanisms 来应对流量变化。
text_en: 6G is expected to support diverse and dynamic traffic with time-varying QoS requirements, which necessitates low latency and efficient QoS adaptation mechanisms to cope with traffic variations.

summary_zh: 6G immersive communication 具有相互依赖的多模态 flows（如 video、audio 和 haptic）、多样的流量模式，以及单个或多个 UE 间严格的同步要求。为满足 human perceptual thresholds，需要协调的 L2 handling 和联合 QoS adaptation。
text_en: 6G immersive communication is characterized by interdependent multi-modal flows (e.g., video, audio, and haptic) with diverse traffic patterns and stringent synchronization requirements across single or multiple UEs, necessitating coordinated L2 handling and joint QoS adaptation to satisfy human perceptual thresholds.

summary_zh: 基于 GBR resource types 和严格 PDB/PER enforcement 的 legacy 5G QoS framework 面向确定性服务优化，在处理 6G immersive services 的非确定性、突发流量模式时会导致显著的频谱效率低下和资源过度配置。
text_en: The legacy 5G QoS framework based on GBR resource types and strict PDB/PER enforcement is optimized for deterministic services, leading to significant spectral inefficiency and resource over-provisioning when handling the non-deterministic, bursty traffic patterns of 6G immersive services.

summary_zh: 静态 5QI definitions 和半静态 RRC/NAS configurations 缺乏跟踪 6G 流量快速、多维变化的灵活性；Control Plane 驱动的重配置固有时延也不适用于实时 QoS adaptation 所需的毫秒级响应。
text_en: Static 5QI definitions and semi-static RRC/NAS configurations lack the agility to track the rapid, multi-dimensional variability of 6G traffic, while the inherent latency of Control Plane-driven reconfiguration is incompatible with the millisecond-level responsiveness required for real-time QoS adaptation.

summary_zh: 5GS QoS Flow 为 6G 提供稳定基线，但 flow-level granularity 太粗，无法跟踪 Mobile AI 和 multi-modal services 中快速变化的流量及差异化 packet importance。
text_en: While the 5GS QoS Flow concept provides a stable baseline for 6G, the current flow-level granularity is too coarse to track the rapid traffic variations and differentiated packet importance inherent in Mobile AI and multi-modal services.

summary_zh: 许多典型移动应用会建立大量短连接，导致 destination IP addresses 和 IP 5-tuples 快速变化。IP 5-tuples 动态变化会直接引发对应 QoS rules 和 mappings 频繁且不可预测地变化。
text_en: Many typical mobile applications may establish a large number of short-lived connections, which results in rapidly changing destination IP addresses and varying IP 5-tuples. Dynamically varying IP 5tuples directly leads to frequent and unpredictable changes in the corresponding QoS rules and mappings.

summary_zh: 新兴 6G 服务对 latency、packet loss rate 等 QoS metrics 有严格要求，且 QoS requirements 可能随实时状态动态变化。现有 static QoS mechanism 无法适应这种动态性。
text_en: Emerging 6G services have the stringent requirements on QoS metrics (e.g., latency, packet loss rate) and the QoS requirements may be dynamically variable based on real-time states. The existing static QoS mechanism is inherently incapable of adapting to such dynamicity.

summary_zh: 流量特征包括同一 data flow 内的 packets 具有不同 QoS requirements 的情形，例如 data burst。
text_en: Traffic characteristics include cases where packets within the same data flow may have differing QoS requirements (e.g., data burst).

summary_zh: NR QoS framework 在 RAN 内将 data flow 中所有 packets 半静态地映射到单一 QoS treatment。因此，同一 DRB 承载的所有 packets 在 RAN protocol stack 中接受统一的 QoS treatment。
text_en: NR QoS framework provides semi-static mapping of all packets in a data flow to a single QoS treatment within the RAN. As a result, all packets carried over the same DRB are subject to uniform QoS treatment within the RAN protocol stack.

summary_zh: 按 per-packet 或 per-packet-group granularity 进行 QoS handling，可比 per-DRB granularity 实现更轻量、高效的差异化处理。Qualcomm 询问了一个打破 intra-flow 的 per-packet group 示例。
text_en:
QoS handling at per-packet or per-packet-group granularity can enable more lightweight and efficient differentiated treatment compared to per-DRB granularity.
-	Qualcomm asks of an example about the per-packet group that breaks the intra-flow.

summary_zh: Per-packet 或 per-packet-group QoS granularity 可在 data flow 内实现更细粒度、动态的 traffic 到 QoS treatment 的映射。
text_en: Per-packet or per-packet-group QoS granularity enables more fine-grained and dynamic mapping of traffic to QoS treatment within a data flow.

summary_zh: 更细的 QoS granularity 可使 resource allocation 更好匹配瞬时 traffic characteristics，从而减少 resource over-provisioning。
text_en: Finer QoS granularity can reduce resource over-provisioning by allowing resource allocation to better match the instantaneous traffic characteristics.

summary_zh: GBR 需要非常严格的 resource reservation 来保证 bit rate，但这种方式的 resource efficiency 不高。
text_en: GBR requires a very strict resource reservation to guarantee bit rate, which is not so resource efficient.

summary_zh: 支持 dynamic QoS requirements 和 pre-authorization 的解决方案正在 SA2 讨论中。
text_en: Solutions to support dynamic QoS requirements and pre-authorization are under discussion in SA2.

summary_zh: 5G 仅对 XR service 的部分 packet（即 PDU set）进行区分：UL 取决于 UE 实现，DL 则通过 GTP-U header 中的 CN indication 对 RAN 可见。6G 应支持 diverse applications，并满足同一 service flow（或 QoS flow）内不同 packet 的多样 transmission requirements。
text_en: In 5G, only the packets from XR service is differentiated (i.e. PDU set), i.e. UL up to UE implementation and DL visible to RAN via CN indication in GTP-U header. However, 6G should be able to support diverse applications (e.g. immersive communication and mobile AI traffic), with various transmission requirements for different packets within a certain service flow (or QoS flow).

summary_zh: 同一 service 的不同 QoS flows 若因 QoS requirements 不同而映射到不同 DRBs，AS 交付给 upper layer 的 packets 将出现 out-of-order。由此会降低 throughput，并增加 signalling overheads 和 redundant packet transmission。
text_en: When different QoS flows with different QoS requirements from the same service are mapped to different DRBs, the packets delivered from AS to upper layer will be out-of-order, which causes throughput reduction, extra signalling overheads and redundant packet transmission (e.g. due to TCP fast retransmission and flow control).

summary_zh: 6G AI traffic 的独特特征可归纳为 Multi-modality、E2E latency，以及在采用 two-sided model 时的 Error tolerance。
text_en:
The unique feature of 6G AI traffic can be further abstracted into the following key aspects:
Multi-modality
E2E latency
Error tolerance (if two-sided model is applied)

summary_zh: 在当前 5GS QoS framework 中，RAN/UE 不具备对 PDU Set 内 AL-FEC structure 的 awareness，这会导致显著的 resource inefficiency。
text_en: In the current 5GS QoS framework, the lack of RAN/UE awareness regarding the AL-FEC structure within a PDU Set leads to significant resource inefficiency.

summary_zh: SA2 已开始研究 AL-FEC 的 QoS aspects。
text_en: SA2 has started study of QoS aspects for AL-FEC.

summary_zh: 在 RAN 中支持 AL-FEC 有助于缓解 congestion 并降低 latency，而 5G 中 AL-FEC 对 RAN 是 transparent 的。可通过在 RAN 中配置 AL-FEC support，以满足 application layer requirements，并处理 RAN discarding 对 application layer 的影响顾虑。
text_en: AL-FEC support in RAN is helpful to ease congestion problem as well as to reduce latency. However in 5G, AL-FEC is transparent to RAN. Concerns regarding the impact on application layer due to discarding in RAN can be addressed by configurable AL-FEC support in RAN to cater for requirements from application layer.

summary_zh: R19 支持基于 AL-FEC 的 discard 的主要问题是：对于 UM DRB，无法获知 PDCP SDU 是否已成功传输。
text_en: The main issue for R19 to support AL-FEC based discard is that for UM DRB, it is not possible to know whether a PDCP SDU is successfully transmitted or not.

summary_zh: 可利用 UL HARQ status indication 来判断 PDCP SDU 是否已成功传输。
text_en: UL HARQ status indication could be utilized for determining whether a PDCP SDU has been successfully transmitted or not.

summary_zh: 基于 FEC-ratio 的 discard 有助于缓解 congestion，同时维持 immersive communication service 的 continuity。
text_en: FEC-ratio based discard is beneficial for alleviating congestion, while at the same time maintaining the continuity of the immersive communication service.

summary_zh: 在 AI glass、car、high-speed train、UAM、FWA 等场景中，service 可能并非由 UE 发起或终止，而是由通过 non-3GPP link（如 WiFi 和 BT）连接到 UE、并与 DN 通信的 tethered device 发起或终止。
text_en: In some scenarios (e.g. AI glass, car, high-speed train, UAM, FWA), service may not be originated from or terminated at UE, but tethered device instead, which is attached to a UE via non-3GPP link (e.g. WiFi and BT) for communication with DN.

summary_zh: 系留设备经历的 QoS 取决于该设备与 Data Network 之间的端到端路径。
text_en: The QoS experienced by a tethered device is dependent on the end to end path between the tethered device and the Data Network.

summary_zh: 5G PIN 的 non-3GPP delay 方案无法充分利用数据包在 non-3GPP link 上经历的动态变化时延，也无法及时适配。
text_en: 5G PIN non-3GPP delay solution cannot fully utilize and timely adapt to the dynamically changed delay experienced by a packet on the non-3GPP link.

summary_zh: E2E reliability 由 non-3GPP link PER 和 3GPP link PER 共同决定。RAN/CN 需要获知 non-3GPP link PER，以便适当设置 3GPP link PER；5G PIN 不支持这一点。
text_en: E2E reliability is determined by both non-3GPP link PER and 3GPP link PER. RAN/CN needs to know the non-3GPP link PER in order to properly set 3GPP link PER, which is not supported by 5G PIN.

summary_zh: 在 tethering 用例中，air interface delay budget 可以动态变化，以确保满足 end-to-end latency requirement。
text_en: In tethering use cases, the air interface delay budget may be dynamically changed to ensure the end-to-end latency requirement can be satisfied.

summary_zh: 当 tethered UE 经由 tethering UE 使用 non-3GPP link 接入网络时，端到端用户体验取决于 3GPP segment 和 non-3GPP segment。
text_en: In scenarios where tethered UE accesses the network via tethering UE using a non-3GPP link, the end-to-end user experience depends on both the 3GPP segment and the non-3GPP segment.

summary_zh: 根据 5G NR PDU session Modification procedure（TS 23.501），PEGC 向 SMF 提供 non-3GPP delay，SMF 可以通过调整 CN PDB 补偿该时延。
text_en: According to the 5G NR PDU session Modification procedure (TS 23.501), the PEGC provides non-3GPP delay to the SMF and the SMF may compensate for this delay by adjusting the CN PDB.

summary_zh: 当前通过 PDU Session Modification 调整 CN PDB 来补偿 non-3GPP delay 的机制，可能不足以覆盖时延动态变化的各种场景。
text_en: The current PDB compensation mechanism, in which non-3GPP delay is compensated through CN PDB adjustment via PDU Session Modification, may not be sufficient to capture the various scenarios with delay dynamics.

summary_zh: RAN2 将研究 6G QoS mechanism 向动态、service-aware model 的演进，重点支持更细粒度 QoS 和快速适配 6G 服务的多维变化及时变需求（例如 Mobile AI 和 immersive communication），同时确保资源高效利用。
text_en: RAN2 to study the evolution of the 6G QoS mechanism toward a dynamic and service-aware model, focusing on supporting finer QoS granularity and rapid adaptation to accommodate the multi-dimensional variability and time-varying requirements of 6G services (e.g., Mobile AI and immersive communication) while ensuring efficient resource utilization.

summary_zh: RAN2 将考虑以 5GS QoS Flow 作为 6G 基线，并研究支持更细粒度、使 Access Stratum 内 QoS 能够快速自主调整的增强方案。
text_en:
RAN2 to consider the 5GS QoS Flow as the baseline for 6G, while investigating enhancements to support finer granularity to enable rapid, autonomous QoS adjustment within the Access Stratum.

summary_zh: 针对 6G 新服务，需要动态 QoS mechanism，由 RAN 直接调整服务的 QoS requirements，以保障数据传输和处理的及时性与可靠性；调整项可包括 Delay Budget、Error Rate 和 importance，粒度可为 QoS flows、PDU sets 或 packets。采用新 QoS requirements 的 QoS flows/PDU sets 将伴随 L2-related parameters 调整，例如 remaining time thresholds、discard timers、重传机制的启停及 scheduling priority。
text_en:
For the 6G new services, a dynamic QoS mechanism is needed to support, where the RAN directly adjusts the QoS requirements of services to ensure the timeliness and reliability of data transmission and processing. In the dynamic QoS mechanism:
The RAN could dynamically adjust the QoS requirements, e.g., Delay Budget, Error Rate, and importance. The granularity of dynamic QoS could be QoS flows, PDU sets or packets.
The QoS flows/PDU sets under the new QoS requirements will be accompanied by adjustments of L2-related parameters, such as remaining time thresholds, discard timers, activation and deactivation of retransmission mechanisms and scheduling priority.
-	Apple asks if RAN includes the UE.   CMCC explains that the RAN can provide some ranges and the UE can select something and we can also report to gNB what was selected.

summary_zh: 动态 QoS 研究应考虑关键网络指标监测、业务类型与需求识别、新处理流程设计，以及 RAN 与核心网交互。会上说明，UL 可依赖 UE，DL 可依赖 RNA 进行识别。

For the study of dynamic QoS, the following aspects should be considered:
Monitoring of key network indicators
Identification of service types and requirements
The design of the new processing flow
Interaction between RAN and the core network

QoS flow remains the finest granularity in 6G QoS framework, while retaining flexible mapping to RBs (1:1 and N:1) and enabling enhancements for more explicit QoS flow-level handling in RAN.

text_en:
To cope with dynamic QoS requirement based on Application/Service awareness, RAN2 should prioritize the study on how the UE can adapt the radio treatment for a UL traffic flow in a dynamic manner.

summary_zh: RAN2 可研究三种方式，为同一 traffic flow 中的数据包动态提供差异化 radio treatment：一个 QoS flow 关联多个 DRB 并选择 DRB；一个 DRB 关联多个 RLC/LCH 并选择 C/LCH；或一个 DRB 配置多组参数并按包切换参数集。ZTE 提出可考虑 1:N，并假设不存在 in-order delivery。
text_en:
RAN2 can consider the following options to dynamically provide differentiated radio treatments for packets on one traffic flow:
Option 1: A QoS flow may be associated to multiple DRBs, and the transmitter can select the DRB to transmit a packet from this QoS flow.
2: A DRB may be associated to multiple RLCs/LCHs, and the transmitter can select the C/LCH to transmit a packet from this DRB.
Option 3: A DRB may be configured with multiple sets of parameters, and the transmitter can switch the parameter set to transmit a packet from this DRB.

summary_zh: RAN2 将考虑在 6GR 中采用 hybrid SDU delivery mechanism。该机制可对携带 TCP ACK 的 SDUs 选择性采用 out-of-order delivery，而同一 DRB 的其他 SDUs 采用 in-order delivery。
text_en: RAN2 consider a hybrid SDU delivery mechanism in 6GR, wherein out-of-order delivery can be selectively applied, e.g., to SDUs carrying a TCP ACK, while in-order delivery is applied to other SDUs of the same DRB.

summary_zh: 对于 CB-PUSCH BSR 的 RAN2 评估，配置假设包括 dedicated 或 shared DMRS、C-RNTI 或 common RNTI，以及典型 Msg3 配置（1 或 2 PRBs、QPSK）；beam information 的使用不受限制，且 CB-PUSCH payload 包含 UE ID。若 CB-UL transmission 后 timer 内收到 positive NW response，则 contention resolution 视为成功；失败时 UE 重试 CB-UL，且不使用 HARQ retransmission，而是在 contention resolution failure 后使用 HARQ new transmission。
text_en:
For the RAN2 evaluation purpose for CB PUSCH of BSR, the followings are assumed for the CB PUSCH configuration:
1) Either dedicated or shared DMRS can be used.
2) Either C-RNTI or common RNTI can be used.
3) The typical Msg3 configuration (i.e. 1 or 2 PRBs and QPSK) is used
4) No restriction on how beam information (i.e. no beam or NW-indicated or UE-selected) is used for CB-PUSCH.
5) UE ID (e.g. C-RNTI MAC CE) is included in CB-PUSCH payload.
6) If a positive NW response is received within a timer after CB-UL transmission, the contention resolution is considered as successful.
7) The UE re-attempts CB-UL transmission when contention resolution fails.
8) HARQ retransmission is not used, i.e. the UE uses HARQ new transmission after contention resolution failure.

summary_zh: NR 为 4-step RACH 的 RAR 和 2-step RACH 的 MsgB 定义了不同的 DL response，并使用不同 RNTI 调度，以区分两种 RACH 类型。这样会降低 multiplexing flexibility，并增加 RNTI spaces 的消耗。
text_en: In NR, separate DL responses are defined for 4-step RACH (RAR) and 2-step RACH (MsgB). Although RAR and MsgB (e.g., fallbackRAR in MsgB) share similarities, they must be separately scheduled using different RNTIs. This ensures UE differentiation between the two RACH types but at a cost of reduced multiplexing flexibility and increased consumption of RNTI spaces.

summary_zh: NR UE 仅在达到配置的失败次数后执行 RACH fallback，并严格遵循预定义顺序。该机制忽略 UE 侧 radio link quality 的动态变化，可能增加 fallback latency，并阻止 UE 选择更合适的 RACH resources。
text_en: In NR, the UE performs RACH fallback only after a configured number of failed attempts and strictly follows a predefined order. The mechanism disregards dynamic change of radio link quality at UE side, which may increase fallback latency and prevents the UE from selecting more suitable RACH resources.

summary_zh: NR RACH 在初始化时选择 UL carrier 和 BWP，之后保持不变，因此无法适应小区内动态负载变化。
text_en: In NR RACH, the UL carrier and BWP are selected during RACH initialization and remain unchanged thereafter, which cannot adapt to dynamic intra-cell load variations.

summary_zh: 通过灵活传输 preamble 和 MSG3/MSGA payload parts，6G 可采用统一框架支持 4-step RACH、2-step RACH 和 CB-PUSCH。
text_en: By enabling flexible transmission of the preamble, MSG3/MSGA payload parts, 6G can support 4-step RACH, 2-step RACH and CB-PUSCH using a unified framework for all these features

summary_zh: NR 中 RedCap、eRedCap、SDT 和 network slicing 的 RACH partitioning 不要求采用根本不同的 RA response message 或 Msg3 format。因此，只要网络能在随机接入期间或之前通过其他机制识别 UE feature，6G 就不必为这些特性专门进行 RACH partitioning。
text_en: In NR, RACH partitioning for RedCap, eRedCap, SDT, and network slicing does not impose requirements on a fundamentally different RA response message or Msg3 format. Therefore, dedicated RACH partitioning for these features is not an absolute requirement in 6G, provided that the network can identify the UE's feature through alternative mechanisms at or prior to the random access procedure.

summary_zh: 只有在 response handling 存在根本差异的特性（如 OD-SIB1）中，才需要在 PRACH detection 阶段提前识别；缺少指示会导致错误的 monitoring 或 response procedures。对于 SBFD、IAB-MT、preamble Group A/B 和 OD-SIs 等功能兼容 common configuration 的特性，单独的 RACH resource partitioning 并非严格必需，额外机制仅用于优化。
text_en: Early identification at PRACH detection is required only for features with fundamental differences in response handling (e.g., OD-SIB1), where lack of such indication leads to incorrect monitoring or response procedures. For other features (e.g., SBFD, IAB-MT, preamble Group A/B, OD-SIs), separate RACH resource partitioning is not strictly required as the procedures remain functionally compatible with a common configuration, with any additional mechanisms providing optimization rather than necessity.

summary_zh: NR 支持的特性中，有些必须通过 Msg1 指示，有些可以等到 Msg3，还有一些需要 RAN1 讨论。
text_en: Among all these features supported by NR, some are necessary to be indicated via Msg1, some can wait for Msg3 and some require RAN1 discussion.

summary_zh: NR 中支持特性及其组合会显著增加 RACH resource set selection procedure 的复杂度，尤其是在多个资源仅支持触发该 RACH procedure 的部分特性时。
text_en: In NR, support of feature/feature combinations introduces significant complexity on RACH resource set selection procedure, especially when there are multiple resources supporting a subset of all features triggering this RACH procedure.

summary_zh: 在 NR 中，RACH resources 难以适应接入负载的短期变化，常导致高争用和接入失败。
text_en: In NR, RACH resources do not adapt well to short-term variations in access load, often resulting in high level of contention and access failures.

summary_zh: 原文指出，NR 中的 RACH resource allocation mechanism and procedure 效率不高。
text_en: RACH resource allocation mechanism and procedure in NR are not efficient.

summary_zh: 原文提出允许 CCCH channel segmentation，以灵活调整 MSG3 payload size、避免为 MSG3/MSGA payload size indication 进行 preamble partitioning。此举还可让可延迟到 MSG3 的功能（如 early UE type、slice indication）改用 MSG3 based indication，而非 MSG1 based indication。
text_en:
Allowing segmentation for CCCH channel can enable the following:
Make the MSG3 payload size flexible without compromising the coverage whilst avoiding the need for preamble partitioning for MSG3/MSGA payload size indication
Enable more features that can wait till MSG3 (e.g. early UE type, slice indication etc) to use MSG3 based indication instead of MSG1 based indication.

summary_zh: 原文预计 6G 中的 MAC CEs 将用于发送更多样的消息，其中一些可能要求更高的 reliability。
text_en: MAC CEs in 6G are expected to be used to send more diverse types of messages, some of which may demand higher reliability.

summary_zh: 6G 中的 MAC CEs 可以采用更结构化的设计，以实现高效处理并满足预期更严格的 6G timing requirements。
text_en: MAC CEs in 6G can be designed in a more structured way to enable efficient processing and meet the stricter timing requirements expected in 6G.

text_en:

Limitation in multiplexing the RA responses across different RA types, e.g., RAR and MsgB share similarities but cannot be multiplexed into the same DL signalling.
Lack of consideration for dynamic radio link quality change in RACH fallback, e.g., RACH fallback relies solely on attempt number and follows a predefined fallback order.
Less-flexibility in dynamic load distribution, e.g., fixed UL carrier/BWP to perform RACH after initial selection.

Only preamble and wait for RAR before transmitting the payload part in MSG3 (similar to 4-step RACH in NR)

Discussions on 2-step/4-step RACH
-	Oppo thinks that for 6G we can use a different concept than 2 step RA
-	Qualcomm thinks that 4step is sufficient.  2step RA is low access latency and low access latency is not a key KPI for idle mode and for connected if we have CB-PUSCH then we don’t need it.  Also there is implementation complexity.  Xiaomi thinks that there are cases where the UE cannot send CB-PUSCH.
-	Ericsson thinks that we should study if we need a faster way from preamble to resource allocation.
-	Lenovo thinks that faster access is an important KPI.  We should design it so from gNB perspective it is seen a single procedure so we shouldn’t rule it out yet.
-	ZTE highlights that one important use case for 2step RA is NTN, which has very long RTT, and this is essential.    On the unification, we needed different RAR formats as 2step was added in later release and now we don’t have that problem as if we design from day one we can use one format and think that 2 step RA is the baseline.   Mediatek agrees and we shouldn’t add this in later release.
-	Samsung also see the benefits and there is no reason to exclude it from study, including how to address some of the identified issues.
-	LG agrees with ZTE and Xioami about latency benefit.
-	Sharp doesn’t think it is very essential as it can only be used when the signal condition are good.
-	CMCC thinks we can study whether to unify the PRACH and address such issues.
-	Huawei thinks that if NTN is the main reason then NTN folks need to support this.   ZTE thinks that NTN is one reason but we have other reasons including CP latency reduction.
-	Nokia supports 4 steps as a baseline and if we do 2step we can’t avoid partitioning.
-	Ofinno thinks that from functional point of view we can look at a unified design.
-	Apple also thinks it is too early to exclude anything
-	DLR also thinks unification is important for CB-PUSCH and RA
-	Mediatek reminds everyone that unification just means strive to find commonalities.

1	Study “2step” and “4step” RA.  After understanding the functionality, further study how and if the random access procedure can be unified/simplified.  FFS if and whether we can include CB-PUSCH in unification discussion only after some further progress on CB-PUSCH.

summary_zh: 材料指出，按 NR design，即使超过 90% 的数据已成功传输，数据仍需在 RLC buffer 中保留一个 RLC RTT period（>30ms）。
text_en: With NR’s design, data is required to remain in the RLC buffer for the RLC RTT period (>30ms), despite successful transmission of >90% of this data.

summary_zh: HARQ process 成功时，若在 DCI 中提供 ACK，可增强对误解读的鲁棒性，并可用于清除 L2 buffer。
text_en: If the ACK is provided in the DCI upon HARQ process success, it would be robust to misinterpretation and can be relied upon to clear the L2 buffer.

summary_zh: HARQ process 成功时在 DCI 中提供 ACK，可使 L2 buffer 需求减少 60–80%。
text_en: With an ACK provided in the DCI upon HARQ process success, there is a 60-80% reduction in L2 buffer needs.

summary_zh: 基于 ACK signalling 的内存需求减少可 effectively had for free。
text_en: The memory requirement reduction based on ACK signalling can be effectively had for free.

summary_zh: 通过 DCI 显式提供 HARQ ACK，可使 UE 避免冗余重传，并确保 MAC CEs 可靠交付。
text_en: Explicit HARQ ACK via DCI enables the UE to prevent redundant retransmissions and ensures the reliable delivery of MAC CEs.

summary_zh: 若 UE 指示的 ACK 设计为可抵御误解读，aNB 可据此清除其 L2 buffers，使 aNB 的 L2 buffer 需求减少 60–80%。
text_en: If the ACK indicated by the UE is designed to be robust to misinterpretation, it can be used by the aNB to clear its L2 buffers leading to 60-80% reduction in aNB’s L2 buffer needs.

summary_zh: DL 中，网络可随时终止现有 HARQ process，并立即转为类似 ARQ 的重传；UL 中不可行。
text_en: For DL, the network is free to terminate an existing HARQ process and move to an immediate ARQ like retransmission at any point in time. For UL, this is not feasible.

summary_zh: HARQ-assisted DL ARQ 有望显著降低 latency，同时不增加 RLC retransmission rate。
text_en: HARQ-assisted DL ARQ has the potential of significantly reducing latency without increasing RLC retransmission rate.

summary_zh: NACK-To-ACK/DTX-to-ACK error detection mechanism 的动机是 DL RLC latency，属于 RAN2 范围；具体机制可由 RAN1 研究。
text_en: The motivation for NACK-To-ACK/DTX-to-ACK error detection mechanism is DL RLC latency which is in RAN2 scope. The exact mechanism can be studied by RAN1.

summary_zh: DL 中 N2A/DTX2A error detection and reporting 的挑战之一，是尽量减少由非 PUCCH errors 引起的 HARQ terminations 所导致的冗余报告。
text_en: One challenge with N2A/DTX2A error detection and reporting in DL is minimizing redundant reporting based on HARQ terminations not caused by PUCCH errors.

summary_zh: DL 中，PUCCH errors 和 missed DCIs 会导致 residual HARQ errors，进而需要 NW 进行 RLC retransmission。
text_en: In DL, PUCCH errors and missed DCIs lead to residual HARQ errors, requiring an RLC retransmission at NW.

summary_zh: 高层 HOL blocking 主要有四类：Type 1 为 PDCP Rx window 内 Inter SDF intra DRB；Type 2 为 RLC Tx side 的 Intra/Inter-SDF intra-DRB。Type 3 为 RLC Tx side 的 PDCP data PDU 阻塞 PDCP control PDU；Type 4 为 Tx side control PDU 与 data PDU 之间的 Inter DRB 阻塞。
仿真结果显示，Type 1/2 HOL blocking 可能使网页下载延迟增加 80%。
text_en: Simulation results show that Type 1/2 HOL blocking issue may result in 80% more delay for web page downloading.

summary_zh: 5G radio bearer setup/release procedure 无法以可扩展、动态、高效且灵活的方式适应应用产生的动态、大量短 TCP/QUIC 连接。
text_en: 5G radio bearer setup/release procedure cannot adapt to the application's dynamic and massive short TCP/QUIC connections in a scalable, dynamic, efficient and flexible manner.

summary_zh: PDCP transmitter 的 HOL blocking 可由 UE/NW 实现充分处理。部分 QoS-related HOL blocking 可能发生在 RLC 的 Tx 与 ReTx buffers 之间。
text_en: HOL Blocking at PDCP transmitter can be adequately handled by UE/NW implementation. Some QoS-related HOL blocking can happen at RLC between Tx and ReTx buffers.

summary_zh: PDCP Rx 中，若某个 SDU 丢失，即使其他 SDU 属于不同 QoS flow，或无需等到该丢失 SDU 后再交付，也可能被滞留在 Rx buffer 中，从而发生 Head-of-line blocking。
text_en: Head-of-line blocking in PDCP Rx happens when a missing SDU causes other SDUs to be held in the Rx buffer even if they belong to a different QoS flow or otherwise do not need to be delivered after the missing SDU.

summary_zh: 对于 Rx HOL blocking，从协议或硬件角度看，单个 DRB 使用多个 Sequence Number spaces（用于 reordering）相比多个 DRB 各使用单个 Sequence Number space 没有优势。
text_en: For Rx HOL blocking issue, there is no advantage is supporting a single DRB with multiple Sequence Number spaces (for reordering) over multiple DRBs with a single Sequence Number space from a protocol or hardware standpoint.

summary_zh: 考虑到 6G 中 TB size 可能较大，交付已成功解码的 TB 部分可带来性能收益。
text_en: With the potential large TB sizes in 6G, delivering successfully decoded portions of TB would offer performance benefits.

summary_zh: 在 5G NR mechanism 中，单个 CB 或 CBG 不被视为可靠；未成功验证 TB CRC 时，不能将其独立交付给 MAC layer。
text_en: In the 5G NR mechanism, a single CB or CBG is not considered reliable and cannot be delivered to the MAC layer independently without successful TB CRC verification.

summary_zh: 启用将通过 CB-level CRC verification 的 CB/CBG 交付给 MAC，可部分解决 PHY layer HOL blocking：错误 CB/CBG 之前的 CB/CBG 将不再被阻塞。
text_en: The PHY layer HOL blocking issue could be partially solved by enabling delivery of CBs/CBGs passing CB-level CRC verification to MAC, i.e., CBs/CBGs before an error CB/CBG will not be blocked.

summary_zh: 从 RAN2 角度看，要完全解决 PHY layer HOL blocking，MAC 需要识别每个已交付 CB/CBG 中 MAC subPDUs 的边界。
text_en: From RAN2’s perspective, a solution to completely solve the PHY layer HOL blocking issue requires MAC to recognize the boundary of MAC subPDUs within each delivered CB/CBG.

summary_zh: 是否可以移除 TB-level CRC verification，以及 6G 是否保留 CBG，需要与 RAN1 确认。
text_en: Whether TB-level CRC verification can be removed and whether CBG will be retained in 6G should be checked with RAN1.

summary_zh: 当前 5G NR 的 MAC subPDU 准备与转发方式不支持提前转发 control 或 data subPDU。HARQ 重传中，相关 CB 已正确解码时仍会造成显著时延。
text_en: The current 5G NR approach for preparing and forwarding MAC subPDUs does not allow for early forwarding of control or data subPDUs. This results in significant latency in HARQ retransmission scenarios, when the relevant CB has already been decoded correctly.

summary_zh: Early forwarding of MAC CEs 和/或其他 control messages 与 PDCP HOL blocking issue 无关。
text_en: Early forwarding of MAC CEs and/or other control messages is not related to the PDCP HOL blocking issue.

summary_zh: RAN2 倾向于在 DCI 中为指定 HARQ process success 提供显式指示，以清除 UL L2 buffers。该指示如何传送由 RAN1 决定。
text_en: From RAN2 point of view, for clearing L2 buffers in UL, an explicit indication in DCI is preferred for a given HARQ process success. It is up to RAN1 how this is signalled.

summary_zh: UE 收到 HARQ process success indication 后，可清除 uplink L2 buffer 中对应的数据，且不预期继续 HARQ retransmissions。Mediatek 和 ZTE 说明，原意是在 NDI toggled 时发送 ACK，而非每次 transmission 都发送。
text_en:
Upon reception of HARQ process success indication, the UE can clear corresponding data from the uplink L2 buffer.  The UE is not expected to continue HARQ retransmissions after this indication is received.
-	Mediatek and ZTE explain that the intention was that the ACK would be sent when the NDI is toggled rather than for every transmission.
Noted
R2-2601661	Other UP functionality in 6G	Samsung, Verizon	discussion	Rel-20	FS_6G_Radio

summary_zh: RAN2 决定不继续推进 positive HARQ feedback assisted RLC enhancement，理由是其在 legacy RLC 之上的预期增益不显著或有限。讨论中提及 NACK 与 ACK 可利用同一 bit，以及 HARQ buffer 清理、RLC 恢复和可靠性等考虑。
text_en:
RAN2 to not pursue positive HARQ feedback assisted RLC enhancement, due to the expected gain is insignificant/marginal on top of legacy RLC.
Noted
Discussion
-	Mediatek highlights that both PDCCH and PDSCH have the same false positive probability.  Samsung thinks that DCI resource is scarce and variable and these benefits are marginal.   MEdiatek explains that we will need a bit for the NACK and the same bit can be used.  This is important for memory which is also a scarce resource lately.
-	ZTE thinks that we should ensure that there is no network requirement on when it sends it.   And the question is can we combine this with NDI.   With the NDI we would send a NACK and this same bit can also be used for the ACK.
-	Huawei agrees with ZTE, the network doesn’t always need to send.  There is a possibility of CRC passing but DCI is not decoded, but that is fine.
-	Apple agrees with Mediatek and explains that it is useful because the we can use the ACK a lot of the L2 timers which will release some resources and power saving gains.
-	LG has concerns on lossless operation. MEdiatek thinks that performance of DCI is very good and if it is good enough for URLLC it is good for eMBB.
-	Qualcomm also supports and indicates that it comes for free.  For reliability it is fairly safe to flush the HARQ buffer even if there are some errors as the RLC can recover.  For the RLC buffer that depends on how it is sent.
-	Vivo sees the benefits but we have to be careful with how we move the window and timer control.
-	Xiaomi thinks that we can implicitly assume it is there as the NACK will be in the DCI.
-	Interdigital doesn’t see an overhead issue as the bit is always there, so it is for free.   It can also maybe be used for MAC CE confirmation.
-	Ericsson thinks that it is up to RAN1 how they will design the NACK.  Also the blind decoding may be different.  What happens when you don’t receive the ACK as one the network may not want to send or there is reliability issue.  Mediatek agrees and RAN2 is just providing recommendation.  Blind decoding is not a big issue.   And there is no problem if we miss a DCI as you just continue keeping the data in your buffer.
-	ZTE wants to confirm that this will not impact max HARQ number of processes, it is just beneficial.   Companies confirm.
R2-2601575	Fast ARQ Retransmission and HOL Blocking Issue	Sharp	discussion	Rel-20	FS_6G_Radio

Explicit HARQ ACK is useful.

summary_zh: RAN2 将研究提高 PDSCH transmissions 的 HARQ feedback reliability、减少 HARQ residual errors 的机制，并研究 UE 能否检测特定 HARQ feedback error cases 且向 NW 指示潜在错误。讨论中对 UE feedback 可能带来的额外开销及其帮助 aNB 了解 HARQ internal status 的作用有不同看法。

Noted
Discussion
-	Apple thinks that even L1 reliability is perfect we may need to discuss some of the L2 aspects, but it can be stage 3 anyways.
-	ZTE thinks that feedback from UE may just introduce excessive overhead as the NW has various reasons it has moved on to new transmission.  Huawei agrees and remembers in the last meeting we already agreed that this is dependent on ACK to NACK error.
-	Lenovo explains that the aNB doesn’t know the HARQ internal status and this indication would help the aNB similar to UL.

summary_zh: 研究 type 1/2 HOL blocking 时应考虑应用流量特征：大量并发、动态且短生命周期的 TCP/QUIC connections（例如超过 100），以及指向多样服务器（包括第三方服务器）的多样 IP addresses。
解决 type 1/2 HOL blocking 的方案应考虑 scalability、latency、signalling overhead 和 flexibility。
text_en:
The solution to type 1/2 HOL blocking issue should take into account the scalability, latency, signalling overhead and flexibility.
Noted

summary_zh: 为缓解 higher layer HOL blocking，支持在 PDCP 层感知 QoS flow。研究选项包括在 PDCP Data PDU header 中通过 in-band signaling 携带 QFI，或由一个 PDCP entity 拆分到多个 RLC bearers 承载不同 QoS flows 或 QoS flow groups。
text_en:
To address the higher layer HOL blocking issue, QoS flow awareness in PDCP layer is supported by the following options:
Option 1: Use in-band signaling, i.e., QFI is included in the header of PDCP Data PDU.
Option 2: One PDCP entity can split into multiple RLC bearers to carry different QoS flows or QoS flow groups.

summary_zh: RAN2 将研究接收端避免 HOL blocking 的两种方案：接收 PDCP entity 为不同 QoS flows 或 QoS flow groups 维护不同队列，或为 DRB 中的 QoS flows 配置不同的 in-order delivery requirements。
text_en:
RAN2 to study the following approaches for avoiding HOL blocking at receiver:
Option 1: Receiving PDCP entity maintains different queues for different QoS flows or QoS flow groups.
Option 2: QoS flows in a DRB can be configured with different in-order delivery requirements.
Noted

summary_zh: HOL blocking 解决方案不应在 DRB 内引入多个 PDCP sequence number spaces。

summary_zh: 研究接收端对部分 PDCP SDUs 进行选择性处理并乱序转发至上层；如何识别这些 SDUs 及转发标准仍待讨论。研究将不考虑 DRB 内多个 PDCP sequence number spaces，并将接收端选择性处理与 QoS 和 differentiated treatment 一并讨论，同时研究 Type 3 和 Type 4 HOL blocking。
text_en:
To alleviate PDCP Rx HOL blocking, RAN2 to study if UE can forward some PDCP SDUs selectively out-of-order to upper layers. FFS on how those PDCP SDUs are identified and the criteria to forward them.
Noted
Type 1 (Inter SDF intra DRB HOL blocking at PDCP Rx window);
Type 2 (Intra/Inter-SDF intra-DRB HOL blocking at RLC Tx side);
Type 3 (Intra-DRB HOL blocking of PDCP control PDU by PDCP data PDU at RLC Tx side);
Type 4 (Inter DRB HOL blocking between control PDU and data PDU at Tx side).
Discussion
-	Mediatek sees value in splitting out SN space to not block some of the application.    The assumption of configuring them in different bearers never happened, as it is expensive for networks to configure multiple bearers but separate SN is easier.   Qualcomm thinks that is complex for the UE as we need to maintain separate buffers.  Huawei has the same understanding as Qualcomm.
-	ZTE thinks that the only reason a flow is mapped to same bearer is because they have the same PDB anyways.   So if there is a good reason to map it to a different bearer we do it.  If they have a same PDB there is no the HOL blocking.  Support some packet differentiation like TCP ACK.   LG, Nokia, Lenovo, Vivo and Apple also agrees and supports QC proposal.   Maintaining different SN/windows/buffer is complex.
-	Fraunhofer points out that different mapping hasn’t happened, so we can at least start with P6.
-	Nokia thinks type1 and 2 depend on what higher layer information and we shouldn’t rule out yet type 3 and 4.
-	Docomo thinks that we should have some differentiation within a DRB, but if separate SN is complex we can at least consider P6 from QC
-	Samsung also agrees with QC and it should be on a per packet basis.
-	Mediatek and Xiaomi rae sad because the SN solution is excluded.
-	Apple would like to have one solution to address the multiple issues identified across HOL blocking and QoS
Agreements on HOL
Study will not consider multiple PDCP sequence number spaces within the DRB.
For HOL blocking at the receiver, study selective treatment of some PDCP SDUs (e.g. packets like TCP ACK or services).  This should be discussed together with QoS and differentiated treatment discussion.
Study Type 3 (Intra-DRB HOL blocking of PDCP control PDU by PDCP data PDU at RLC Tx side) and Type 4 (Inter DRB HOL blocking between control PDU and data PDU at Tx side).
Not treated

R2-2602347	UL HARQ- and CSI feedback in 6G	Ericsson, MediaTek Inc., Charter Communications Inc., Turkcell, Jio Platforms, Kyocera, T-Mobile USA Inc., Ofinno, III, Anterix, CEWiT, Telstra, Deutsche Telekom, ASUSTek, AUMOVIO, Thales, ESA, LG Uplus, KDDI Corporation, NTHU, Bell Mobility	discussion	Rel-20
Observation 1	NR’s HARQ feedback for carrier aggregation requires tight coordination among involved schedulers which is very challenging in practical implementation.
Observation 2	Multiplexing HARQ feedback and CSI reports into PUCCH or PUSCH is complex and error-prone due to multiplexing rules and timeline restrictions.
Observation 3	The complexity of HARQ-FB and CSI reports and the way they are transmitted in NR became one of the biggest pain points for network and UE implementation.
Observation 4	MAC offers a generic framework of multiplexing control information and user data.
Observation 5	Explicit IDs for HARQ processes and CSI reports would make the reports self-contained which is a prerequisite for avoiding timeline- and multiplexing restrictions, inter-carrier dependencies and race conditions that were observed with NR’s L1 UCI.
Observation 6	The PUSCH’s in-built CRC and HARQ would avoid ACK(NACK errors in UL HARQ feedback and thereby reduce end-to-end latency spikes compared to NR’s RLC retransmissions.
Observation 7	The PUSCH’s in-built CRC and HARQ would make CSI feedback robust.
Proposal 1	Evaluate how different transmission schemes for UL HARQ- and CSI feedback affect the end-to-end performance for various applications. Evaluate for various bandwidths including the narrowest bandwidths of 6G, and evaluate various deployment scenarios including NTN. Choose a transmission scheme that offers the best performance/complexity trade-off and that avoids NR’s complicated timeline- and multiplexing restrictions.

summary_zh: 提出的 RRC CONNECTED state 中 “inactive sub-state” 有两种主要设计：其与 normal state 间的转换类似于基于 WUS 的 CDRX 设计中 “DRX ON” 与 “DRX OFF” 的转换。UE based mobility 设计采用 CLTM framework，并考虑额外的省电设计，例如不发送 measurement report。
text_en:
The proposed “inactive sub-state” in RRC CONNECTED state has two main designs:
The sub-state transition between inactive and normal is same as the transition between “DRX ON” and “DRX OFF” in the WUS based CDRX design.
The UE based mobility design utilizes the CLTM framework and considers additional power saving design (e.g. no measurement report).

summary_zh: 带有已存储 context 的 inactive/idle state 可能无法满足具有 bursty、delay-sensitive traffic 的设备需求。
text_en: An inactive/idle state with stored context is unlikely to meet the needs of devices with bursty, delay-sensitive traffic.

summary_zh: RRC_CONNECTED substate 可能无法满足低端 IoT 等具有 infrequent、delay-insensitive traffic 的设备需求。
text_en: An RRC_CONNECTED substate is unlikely to meet the needs of devices with infrequent, delay-insensitive traffic such as low-end IoT.

summary_zh: 一些可预见的用例更适合从低功耗 substate（例如基于 C-DRX）定期转换到 continuous downlink monitoring。
text_en: Some foreseeable use cases would be best served by regular transitions from a low-power substate (e.g., C-DRX-based) to continuous downlink monitoring.

summary_zh: 在 inactive state 下进行 small data exchange 时，网络无需为 UE 在邻区预留 dedicated radio resource。对于 MT 和 MO 两种情况，交换 small data 前无需进行 dedicated signalling 以配置资源。
text_en: For small data exchange in inactive state, Network is not required to reserve dedicated radio resource for the UE in the neighbour cells. When UE is in inactive state, dedicated signalling for resource configuration is not required before the small data exchange for both MT and MO cases.

summary_zh: 从 connected state 转换到 inactive state 应通过显式网络信令（例如 RRCRelease）完成，并受到安全保护。
text_en: The state transition from connected state to inactive state should be done via explicit network signalling (e.g. RRCRelease) that is security protected.

summary_zh: inactive state 应支持 UE based mobility 的 cell selection 和 reselection；该状态不适用 connected mode RLM/RRM，且 UE power consumption 应与 idle state 相当。
text_en:
Cell selection and reselection should be supported as UE based mobility for inactive state. No connected mode RLM/RRM is applicable for the inactive state and the UE power consumption in inactive state should be comparable to that of idle state.

Delta Signalling

summary_zh: 支持 delta signalling 的字段（逻辑必选字段除外）还必须提供释放手段，可显式信令释放或在缺失时隐式释放。将继续评估 “partial full config” 与 “release by default + signal to keep” 的稳健性和信令开销，并研究参数化 delta-signalling lists、configuration constraints、extensible ID 及列表扩展等方向。
text_en:
All fields (except for fields that should always be configured(i.e. logically mandatory fields)) that support delta signalling (i.e., the possibility to maintain/keep their previous value) shall also offer means to release them (explicitly by signalling or implicitly upon absence).
Continue discussions on refining the proposed delta signalling solution directions (“partial full config”, “release by default + signal to keep”) and continue their evaluation in terms of robustness and signalling overhead. Investigate whether it is meaningful to combine them in some way. Take related aspects into account (e.g. “configuration constraints”).
3	Continue discussions on analysing and quantifying the listed (potential) benefits and drawbacks of OCTET STRINGs in terms of message size and processing time. Aim to derive rules in which cases (message size, number of extensions, …) OCTET STRINGs should be used or avoided.
4	Aim to introduce a parameterized type to generalize the handling of delta-signalling lists (instead of NR’s separate- and case-specific lists for AddMod- and Release). Discuss further details of such (e.g. whether and how to support release+add) taking agreements on delta signalling and configuration constraints into account.
5	RAN2 should aim to capture at least typical constraints (setup vs. modify) in the signalling structure.   FFS the details and how/when to apply it
6	RAN2 should introduce configuration constrains when it is necessary to rule out some configuration.
7	Consider the extensible ID (CHOICE of INTEGERs) as a tool in the toolbox that could serve as a safety net when it is difficult to predict the required size of IDs (and lists) that are difficult to extend by other means. RAN2 will decide on a case-by-cases basis, whether and where to use extensible IDs.
8	Study and discuss further in which scenarios parallel lists have benefits over per-element extensions and over critical extensions of the entire lists. Investigate also the signalling overhead of the different solutions for practical sizes of lists.
9	Continue study lists extensions.

summary_zh: NR 的 delta signalling 会导致 gNB 在过多情况下必须应用 full configuration，因为它无法确定能可靠地使 UE 与 gNB 配置状态一致的 delta-configuration。
text_en: NR’s delta signalling results in too many cases where the gNB must apply a full configuration since it cannot determine a delta-configuration that brings UE and gNB reliably to the same configuration state.

summary_zh: 较早 ASN.1 version 的 target gNB 可跳过消息末尾无法理解的 extensions 和 NCEs，但若 source gNB 使用 target 版本中声明为 spare (NULL) 的新 CHOICE option，target gNB 将无法解码消息剩余部分。
text_en: A target gNB implementing an earlier ASN.1 version can skip non-comprehended extensions and NCEs at the end of the message. But it fails to decode the remainder of the message when the source gNB uses e.g. a newly defined CHOICE option that was declared as spare (NULL) in the target gNB’s ASN.1 version.

summary_zh: 若 UE 发现其实现版本之后版本的扩展，可假定存在网络或传输错误，并应声明无法遵从该配置。
text_en: If a UE discovers extensions of a later release than it implements, it may assume a network- or transmission error and should declare that it cannot comply with the configuration

summary_zh: Need codes 在 ASN.1 注释、字段描述、条件表和流程文本中较脆弱，难以可靠自动处理。这会导致 gNB 过于频繁地回退到完整配置。
text_en: Need codes in ASN.1 comments, field descriptions, condition tables and procedural text are fragile, and handling thereof cannot be automated reliably. This contributes to the problem that gNBs fall back to a full configuration too often.

summary_zh: 默认保留（“Need M”）且不支持显式释放（SetupRelease）的字段，可能造成显著信令开销，并导致完整配置过多。该项已记下。
text_en:
Fields that are kept by default (“Need M”) and that do not offer means for explicit release (SetupRelease), can cause substantial signalling overhead and to the observed problem of too many full configurations.

summary_zh: 6GR 的 (re)configuration failure handling 研究应同时致力于使 UE 能向 NW 提供有关错误或不适用配置的充分信息，并尽可能减少 UE 与 NW 间的服务中断。
text_en: Study on (re)configuration failure handling in 6GR should aim at both enabling the UE to provide sufficient information to the NW on erroneous/inapplicable configurations and reducing service interruption between UE and the NW as much as possible.

summary_zh: 支持 UE 在 6GR 中报告导致 (re)configuration failure 的错误或不适用配置，即 UE 只能应用部分 RRC reconfiguration。需要进一步确定哪些配置失败须报告，以及报告粒度。
text_en: Support UE reporting of the erroneous/inapplicable configurations to the NW for (re)configuration failure (i.e. UE can only apply a part of RRC reconfiguration) in 6GR. FFS the specific configurations whose failure needs to be reported and the reporting granularity for such configurations.

summary_zh: RAN2 以三类候选方案为基线继续研究：Enhanced RRC Re-establishment、Partial (re)configuration success，以及不进行 Re-establishment 或 partial (re)configuration 的 failure information reporting。方案涵盖 UE 重建时报告、应用可用配置并报告问题配置，或继续使用当前配置／NW 配置的 fallback/default 配置恢复通信并报告问题配置。
text_en:
RAN2 further studies how to avoid UE service interruption and/or enable the UE reporting of erroneous/inapplicable configurations in 6GR upon (re)configuration failure, taking the following candidate solutions as the baseline:
1.	Enhanced RRC Re-establishment
	Solution 1-A: UE triggers RRC Re-establishment during which the erroneous/inapplicable configurations are reported to the NW;
2.	Partial (re)configuration success
	Solution 2-A: UE applies the good/appliable configurations and ignores the erroneous/inapplicable configurations which are reported to the NW, if the reconfiguration failure happens to the "non-critical" configurations; otherwise, UE triggers RRC reestablishment.
	Solution 2-B: UE applies the good/appliable configurations and reports the erroneous/inapplicable configurations for which the UE applies default/fallback values configured by the NW, if reconfiguration failure happens to "non-critical" configurations; otherwise, UE triggers RRC re-establishment.
3.	(Re)configuration failure information reporting w/o Re-establishment or partial (re)configuration
	Solution 3-A: UE continues using the current configurations to resume its communication and reports to the NW the erroneous/inapplicable configuration(s) (based on which NW may decide to keep the UE continuing with the current configuration or perform further reconfiguration).
	Solution 3-B: UE applies the NW-configured fallback/default configuration to resume its communications, and reports the erroneous/inapplicable configuration parameter(s) to the NW (where the fallback/default configuration may include minimum set of configurations that enable UE's basic data transfer).

summary_zh: 一般原则是 UE 的 (re)configuration failure handling 应由 NW 控制。NW 如何控制 UE 行为，待采用具体方案后进一步确定。
text_en: As a general principle, (re)configuration failure handling by the UE should be under NW control. FFS how the NW controls UE behaviour for (re)configuration handling, pending the specific solution to be adopted.

summary_zh: RAN2 下一步将分析 Proposal 3 所列候选方案的 pros and cons。R2-2601990 提议不定义 partial application 或 critical/non-critical 参数分类，并研究简化 RRC connection re-establishment，以便恢复 user data transfer、向 NW 报告失败及其原因；会议讨论意见对部分配置、报告和优化重建程序有不同看法。
text_en:
RAN2 carries out the pros and cons analyses for the listed candidate solutions in Proposal 3, as the next step for 6GR (re)configuration failure study.
Noted
R2-2601990	Simplified RRC connection re-establishment for RRC reconfiguration failure	MediaTek Inc., Nokia, Huawei, HiSilicon	discussion	Rel-20	FS_6G_Radio
Proposal 1 	Do not define partial application of the RRC configuration in RRC reconfiguration failure or categorization of the UE configuration parameters to critical and non-critical parameters in 6GR.
Proposal 2 	RAN2 to study improvement on RRC reconfiguration failure (non-mobility scenario) handling in 6GR based on a simplified RRC connection re-establishment procedure, in which the UE applies simple physical layer and MAC configurations for the purposes of re-establishment signalling, in which cell search, security key update, and bearer re-establishment are not performed, and during which the user data transfer is resumed without subsequent RRC reconfiguration procedure.
Proposal 3	After triggering the simplified RRC connection re-establishment procedure, the UE signals the network about it. This signalling identifies the UE in unambiguous and secure manner. The network responds with reconfiguration of the UE with more sophisticated physical layer and MAC configurations for the user data transfer to continue. Signalling during the procedure could also let the network know which part(s) of RRC reconfiguration caused the RRC reconfiguration failure.
Noted
Discussion
-	Qualcomm explains that the main problem was not being able to apply one minor configuration and now we are making things worst.   The intention is to not always do re-establishment.
-	Huawei thinks that improved re-establishment is improving service interruption as it is not the usual re-establishment.  The network would reconfigure the UE.   Xiaomi thinks that we can’t avoid the interruption as we need to do random access.
-	CMCC would like to understand the main issue and according to the real field results this happens very rarely 2% amongst the re-establishment failures that also occur 2% of the time.   We can just report something and that’s it.   Qualcomm thinks that the network doesn’t know why it happens, 27% of failure happen because of network configuration.  CATT agrees with CMCC.
-	Ericsson agrees that we can get more information from the UE but this doesn’t mean that a new configuration will be provided.   We should make sure that the network is aware of the issue as soon as possible.   We won’t be able to get rid of the re-establishment procedure and we shouldn’t allow a partial reconfiguration as this may cause a misalignment.   ZTE has the same concerns and solution 2 and 3 don’t work from network perspective.   There are some benefits from improving the procedure by for example not triggering the full re-establishment procedure on other cells, just trigger it on the current cell.   Xiaomi explains that the UE would report which part of the configuration it applied, for example SCell configuration, or configuration on CHO canadidate cells.   In this case the PCell connection can still work.
-	Oppo agrees with ZTE and Ericsson and there seems to be complexity in the partial configuration.  However, they are open to optimize the procedure and see what can be saved.
-	Samsung thinks that even if we don’t standardize the UE can still do partial configuration so we should enhance the procedure to support some reporting and study how to enhanced.
-	Nokia thinks that there are ways to improve the re-establishment procedure, by skipping cell reselection, UP resetting etc.
-	Lenovo thinks that at least we report it to the network.   Qualcomm thinks that telling the network I couldn’t is not useful, it needs to tell more to the NW.
-	Apple thinks that even today we have some workaround that doesn’t require the UE to re-establish and this is now forcing the UE to always do re-establish.    Anyways, we have UE reporting.
-	LG agrees that the UE needs to report the problem and the reason of the problem.
-	Vivo thinks that partial configuration is a good option and it is already an implementation workaround.
-	Interdigital thinks that there will some cases where re-establishment is needed and for the reporting we can either report right away or after re-establishment.

summary_zh: 研究如何高效存储和复用 RRC configurations，以支持至少在同一 serving cell 内频繁的 RRC state transitions 或 configuration changes。
text_en: Study how to efficiently store and reuse RRC configurations for frequent RRC state transitions or configuration changes at least in the same serving cell.

summary_zh: 研究网络按需激活 stored RRC configurations 的用法，覆盖转入 CONNECTED 以及 CONNECTED mode 期间。
text_en: Study use of stored RRC configurations that can be activated in an on-demand manner by the network for both transition to CONNECTED and during CONNECTED mode.

summary_zh: RAN2 研究并采用 6G RRC 的 Reference Configuration framework，网络通过指示 Identifier (ID) 或 Index 来配置 UE，使其引用一组已知的 baseline parameters。
text_en: RAN2 to study and adopt a Reference Configuration framework for 6G RRC, allowing the network to configure the UE by indicating an Identifier (ID) or Index that refers to a known set of baseline parameters (e.g., a reference configuration, stored configuration, or predefined profile).

summary_zh: 研究如何通过高效 signalling（例如 modular RRC）使网络能在 activation time 修改 stored configurations，以适配动态分配的资源，例如 UE-specific resources 中的 C-RNTI 和 PUCCH resources。
text_en: Study how to enable efficient signalling (e.g. via a modular RRC) to allow network to modify stored configurations at activation time for dynamically allocated resources (e.g. UE-specific resources such as C-RNTI and PUCCH resources).

summary_zh: stored configurations 应支持 delta signalling，使网络能在同一消息中激活 baseline stored configuration 并携带特定 parameter modifications（deltas）。讨论中提及同一 serving cell、RRC inactive、CONNECTED mode、CA configuration 等场景，并指出 UE behavior 和所保存内容仍需澄清。
text_en:
The stored configurations should support delta signalling, allowing the network to activate a baseline stored configuration with specific parameter modifications (deltas) in the same message.
-	Ericsson points out we had reference configuration in 5G but they didn’t work well.   If we make delta signaling that actually is efficient we don’t need to have stored configurations.  Maintaining the reference with mobility has some complexity.    Mediatek has the same understanding as Ericsson on reference configuration.   Proposal 5 is complex.
-	Nokia explains that the proposal is for at least the same serving cell that avoids the mobility related issues, and we should avoid the reference configuration issues we introduced in 5G.
-	Oppo asks what is the dependency on modular RRC.  Nokia thinks it would work well with modular but it is not dependent on it.
-	Huawei agrees with Ericsson and in 5G the usage of reference configuration was very loosely specified and if we want something with even more flexibility it is even more complex.   Also agrees with meditek that we are doing a delta on a stored config which is complex.  Nokia explains that we are doing that for inactive.  We get a delta on top of stored config.
-	Xiaomi ask based on what information would the network configure the UE for later use.    Nokia explains that it depends on what the network wants to enable for the UE.  For example voice call or data, or something that the NW can learn.
-	Qualcomm thinks the intent is good to improve things from 5G, like improving reference config from 5G.   So we should study how to improve.
-	Lenovo asks how is this different from RRC inactive.   Nokia explain that it is one of the use cases.   We can see how to enable this in connected and aim to have the same solution.
-	LG thinks this can be very useful for CA configuration case.
-	ZTE asks if it is only for common or only for dedicated config.  What is on-demand.  Nokia explain that ondemand means it is under network control.  Common config is a monster we should avoid.
-	Apple thinks that this is very valuable.
-	Ericsson thinks that we need to clarify UE behavior with this configuration, and what we are saving.
