Observation 1-4: 	In NR, the implicit and explicit SI window(s) determination mechanisms can be used together to reduce the overhead of SI configurations and improve the flexibility of SI window configurability for some SI messages.

summary_zh: RAN2 将研究结合 explicit window start positions（per SI message configurable position）与基于 scheduling list 顺序的 implicit window start positions。原文指出，每个 SI window 仅支持 SI window granularity offset 可能增加 common signalling 总发送时长；结合该 offset 与适用于所有 SI windows 的 SFN 或 slot granularity offset 可使首个 SI window 紧接 SIB1 或其他 common signals 开始，并减少开销。
text_en:
RAN2 to study supporting a mixed use of explicit window start positions (per SI message configurable position) and implicit window start positions (based on the order of SI message in the scheduling list) as in NR.
Observation 2-3:	Only supporting the SI window granularity offset for each SI window (as si-WindowPosition introduced in NR R17) may not allow the SI window of the first SI message to start immediately after SIB1 or other common signals. This will cause an increase in the total duration for sending the common signalling, which is not beneficial for network energy saving.
Observation 2-4:	Introducing the SFN or slot granularity offset for each SI window generates unnecessary overhead, and will render the implicit SI window unusable.
Observation 2-5:	Supporting the SI window granularity offset for each SI window (as si-WindowPosition introduced in NR R17) and introducing an SFN or slot granularity offset for all SI windows (i.e., Method 2) enables the SI window of the first SI message to start immediately after SIB1 or other common signals with minimal overhead.

summary_zh: RAN2 将研究在 per-SI-window、SI window granularity start position 之外，为所有 SI windows 配置 SFN 或 slot granularity start position，以便将 SI transmission 与其他 common broadcast signalling 聚集。关于 per-SI-message SI-window width 的讨论意见不一，原文未给出结论。
text_en:
RAN2 to study a configurable start position of all SI windows (with SFN or slot granularity) in addition the per SI window start position (with SI window granularity, as si-WindowPosition introduced in NR R17), so that the SI transmission can be clustered with other common broadcast signalling.
Noted
Discussion per-SI-message configuration of SI-window width?
-	Vivo
-	Huawei thinks that if we have explicit and implicit, we have a single width.   CATT also thinks that both explicit and implicit help with the shortcomings.
-	Nokia thinks it is simple, that the windows are consequitive, we should at least configure the first window, but not sure if we need the subsequent windows, may be nice.  Nokia thinks that it is not a big problem even if the length is different it is not a problem.
-	Interdigital thinks it is important to have different SI window length as we will also have different types of devices and longer time/ messages and also offset to allow for power saving.
-	CMCC minimum SI length and for larger they can use multiple of minimum SI length, so we can save bits.
-	Vivo would like to avoid impact to the UE and whats important is that the behaviour is the same from the UE side.
-	Lenovo thinks that allowing multiple SIs in in one fixed window length, is not acceptable for UEs.

summary_zh: 对于 non-broadcasting SI，其 SI window position 不在 SIB1 中预留；broadcast status 通过 SIB1 modification 改变，并遵循与其他 system information changes 相同的 SI modification period。临时 OD-SI transmission 的 reception window 可通过 SI request 响应或预定义时机上的 L1 signalling 指示给 UE。
text_en:
To address the problem of reserving SI window for currently non-broadcasted SI, RAN2 support the solution as follows:
-	The SI window position of SI whose broadcast status is ‘non-broadcasting’, is not pre-reserved in SIB1. Broadcast status change is performed via SIB1 modification, and follows the SI modification period like other system information changes.
-	For temporary OD-SI transmission, its reception window is indicated to the UE via the response to the SI request, or via the L1 signalling transmitted on pre-defined occasions, or the OD-SI is indicated to the UE via the response to the SI request.

summary_zh: RAN2 将进一步研究解决未广播 SI message 预留 SI window 问题的三种方案：有 SI 未广播时将 SI windows 前移、将 on-demand SI 的 SI windows 配置在 SI transmission period 末尾，以及在 SI request 后提供 dynamically allocated windows 的 SI scheduling information。
text_en:
RAN2 further study the three solutions for the problem of reserving SI window for not broadcasting SI message: 1) Moving SI windows forward when some SI are not being broadcast; 2) Configuring SI windows of on-demand SI at the end of the SI transmission period; 3) SI scheduling information of dynamically allocated windows provided upon SI request

R2-2603244	System Information for 6G	Ericsson	discussion	Rel-20
Observation 1	Multiplexing SIBs/SI messages with different periodicities within the same TB is of limited use because of the limited TBS and forces a UE to decode SIBs/SI messages which it may not be interested in.
Proposal 2	The following options for transmission of multiple SI messages within an SI window can be discussed further:
- Option 1 (TDM): The SI messages are transmitted sequentially in time within the SI window. The start of the next SI message transmission is indicated dynamically on PDCCH using e.g. different SI-RNTI or indication in DCI.
- Option 2 (FDM): The SI messages are transmitted on different parts of the carrier bandwidth (e.g. using different CORESETs or BWPs). A bandwidth limited UE may need to acquire different SI messages sequentially, e.g. SI1 in the first period and SI2 in the second period.

summary_zh: RAN2 应将 SI scheduling study 拆分为两个目标：优先建立 extensible、unified SI scheduling baseline framework，并考虑 R17 configurable starting position；另一个目标是研究更短时间内接收 SI 的机制，并重新评估 power-saving gains、相关影响及与其他 NES features（如 OD-SIB）的比较。
text_en:
RAN2 should decouple the study of SI scheduling into separate targets:
Target 1 (Prioritize): Establish an extensible and unified SI scheduling scheme as the baseline framework. Consider R17 configurable starting position as baseline.
Target 2: Mechanisms for receiving SIs in a shorter period of time. Reevaluate the realistic power-saving gains and the corresponding impacts in different directions, while concurrently comparing them against alternative NES features (e.g., OD-SIB)

Support having gaps between Paging PF/PO within a cluster  (i.e., clustered paging)
Support configuration of multiple paging occasions associated with a paging frame
Support configuration of PO/PF close to common signals e.g. with SSB transmission
We aim to distribute UEs among Paging PO/PF
A RRC paging message should be able to address multiple UEs (e.g. like paging records in 5G).
Should be possible to have one or multiple paging clusters per UE paging DRX cycle.

Reach UEs in idle state and inactive state, through Paging messages.
Notify UEs at least in RRC Idle/Inactive states of system information change and ETWS/CMAS indications.  FFS whether SI change and ETWS/CMAS in RRC connected.
From RAN2 point of view, the paging capacity (including paging records) in 6G should be at least the same level as 5G.

summary_zh: RAN2 需研究 FR1+FR2 非共址场景中最高 10ms backhaul delay 对 CA 和 DC 的协议、接口、性能以及 UP/CP 的影响，并评估可满足的需求和简化 DC 的可行性。工作分为阶段一影响分析和阶段二协议层评估及方案比较，期限为 Long。
text_en:
For both CA and DC there are performance limitation because of the 10ms backhaul delays
For CA, if the backhaul delay can be transparent from the UE, CA can work up to some backhaul delay.  Some evaluations have shown that it works when X is very short, but the value of X also depends on network implementation.  If X is long, then there are protocol, performance, interface impacts and needs to be further studied.
DC is defined to handle long backhaul delays, but concerns on complexity and performance are raised, so need to study further the impact to UP, CP, and whether it can be simplified.
RAN2 needs to study for FR1 + FR2 scenario and understand the protocol impacts, performance impacts, and how if some of the requirements are met for CA and DC.
[POST134][15][6G CP] Non-ideal backhaul (Xiaomi)
Intended outcome: Impact analysis of non-collocated FR1+FR2 scenarios with backhaul delays up to 10ms.
Phase 1
Identify the protocol, interface, where/how the data is split for dual scheduler, dual PUCCH, and performance for CA framework and understand the required changes to support it.
Identify the impacts to UP, CP of supporting DC, where/how data is split, performance impacts, if and how simplified DC can work.
Understand which requirements can be met for the various solutions (e.g. deployment flexibility, aggregation)
Phase 2
Evaluation (whenever available) at protocol level and assumptions used (including scheduler assumed – companies are encouraged to ensure that dual scheduler is included in the evaluation).  Dual PUCCH is assumed for evaluation purposes.
Attempt to compare the gains, advantages, disadvantages of all solutions
Deadline:  Long

summary_zh: 在 5G CA 中，UL CC 数量不得超过 DL CC 数量的限制，使系统难以适应不同的 UL/DL 流量负载，尤其是 UL 流量较重时。
text_en: In 5G CA, due to the restriction of UL CCs no more than DL CCs, it is hard to adapt to different UL/DL traffic load, especially for the UL heavy traffic.

summary_zh: 在 5G CA 的某些情况下，例如将 serving SCell 切换为 PCell，执行 HO 会造成不必要的中断和 signaling overhead。
text_en: In 5G CA, in some cases, such as changing the serving SCell to PCell, the execution of HO will cause unnecessary interruption and signalling overhead.

summary_zh: 在 5G CA 中，即使 SCell 仍可用，PCell RLF 也会导致 RRC re-establishment。由此会造成不必要的中断和 signaling overhead。
text_en: In 5G CA, the PCell RLF will cause RRC re-establishment even if the SCell is still available, which will cause unnecessary interruption and signalling overhead as well.

summary_zh: 在 NR 中，各频段的 duplex mode（TDD 或 FDD）及 uplink/downlink directions 被严格规定。SUL 严重依赖已定义的 SUL carriers，且 NR CA 不支持 UL-only SCell。
text_en: In NR, the duplex mode (TDD or FDD) and uplink/downlink directions of each frequency band are strictly specified, SUL is heavily dependent on the defined SUL carriers and UL-only SCell is not supported for NR CA.

summary_zh: 对于 backhaul latency 较高（例如 10ms）的部署，single scheduler operation 在 HARQ、CSI 和 ARQ 运行方面存在显著问题。该方式也不适用于 inter-vendor deployment。
text_en: For deployments where the backhaul latency is significant (e.g. 10ms), single scheduler operation has significant issues in operation of HARQ, CSI, ARQ and also not feasible for inter-vendor deployment.

summary_zh: 节点未共址但 backhaul latency 不大时，central scheduler 可通过提前若干 slots 管理时延，使通常的 co-located CA operation 可运行。何时根据 backhaul delay 使用 single 或 dual scheduler 可由 NW implementation 决定。
text_en: On the other hand, if the backhaul latency is not large (which the nodes are still not co-located), the central scheduler can manage the delay transparently to the UE (for eg., operating ‘n’ slots in advance) such that the usual co-located CA operation can work. It can be up to NW implementation on when they can decide to use single vs dual scheduler based on their backhaul delay.

summary_zh: 10ms backhaul latency 会因 HARQ RTT 增加而显著提高 L2/HARQ memory buffer 的需求。
text_en: A 10ms backhaul latency would significantly increase L2/HARQ memory buffer requirements at the due to increase in the HARQ RTT.

summary_zh: 10ms backhaul latency 会使 centralized scheduling decisions 效率显著降低，因为 BSR、CQI、PHR 等关键状态信息到达 central MAC entity 时已过时。
text_en: A 10ms backhaul latency renders centralized scheduling decisions highly inefficient, as critical status information (e.g., BSR, CQI, PHR) becomes outdated by the time it is received by the central MAC entity.

summary_zh: 在 10ms backhaul 下依赖 single scheduler，会严重降低时延敏感 MAC procedures 的性能，包括 SCell activation/deactivation 和 MAC CE transmissions。
text_en: Relying on a single scheduler across a 10ms backhaul severely degrades the performance of latency-sensitive MAC procedures, such as SCell activation/deactivation and MAC CE transmissions.

summary_zh: 对于低 backhaul latency（例如 2ms）的非共址部署，single-scheduler Carrier Aggregation architecture 可能可行；对于最高 10ms 的时延则可能不可行。
text_en:
While a single-scheduler Carrier Aggregation architecture may be feasible for non-collocated deployments with low backhaul latency (e.g., 2ms), it is likely not feasible for latencies of upto 10ms.
Dual Scheduler Deployment – DC
R2-2603836	6G Spectrum aggregation for FR1-FR2 deployments	Verizon, Qualcomm Inc, Samsung, NTT DOCOMO, Orange	discussion	Rel-20	FS_6G_Radio

summary_zh: 在具有较大 backhaul delay 的 dual/independent scheduler 场景中，转发至 FR2 cell 的 user data 应至少位于 MAC layer 之上。
text_en: For dual/independent scheduler case with large backhaul delay, the user data forwarding to FR2 cell should be at least above the MAC layer (i.e. not the MAC layer).

summary_zh: 若多个 NW schedulers 控制同一 UE 不同 cells 的调度，它们需要紧密协调；否则会增加 UE HARQ requirements，并对 HARQ/ARQ 和 RLC performance（如 (re)segmentation）产生负面影响。
text_en: If multiple NW schedulers control the scheduling for the same UE on different cells, there needs to be tight coordination between these schedulers; otherwise, this can add UE HARQ requirements as well as negatively affect HARQ/ARQ and RLC performance (e.g. (re)segmentation).

summary_zh: 在 4G/5G CA 中，不同 DL transmission points 间的 backhaul latency 假定为 ideal，即微秒量级。对于涉及多个 eNB/gNB/DU 向同一 UE 传输的 non-ideal backhaul，使用 DC。
text_en: In 4G/5G, in CA, it assumed that the backhaul latency between different DL transmission points is ‘ideal’, i.e. in the order of microseconds. For non-ideal backhaul, DC is used when multiple eNB/gNB/DU are involved in transmission to the same UE.

summary_zh: NR CA 已支持用于 non-collocation scenarios 的 PUCCH SCell 和 sTAG。该支持可应用于采用 non-ideal backhaul 的 non-collocated CA。
text_en: NR CA already supports PUCCH SCell and sTAG for non-collocation scenarios. It can be applied to non-collocated CA with non-ideal backhaul.

summary_zh: 在 NR non-collocated CA 中，BSR、PHR、RACH 和 SCell activation 等 time-critical MAC functionalities 可能因 backhaul delay 而性能下降。
text_en: In NR non-collocated CA, time-critical MAC functionalities (e.g., BSR, PHR, RACH, and SCell activation) may have degraded performances due to the backhaul delay.

summary_zh: 为 non-collocated CA 配置多个 PUCCH cell groups 和多个 TAGs 时，MAC entity 仍是单一逻辑实体，RLC 和 PDCP 层对底层 CC 拓扑透明。因此，co-located 与 non-collocated CA 的 UP handling 保持一致。
text_en: When multiple PUCCH cell groups and multiple TAGs are configured for non-collocated CA, the MAC entity remains a single logical entity, and the RLC and PDCP layers are transparent to the underlying CC topology. Hence UP handling remains consistent between co-located and non–co-located CA scenarios.

summary_zh: 6G UP 中，RAN2 正在研究采用 unified SN 的 UP architecture，以及基于 HARQ feedback 的 L2 ARQ handling。尽管该研究中部分已同意的设计假设可能影响 non-collocated CA operation，RAN2 应避免为其定义相较于 6G SA 的独立 UP architecture。
text_en: In 6G UP, RAN2 is studying UP architecture with unified SN, along with HARQ feedback based L2 ARQ handling. While some of the agreed design assumptions of this study could influence non-co-located CA operation, RAN2 should avoid defining a separate UP architecture for the non-co-located case compared to 6G SA.

summary_zh: 在 5G-like DC 中，flow control 和 separate RLC buffers 相较于理想 CA throughput 会导致至少约 20% 的 throughput reduction。
text_en: With 5G-like DC, the flow control and separate RLC buffers will cause at least ~20% throughput reduction compared to the ideal CA throughput.

summary_zh: 采用 10ms 时，non-collocated CA performance 仍属合理，并且优于 single carrier performance。
text_en: Non-collocated CA performance with 10ms is still reasonable and provides gains over single carrier performance.

summary_zh: Table-2 对比了采用 dual PUCCH group 的 CA 与 DC operation：CA 在 configuration/control operation 方面效率更高，但 deployment 和 operational flexibility 较低。
text_en: Table-2 shows the CA with dual PUCCH group comparison with DC operation. It can be observed that CA brings in more efficiency in terms of configuration/control operation compared to DC, while sacrificing deployment and operational flexibility.

summary_zh: CA 的功能效率会受到 single RLC 和 MAC functionality 的影响，原因包括 backhaul 带来的 L2 ARQ traversal delay，以及某些 MAC runtime operation 相关参数的传递延迟。若 UL 限制为 one leg（non-split bearer operation），尤其选用无需 BH traversal 的 leg，CA operation 会优于 DC。
text_en: CA also has functional inefficiencies due to single RLC and MAC functionality with the delay that the backhaul brings for L2 ARQ traversal, or certain MAC runtime operation related parameter traversal. However, if we restrict the UL to one leg (non-split bearer operation) esp. to the leg that does not require the BH traversal, CA operation would be much better than DC.

summary_zh: 每个 FR1 cell 支持的 FR2 cells 数量限制了可与每个 FR2 cell 聚合的 FR1 spectrum 数量，从而限制 FR1-FR2 spectrum aggregation 的收益。
text_en: The number of FR2 cells supported per FR1 cell limits the amount of FR1 spectrum that can be aggregated with each FR2 cell, limiting the benefit of FR1-FR2 spectrum aggregation.

summary_zh: 通过 FR1 与 FR2 aNBs 之间 10ms non-ideal backhaul 聚合 FR1 和 FR2 spectrum，会影响整体 performance。额外的 packet re-ordering delay 会影响 achievable throughput 和 latency。
text_en: Aggregating FR1 and FR2 spectrum via a 10ms non-ideal backhaul between FR1 and FR2 aNBs will impact the overall performance, both in terms of achievable throughput (due to the additional packet re-ordering delay) and latency.

summary_zh: 聚合 FR1 和 FR2 上不对称的 data rates 可能进一步降低 TCP performance，整体表现也可能低于仅使用 FR2。
text_en: Aggregating asymmetric data rates on FR1 and FR2 may cause further performance degradation on TCP and overall lower performance than using FR2 alone.

summary_zh: RAN2 将在研究 CONNECTED mode 下的 multi-carrier operations 时考虑 5G CA 的若干不足：PCell 与 SCell 的配置和操作分离、PCell RLF 后无法 recovery、PCell/SCell role change 困难、SCell（及 CA）激活或添加较慢，以及载波组合（UL/DL）静态。材料还指出，PCell change 会触发 HO，PCell RLF 会触发 RRC re-establishment，造成不必要的中断和 signalling overhead；PCell re-establishment 会丢弃所有 SCells。

-	HO procedure is always triggered upon PCell change causing unnecessary interruption and signalling overhead;

summary_zh: 非共址场景的 single scheduler 方案中，MAC/PHY 间分拆因两者紧耦合而难以实现，PHY 内分拆则因需传输量化 I/Q 频域样本而对回传带宽要求高。模拟 RF 信号透明转发的时延通常为微秒级且无需类似 NTN 的方案，但其功能限制较大，尤其在 FR2。
text_en:
For protocol split between scheduler and RRU/TRP in single scheduler option of non-collocated scenarios, the identified issues are:

-	Split within PHY requires substantial requirements on the backhaul bandwidth due to the transmission of quantized I/Q frequency domain samples, and solution similar to NTN might be required.
-	Transparent forwarding of analog RF signals typically has microsecond level delay and does not required solution similar to NTN, but the functionality is quite limiting especially for FR2 operation.

- Decodability refers to the capability to decode and interpret the content of the data
- Visibility refers to the capability to determine how the received data should be handled

summary_zh: 条目提出 termination point 应具备 full visibility，以决定路由、处理或本地终止数据，并以此为基线研究至少适用于 AI/ML 的 standardized data collection framework。要求还涉及数据安全与隐私、MNO 对传输过程的控制、可扩展性，以及降低对 UE 和用户流量的影响；术语说明 full visibility 包含 decodability 和 controllability，并将在 MNO。
text_en:
RAN2 to consider that a termination point should have full visibility (e.g., can determine whether to route/process/consume data). Based on the visibility, the termination point can perform the following operation:
- Decide whether the data needs to be routed to another NW entity;
- Decide whether the data is to be terminated locally,
- Perform the necessary processing based on the data characteristic related information (e.g., data type/QoS).
Study the standardized data collection framework with these requirements as a baseline at least for AI/ML
The data collected is secured and data integrity and confidentiality for that data is ensured.
User data privacy, anonymity and user consent is respected.
The MNO has full control of the standardized data collection transfer process and can manage data transfer to the server for UE side data collection, without the need of Service Level Agreement (SLA) for this purpose
This includes initiating, terminating, and fully managing data transfer.
MNO has full visibility for standardized data.
The design is future-proof and extendable.
The UE data collection should minimize impact to the UE battery, UE processing and memory utilization.
UE data collection should minimize impact to user traffic transmission and power saving features
These requirements can apply to both UE and NW sided data collection.  FFS if some don’t apply to both.
----
For terminology purposes – it is not implying a change of requirements
- Decodability refers to the capability to decode and interpret the content of the data
- Controllability refers to the capability to determine how the received data should be transferred (e.g. enable awareness for routing/controllability purposes, etc).
- Full visibility includes both decodability and controllability and will be in the MNO.
Termination point for UE-side data collection

summary_zh: standardized UE-side data collection 指 UE 侧数据收集的数据类型/格式和数据传输过程均实现标准化。
text_en: It is clarified that standardized UE-side data collection means that both the data type/format and data transfer procedure for UE-side data collection are standardized.

summary_zh: 认为网络复用 UE 侧数据采集的数据进行网络侧模型训练是合理的。Qualcomm 提出，UE 实现可能导致数据粒度不同，并询问这是否限制 UE 能力。
text_en:
Based on observation 5~7, it makes sense for network to reuse the data from UE side data collection for NW-sided model training.
-	Qualcomm thinks that we may have different granularity in the data according to UE implementation.  Is this now limiting what the UE can do?

summary_zh: 原文认为，若在 RAN 终止 UE 侧数据采集，基于 5G-A 用例中的标准化测量结果（如 L1/L3 measurement results 或 CSI channel information）不存在安全或隐私风险，也没有将这些数据在 CN 终止的必要或益处。会议记录同时指出，对所有用例是否可复用数据尚未达成结论，并提出了标准化与厂商特定数据范围及商业化价值方面的关注。
text_en:
Based on observation 8~11, there is no security/privacy risk when the termination of UE side data collection is in RAN since the standardized data for UE side data collection are measurement results such as L1/L3 measurement results or CSI channel information according to 5G-A use cases. And there is no necessity and no benefit to terminate these data in CN.
-	Apple points out that we haven’t concluded on all the use case before determining whether we can reuse the data.
-	Qualcomm is concerned that there a lot of things exposed.
-	Mediatek asks this rules out vendor specific data.   CMCC thinks that this only covers standardized data.   Mediatek asks if we will have a standardized and non-standarized data collection.   Just using standardized data comes with a lot of a problems, which means that first we have to agree what data to be collected before we can collect and we have no ways to enhance the performance beyond what 3GPP has looked at.  There are other data than standardized data that can be useful.    We need to specify what the market needs as if we got this way it is not useful.   Qualcomm agrees we should do commercializable things.
Noted

Noted
Discussion on standarized and non-standarized data
-	Oppo asks who is going to do the verification of the data.  Xiaomi explains that the non-standarized data doesn’t include any private data.    SA2 studied that and hasn’t concluded the verification.   Xiaomi thikns that the network can verify what is the UE and the data type.  But it doesn’t have to decode what is reported.   Mediatek thinks that the verification happens between the UE and the consumer and if the data is non-standarized we can provide some visibility on the type of data and some data can be used by MNO and some cannot.

summary_zh: 提出 UE-side data collection 的终止点可依数据是否供 RAN 使用而定：供 RAN 复用时由 RAN 终止并可查看数据，否则由 CN 终止且 RAN 不可查看；基线考虑 RAN 为终止点，涉及 CN 的情况需 RAN2 与 SA2 进一步协调。讨论中对单一采集方案、RAN 与 CN 终止点及数据复用等问题存在不同意见。
text_en:
For UE-side data collection, the termination points include the following cases:
If the data can be reused by RAN (e.g., for network-side AI model training), RAN is the termination point with visibility on the data;
Otherwise (if the data is not expected to be utilized by RAN), CN is the termination point, and RAN has no visibility on the data.
As a baseline, RAN2 should consider the RAN as the termination point; cases involving the CN as the termination point are subject to further coordination between RAN2 and SA2.
Noted
Discussion on termination point RAN vs. CN for standarized data with assumption we don’t exclude non-standarized data (to be discussed later)
-	LG agrees with Xiaomi, as we should discussed UE side and NW data.
-	Lenovo thinks that UE shouldn’t share data with the RAN, but it can share it with the operator in CN and they can determine how to handle it.
-	Interdigital asks what is the technical reason to have in the RAN, if the requirements are satisfied by MNO if the data is in the CN.
-	CMCC thinks that the motivation is to re-use the data for both network sided and UE sided.   Interdigital thinks that there is already a mechanism for data collection for the network.
-	Tmobile agrees that we should be able to reuse, but there are things that vendors can do outside the RAN and that’s why we have thing a bit bigger and we should terminate CN.
-	ATT agrees with CMCC and we should have the ability to decode for some use case, but we can make it configurable.  Contrallability should always be in the RAN.
-	Xiaomi thinks we should have a simple and single solution to collect the data from the UE side, as if we have for some cases sending to RAN and some cases for CN this increases complexity.  Apple agrees with Xiaomi.
-	Verizon thinks that we can get the data to OAM and we can combine with other data as well.
-	Samsung also agrees that we should have a simple way of doing it and we can’t exclude one of the termination point so we should study both.
-	ZTE also thinks that we should RAN as a termination point.
-	ZTE thikns that this data can also be re-used by SON and MDT as a lot of this measurement data.
-	China Telecom and CATT also would like to re-use the data.   CATT and ZTE thinks that this will reduce the UE memory too.
-	Ericsson agrees we should have a single solution with nw and UE sided.  The controllabity should be in the RAN and decodability can be in RAN or OAM.
-	MEdiatek thinks that if we support very big file we should support some stop and start functionality and mobility, like we can support protocol like TCP/IP.  This are long files that can be stored somewhere and we don’t need to specify it.  Anyone can access this server and decode.
-	Nokia thinks that OAM can be a good point from data re-usability perspective.   We should support mobility and a UP like solution is an easy way to support transfer of long file.
-	Kyocera would like to clarify the principle if it is used by the network then we can support termination point in the RAN.
-	ATT would like to ensure that we don’t use UP for the protocol.   Nokia thinks that the agreement doesn’t preclude this discussion.  Ericsson would also like to preclude having a UP solution.

text_en:

summary_zh: UE 与 RAN 间数据传输优先考虑 non-IP 方案，理由是开销较低且不需要 IP routing。潜在方向包括增强型 CP 方案或新 data plane；原文认为 UP-based solution 不适用于 UE-RAN 数据传输。
text_en:
For the data transfer between UE and RAN, a non-IP solution is preferred due to its lower overhead and the lack of IP routing requirements. Potential directions include:
- Enhanced CP-based solution;
- New data plane (e.g., new protocol layer and new RB type).
- Note: UP-based solution is considered unsuitable for UE-RAN data transfer.

summary_zh: UE 与 CN 间数据传输方面，RAN2 应聚焦由 SA2 架构进展触发的 Uu 传输协议，并区分用例特定的 UE-CN 高层协议与低层传输协议。传输协议候选包括 CP、UP 和 new plane；IP 或 non-IP 取决于 SA2 架构。
text_en:
For the data transfer between UE and CN, RAN2 should focus on the air interface (Uu) transport protocols triggered by the architectural progress in SA2. Specifically, RAN2 should differentiate between the use-case-specific UE-CN protocol (higher layer) and the transport protocols (lower layers), noting that:
- CP, UP, and a new plane are potential candidates for the transport protocols;
- IP or non-IP depends on the SA2 architecture (e.g., IP for UP compatibility; non-IP for non-UP solutions).

summary_zh: 提出 RAN2 应研究一种新型 radio bearer，支持可配置的 decodability、所有用例下 RAN 侧的 identifiability，以及 QoS differentiation。QoS differentiation 用于支持具有不同数据量和时延要求的数据传输。

- support configurable decodability,

- support QoS differentiation to enable data transfer with varying volume and latency requirements.

RAN2 should study the mechanisms necessary to support the new radio bearer (e.g., logical channels, scheduling framework.

summary_zh: 就 UE-sided model transfer，RAN2 记录的共识是 MNO 应能知晓经 3GPP 进行的 model transfer，以便区分 user traffic 与 model transfer traffic，并可调整优先级；无需了解模型内容，也无意由 MNO 禁止 UE 进行 transfer。如何实现不在 RAN2 范围内，可能由 CN mechanisms（如 QoS、PDU session management）实现，并已批准向 SA2 发送 LS。
text_en:

Noted
Discussion
-	ATT agrees that the network should know, as it can avoid charging the subscriber, and handle congestion cases, we don’t need to understand what’s in the model but just to understand so we can control.
-	Oppo thinks that for two sided model there is motivation as there needs to be some coordination, but for one sided model wonders where the control/awareness would be.
-	Docomo thinks that to avoid congestion is one motivation so lower level controllability.    CMCC thinks that at least we can configure it with a different QoS so if there is congestion we can handle it properly.
-	ATT thinks that we can ask can you do it later.
-	Ericsson agrees that it would be good to have some awareness.
-	Apple thinks that we should focus on one sided model and for that cases it is from OTT to UE, so why this model would cause network congestion and this is the same as the software update.     ATT doesn’t thinks that model transfers are the same as software as the user has the choice to say I want to do it now or not, but for model transfer the user has no say and they don’t know that anything is going on.  Docomo also thinks that this is completely different and there is responsibility from MNO.   CMCC explains that it is not the model transfer that causes the congestion, the network is congested and just need to know to give it a lower priority.   Samsung thinks that there is some means already to know that there is a software update and control and that is transparent to the RAN.
-	Xiaomi thinks that there is nothing we need to do, as we can just map this service and charging is out of scope of RAN2.   Samsung agrees.
-	Vivo agrees with the operators.
-	Lenovo sees the concerns from the operators and understand that the issue belong to SA.  Something similar like background data transfer can be considered there is coordination between AF and CN to negotiate when it can transfer.  We can discuss what are the requirements for model transfer.  Mediatek thinks we should be careful as the background data is very long delay and for model transfer may not be the same delay.  But we should agree to an intention and SA can study.
-	Qualcomm thinks this is SA discussion and we can’t set requirements.
-	ZTE would like to have test before transfer.
-	LG thinks that what matter is the size and frequency.
-	Futurewei doesn’t think we need to do anything special as anyways different model transfer may have different priority.   CMCC thinks that model transfer is not high priority.
-	Huawei understand that there is a willingness to not impact user traffic.
-	Nokia would like to understand how often they happen, is it the same as OS updates, like every 3 months.   Interdigital thinks that the UE check applicability and if it doesn’t have the model it has download and this is evaluated after mobility and for a lot of UE this can be quite a lot.  Mediatek agrees we need to understand how big this problem is and in real products we may go with more generalized solution so perhaps the problem will not be so severe.
-	Tmobile would like to stop models.   Qualcomm doesn’t think it is possible to stop if you have no visibility on the model.
-	Samsung and Qualcomm thinks that this is a problem if the model transfer size is big and/or frequent.
Agreements on model transfer
MNO should be aware model transfer is happening over 3GPP for the purpose to differentiate between user traffic and model transfer traffic  (e.g. to minimize impact to user traffic, adjust priority).   No visibility of the model is required and there is no intention for MNO to disable the UE from doing model transfer.    Understanding from RAN2 is that how to achieve this is not in scope of RAN2 and can be perhaps be achieved by CN mechanisms (e.g. QoS, PDU session management, etc).

summary_zh: 指出静态 CDRX timer operations 会在四种情形导致不必要的 PDCCH monitoring：无数据活动、无后续传输、重传无效，以及不能支持单连接内多种业务或动态时延要求。
text_en:
Static CDRX timer operations lead to unnecessary PDCCH monitoring at least in following cases:
	Case 1: Active inactivity timer when no data activity (e.g. blind UL scheduling before data arrival in UE).
	Case 2: Active inactivity timer when no subsequent transmission (e.g. measurements and CP signalling).
	Case 3: Active HARQ retransmission timer when retransmission is not valid (e.g. if PDCP discarding).
	Case 4: Not support multiple traffics/services and/or dynamic delay requirements during one connection.

summary_zh: 对 C-DRX 与 DL WUS 配置组合的研究，假设 C-DRX 参数包括 DRX cycle、onDuration-like Timer x 和 inactivityTimer-like Timer y；WUS 参数包括 WUS cycle、PDCCH monitor Timer x 和 inactivityTimer Timer y。UE 未收到 WUS 时的行为、两类 cycle 是否相同，以及两类 timer 是否相同仍为 FFS。
text_en:
For single UE discontinuous monitoring framework, RAN2 to study the following UE behaviour steps:
	C-DRX operation: UE starts Timer 1 (onDuration-like) for PDCCH monitoring according to Cycle 1 (C-DRX cycle). If the UE is scheduled on PDCCH, it (re)starts Timer 2 (InactivityTimer-like) for extended PDCCH monitoring;
	DL WUS operation with C-DRX: UE monitors DL WUS according to Cycle 2 (DL WUS Occasion cycle), if the detected DL WUS targets to itself, UE starts Timer 3 (after a time offset) for PDCCH monitoring. If the UE is scheduled on PDCCH, it (re)starts Timer 4 (InactivityTimer-like) for extended PDCCH monitoring.
Discussion
-	Nokia asks what is the motivation for different timers.    Huawei thinks that DL WUS has the benefit of being more energy efficient so we can benefit from it and have more frequent monitoring occasions.  Nokia thinks that we can consider the cycle to be different we can consider, but other timers we have to see why they would be different.
-	ZTE also doesn’t see a benefit for different onduration timers.   Huawei thinks main benefit is cycle anyways.    But if we have a short timer for the cycle then the on duration can be smaller so you don’t have to wake up too ofter.
-	Timer 1 and 3 can be the same if they are aligned.
Discussion on DRX and WUS cycle
-	Vivo thinks that main benefit from WUS comes from short cycle.   And all the timer behavior should be the same and we can align the behavior.
-	Offinno ask if we have different cycle, does that mean that we are doing 1 to N.
-	Qualcomm thinks that different cycles make no difference according to simulation results and in cell edge the coverage is worst.   Ericsson thinks that if you configure a short DRX cycle or a short WUS cycle, the WUS case should be more energy efficient.   Vivo thinks that if we monitor the RRM and L1 measurements then we would see the benefits.
-	CMCC thinks that we should design something that is aligned so the timers can be same and configurable.
-	ZTE thinks that the cycle is decided based on service requirements and we’d up configuring the same cycle.   The short DRX cycle is short enough.   Mediatek thinks they made a good point and we would need to understand why it is acceptable for WUS to have a different cycle than DRX as we are offering the same service.
-	Sony thinks that we can configure them separately and we need to the WUS indicating to monitor.
-	Panasonic thinks that there is a case where the WUS is telling the UE to not start the DRX timers and that benefit is useful.
-	Oppo thinks that we should one cycle for both as a baseline and for different cycles it is the same as WUS without DRX.
-	Samsung thinks that the two cycles shouldn’t be associated together
-	Lenovo and Panasonic thinks the cycles should be different.  LG thinks they should be aligned.
-	Nokia thinks we can at least agree that it can be the same and we can continue studying whether it can
-	Vivo thinks that we should consider two cycles one for PDCCH monitoring and one for measurements.   Qualcomm indicates that RAN4 is studying how to handle measurements so we shouldn’t have it bundled with measurement requirements.
-	Qualcomm explains that in 5G we have an indication by RRC whether the UE can wake up without indication or not.
Agreements for the study of C-DRX and WUS configured together
For the purpose of the discussion to find commonalities, we assume the following, but this doesn’t mean that WUS can be configured without DRX.  That will be studied separately.
For C-DRX we assume the following parametrs are needed (DRX cycle, Timer x( onDuration-like), and Timer y(inactivitytimer like))
For WUS we assume the following timer (WUS cycle, Timer x (PDCCH monitor timer), Timer y (inactivitytimer)
For the study of C-DRX and WUS configured - FFS UE behavior if WUS is not received and DRX is configured.  FFS if the cycles can same or different.  FFS if the timers x and y can be same or different.

-	Xiaomi asks if the first two use case are the same.  Huawei thinks that they can be the same but we would have different ways to report it.
-	ZTE what is the difference with UE.  Huawei explain that the information will be courser than UP as for UP this is used for scheduling.   Vivo thinks that in msg5 the UE can report the data and arrival time
-	Mediatek asks if the information reported would be the same across the usecases.   Huawei hope it was the same but we have to study.   Lenovo doesn’t think the format and what you report can be the same as you have no bearers setup.
-	CMCC thinks that we should study case 3 and case 2 but first one not sure what are the benefits compared to BSR.
-	Qualcomm asks if releasing the UE from connected also means maintaining.  Confirmed.
From idle to connected
-	Ericsson thinks that this is the main use case to enable early CA setup.    It can be some information. Nokia agrees and we shouldn’t use the NAS aspects in this discussion, the network just would like to know I have a lot of data, it doesn’t need too granular, so the network would know what  it may want to do.
-	Qualcomm doesn’t think the service level information is needed to decide whether we want to setup CA or not.   ZTE thinks that for CA the short term reporting can help, the network has enough time from the early reporting to set up the CA.
-	Interdigital thinks that the only benefit of this would be in msg3 and if it is subsequent message the benefits of it are not clear given all the other pains/complications.   The UE can send it in connected mode anyways.   Huawei thinks that the NW doesn’t the know the capabilities yet so it would anyways do the reconfiguration after receiving UE capabilities, at that point the reconfiguration should be the right one for CA.
-	Mediatek thinks msg3 should not be excluded and maybe RAN1 will do some magic.
-	Xiaomi asks how the UE is aware how much volume would trigger the CA and wonders how the UE would know what the is volume in idle mode.
-	Tmobile thinks that we are missing is service awareness and letting the aNB know what QoS/Service calls so it would know what it has to do.   Mediatek wonders if we can provide application information (like background, streaming, interactive etc) if we don’t have the QoS information yet.
-	Samsung asks about security, as the it is only activated after RRC connection, so we need to understand if it is ok to provide this information before.   Apple agrees that measurements can only be reported only after security is established.   Vivo points out that for RRC inactive the security is not a problem.
-	Apple thinks that the UE can trigger the service request before the data is in AS buffer.    The network can only use CA after the CSI resources are configured, so there is no benefit for the fast setup.
-	Oppo thinks that also UE capability is needed before it can setup anything.
-	ZTE thinks that we can consider doing something in inactive as the nw has UE context, security etc, but idle doesn’t make too much sense.

summary_zh: 除 CFRA baseline 外，RAN2 研究 UE 使用预配置 preamble 的 CBRA-based early UL synchronization 的可行性；支持 NW-triggered early UL synchronization，并进一步研究 UE-triggered 的潜在收益和可行性。NW-triggered baseline procedure 包括 source cell 向 UE 发命令、UE 向 target cell 发 RACH preamble、target cell 计算并传送 TA 给 source cell、source cell 将 TA 交付 UE，之后 UE 使用有效 TA 执行 RACH-less mobility；还考虑 network-triggered mobility 中 target cell initial access resources 在 cell switch command 前提供或随命令提供的两种情形。
text_en:
1	In addition to CFRA baseline for early UL synchronization in 6G mobility, RAN2 studies also the feasibility of UE using CBRA based early UL synchronization.  For CBRA-based the assumption is that the UE still is configured with a preamble to use for this purpose.
2	NW-triggered early UL synchronization is supported. Study further the potential benefits and feasibility of UE-triggered early UL synchronization
3	For NW-triggered early UL synchronization RAN2 considers the following steps to be a part of baseline procedure (FFS if any other enhancements are needed):
a.	Source cell initiates the procedure by transmitting a command to the UE
b.	UE transmits a RACH preamble to the indicated target cell
c.	Target cell is responsible to calculate the TA value and transmits it to the source cell
d.	Source cell is responsible to deliver the TA value to the UE
e.	With a valid TA value, UE performs a RACH-less mobility procedure
4	In mobility with pre-configuration, for network-triggered mobility, the resources for initial access to the target cell (e.g. CFRA, CG, SR): the following two cases are considered
-	Can be provided before cell switch command but be used upon cell switch command
-	Can be provided with cell switch command and be used.
Resource reservation issue of pre-configuration

summary_zh: UE 处理时间（Tprocessing，RAN4 定义）主要取决于 UE 收到 HO command 后需要执行的实际操作。它与 HO 期间变更的 IE/参数数量或 HO command 的大小没有直接相关性。
text_en: The factor which contributes majorly to the UE processing time (i.e., Tprocessing defined by RAN4), depends on the actual actions UE need to take after receiving the HO command and is not directly correlated to the number of IEs/parameters that change during HO or the "size of the HO command”.

summary_zh: RAN2 认可，在某些痛点场景中，legacy handover mechanisms 可能有较高概率发生非预期事件。例如，快速 RSRP 下降时 measurement event 未能正确触发。
text_en: RAN2 recognize that legacy handover mechanisms might show high probability of unintended events (e.g., measurement event is not properly triggered when fast RSRP degradation) in some pain point scenario (e.g., some trajectory in urban grid scenario defined in TR 38.914).

summary_zh: UL-based mobility measurement 可在网络侧执行：UE 向潜在目标小区发送上行信号（如 PRACH preamble/SRS），目标小区再基于这些信号进行测量。
text_en: UL-based measurement for mobility can be performed at the network side where the UE transmits uplink signals (e.g., PRACH preamble/SRS) to the potential target cells, and then these target cells perform measurements based on the uplink signals.

summary_zh: 降低 interruption time 是 mobility 的 KPI 之一。因此，UL-based mobility 可与 candidate configurations、DL sync、UL signal transmission 和 RACH-less HO 等预配置技术集成。
text_en: One of the KPIs of mobility is to reduce interruption time, therefore UL-based mobility can be integrated with pre-configured techniques such as candidate configurations, DL sync, UL signal transmission and RACH-less HO.

summary_zh: UL-based mobility 可减少访问目标小区的资源消耗：只有接受 UE 的候选小区才指示资源分配（如 CG、CB-PUSCH）。它也可改善上行服务质量，例如 uplink-heavy interactive AI applications。
text_en: Other advantages of UL-based mobility are: to minimize resource consumption for accessing the target cells as only the candidate cell that accepts the UE provides the indication of resource allocation (e.g., CG, CB-PUSCH), and to improve UL service quality such as uplink-heavy interactive AI applications.

summary_zh: 应用目标小区参数时的关键时延包括：Physical layer configuration 的 RF retuning 和 BWP switching，MAC configuration 的 MAC reset，RLC configuration 的 RLC entity re-establishment，以及 PDCP configuration 的 PDCP entity re-establishment 和 security update。
text_en:
The key delays incurred by applying target cell parameters are as follows:
•	Physical layer configuration: delay incurred by RF retuning and BWP switching
•	MAC configuration: delay incurred by MAC reset
•	RLC configuration: delay incurred by RLC entity re-establishment
•	PDCP configuration: delay incurred by PDCP entity re-establishment and security update

summary_zh: 不同 handover 场景中持续变化的配置范围不同：Intra-DU/Intra-CU 涉及 physical layer configuration；Inter-DU/Intra-CU 涉及 physical layer、MAC 和 RLC configuration；Inter-CU 还涉及 PDCP configuration 和 security。条目还提出请 RAN4 研究两类场景是否可定义更低的 interruption requirements：无 RF 和 baseband change configuration update 的同频 mobility，以及基于 multi-carrier configuration 的异频 mobility。
text_en:
The always changing parameters in each handover scenario are as follows:
•	Intra-DU/Intra-CU: physical layer configuration: e.g., SSB frequency, PCI, SCS, carrier bandwidth, BWP configuration, TDD configuration, etc.
•	Inter-DU/Intra-CU: physical layer configuration, MAC configuration, RLC configuration
•	Inter-CU: physical layer configuration, MAC configuration, RLC configuration, PDCP configuration, security
Noted

summary_zh: 6G Early UL synchronization 的基线为 network-controlled：网络向 UE 发送命令，UE 向指示的 target cell 发送 RACH preamble，target cell 计算 TA 并发送给 source cell，再由 source cell 将 TA 交付 UE。获得有效 TA 后，UE 执行 RACH-less mobility procedure。
text_en:
The Early UL synchronization procedure in 6G is network-controlled as baseline and comprises the following baseline steps (FFS on additional enhancements):
a.	Network initiates the procedure by transmitting a command to the UE
b.	UE transmits a RACH preamble to the indicated target cell
c.	Target cell is responsible to calculate the TA value and transmits it to the source cell
d.	Source cell is responsible to deliver the TA value to the UE
e.	With a valid TA value, UE performs a RACH-less mobility procedure

text_en:
Study the following approaches for early UL synchronization:
For RA-based early UL sync: Focus on minimizing the frequency of unnecessary early UL sync by optimizing the event configurations for early measurement reporting (e.g., defining appropriate event thresholds for a MR).
For UE-based TA measurement: Expand the applicability of UE-based TA estimation to asynchronous network scenarios. Specifically, study mechanisms to provide the UE with:
the reference timing difference between the source and target cells; or
Assistance information enabling the UE to calculate the propagation delay to the target cell.

R2-2604139	Discussion on UE-based mobility for UE power saving	Turkcell, China Unicom, OPPO, Huawei, HiSilicon, Kyocera, NEC, Ofinno, Sony,  CEWIT, BYD, Wistron	discussion	Rel-20	FS_6G_Radio
Proposal 1	For mobility in the RRC_CONNECTED state, the following UE-based mobility behaviours can be considered for UE power saving:
Within the pre-configured cell-list: during the no-data period, the UE does NOT report measurement results, performs conditional cell switching itself per configuration, and does NOT notify the network for cell switching; Upon data arrival, the pre-configured identification(s) for each cell are used to identify the UE.
Upon the UE moving outside the pre-configured cell-list, the UE notifies the network with the necessary identification(s).
Noted
R2-2604175	Solutions for mobility shortcomings	Ericsson, T-Mobile USA, Deutsche Telekom	discussion	Rel-20	FS_6G_Radio	R2-2603523
Observation 6	Relying only on conditional mobility solutions for energy efficient operation in RRC Connected mode would result in wastage of a large amount of conditional resources assigned to the UE. Such a solution would not be scalable.
Observation 7	The UE still needs to perform RA in the new cell to obtain timing advance.
Observation 8	Transmitting a measurement report before the mobility execution would not introduce a significant cost in terms of the UE energy consumption.
Proposal 7	There is no special mobility handling needed for performing mobility while the UE is in energy efficient operation of RRC Connected mode i.e., the UE transmits measurement reports as per the measurement configuration associated to the mobility in the RRC Connected mode and performs the mobility procedures.
Noted
Discussion
-	Ericson is concerned that if the UE doesn’t report when it changes the NW doesn’t know where the UE is and we have to reserve resources and we would have to do sub-sequent mobility and that was agreed that it was complex.  Huawei explains that the UE will not apply the configuration until it has data and if does apply it, it will notify the network.  So there is no need for subsequent mobility as the UE is not applying the configuration as it is moving.
-	Ericsson thinks that one way to save power is to have some form measurement relaxation.
-	Vivo and Offino thinks that it would be good to save power for the UE and we should study.
-	Oppo thinks that we should analyze the benefits and the complexity.   Oppo explains that the UE will stay in RRC connected and that is power consuming and it also helps the system as a whole.  For complexity part, we should look at restrictions on how to reduce the complexity, like for example limit for intra.
-	Lenovo agrees with Ericsson and also it is not clear what UE ID would be used.
-	Samsung thinks that the network is responsible for the UE in connected mode and has to reserve resource including resources for reaching the UE in the other cells, so it is not good from network.
-	ZTE also agree with Ericsson.   It is difficult to know when to release the resources.   We should split the discussion into separate features, RRM and PDCCH monitoring.   We can look at RRM relaxation and also consider new triggers related to data activity.
-	CATT also agrees with Ericsson and ZTE.  Wonders if there is a target scenario and the UE has to apply the RACH procedure and that will cause delay.   Huawei thinks that to remove the delay you need to reserve.
-	Mediatek thinks that there may be some gains so we can study but it should be something simple.  How does the UE determine when to be in this mode.    Huawei explains that this would controlled by the network.
-	Apple thinks that a UE in connected mode should follow the same procedures as connected mode, from UE perspective don’t want to support different procedures.   Apple asks how the UE gets the measuremetns.  Huawei explains that the UE performs the measurements like in idle mode.
-	Sony thinks that this is beneficial if the UE knows when it will trigger UL data and you have longer periodicity.
-	Interdigital thinks that there may be some scenario like intra-CU/DU but we don’t know yet if we have HLS, so we can focus on measurement relaxation.
-	Nokia is concerned with the complexity we are adding in RRC connected as we are trying to replicate the mobility/functionality we have in idle mode.   The RNA configuration now it’s like in a pre-configuration form.
-	Rakuten thinks this is not efficient from resource reservation perspective and the network does’nt know when the UE left.
-	ZTE thinks that even for DL you still need to find the UE and you will send WUS, so it’s similar to paging.

summary_zh: 为降低 RRC connected mode 下 delay-sensitive、bursty traffic 的功耗，研究两项彼此独立且不捆绑的功能：基于 DL/UL (LP)WUS 的 wake-up mechanism，以及以 CLTM/CHO-like pre-configuration 为基线的 UE-based mobility，并进一步研究 measurement relaxation 和 measurement reporting reduction。
UE 应在每次 cell switch 后通知 network，以便 network 维护 UE 的 cell-level location。这样可避免在所有 candidate cells 预留 UE-dedicated resources，以及向所有 candidate cells 发送 UE-dedicated WUS 所带来的 signaling overhead。
text_en:
The UE should notify the network after each cell switch, so that the network maintains cell-level location of the UE. This avoids:
The capacity impact of reserving UE-dedicated resources across the full set of candidate cells; and
The signalling overhead of transmitting UE-dedicated WUS across the full set of candidate cells.

For the UE capability reporting procedure, the UE shall report both higher-layer sensing capabilities (e.g., supported sensing modes, calculation capabilities) and AS-layer sensing capabilities (e.g., RS-related capabilities) to the SF. The UE shall also report AS-layer sensing capabilities to the RAN as part of the UE AS capability.

summary_zh: 条目提出 sensing configuration 可由 SenF/RAN node 通过请求或非请求方式发送给 sensing UE，并可采用 broadcast signalling 或专用信令；该条目标注为 Noted。讨论涉及 sensing data 的消费者、协议及终止点，以及广播和专用传输等问题。
text_en:
The sensing configuration is transmitted from SenF/RAN node to sensing UE by a request or unsolicited way, and can be transmitted by broadcast signalling or dedicated to the sensing UE.
Noted
Discussion
-	Xiaomi thinks that for sensing assisted communication RAN1 agreed to study an option that data goes to the gNB.   Ericsson thinks that the plenary has agreed to have sensing assisted communication but we should strive for a common protocol that works for both communication and sensing.
-	Qualcomm thinks that the main point is who is the consumer of the sensing of the data and we will have transport mechanisms to carry.
-	Vivo UE as Rx entity (this needs to be further discussed and UE Tx entity (configuration is mainly about the UL reference signal)
-	CMCC thinks that we need RRC protocol for data processing.   ZTE thinks we should first understand why we need a new protocol, RRC can do this.  We can’t get rid of RRC no matter what, even if we have a new protocol.   Xiaomi explains that the consumer can be UE, SF, AF.  The SF needs to stay involved.  CATT thinks that we can rely on RRC.
-	Huawei thinks that we need to wait for RAN1 what data is being carried.
-	Xiaomi explains that there is cooperative sensing and there needs to be a SF.
-	CeWit thinks that we need to understand who does the processing and results calculated.
-	LG thinks that we need to consider the two cases.
-	Kyocera thinks that we should discuss broadcast and dedicated
-	Nokia thinks what are the content and the termination points and then we can talk the protocol.
Sensing configuration contents

summary_zh: 多轨道议题达成一致：在 TN session 继续讨论 multi-carrier idle mode，并将 multi-orbit 纳入讨论场景；至少研究 inter-frequency 场景下的 service-based reselection。还将结合 TN session 后续讨论，了解相较于 Option 1 的收益，以及特定 NTN 问题或顾虑。
text_en:
RAN2 to study multi-orbit operation assuming same operator:
Paging and initial access procedure:
Option 1): UE paged by GEO, and accesses via GEO, then the NW handover or redirect the UE to LEO;
Option 2): UE paged by GEO, then performs cell reselection to LEO, and performs initial access on LEO (i.e., cross-carrier paging response);
Option 3): UE paged by GEO, and directly performs initial access via LEO based assistance information provided by GEO (i.e., cross-carrier random access).
Feasibility of providing coverage information for other orbits for efficient switch including cell selection/reselection and measurement triggering.
-	Option 2 and 3 need to be studied a bit more.
-	ZTE also thinks that we should study both option 2 and 3.
-	Xioami thinks that option 2 can work for both MT and MO case, so we should prioritize that one.   ZTE thinks that option 3 can also apply for MO.    CATT agrees that the options apply to both MO and MT.
-	Huawei explains that the difference between 2 and 3 is how the information for accessing the information is provided.
-	Option 3 should be discussed in TN first and option 2 is more friendly for UE, so we can start with option 2.    ZTE thinks that when we study the multicarrier we can add multi-orbit and aim to have the same solution.
-	Ericsson asks where the power savings is.
-	Nokia asks if we increase the risks.   Thales and Qualcomm think that there are problems of UE attacking the LEO if there is false paging.   Qualcomm also explains that we have to acquire synchronization that takes a long time.    ZTE and Xioami thinks that the false paging is not specific to NTN, even in TN it not protected.   Samsung explains that network triggered mobility should be secure.  Xiaomi explains that the paging can be in both GEO and LEO.
-	Google explains that there are cons with option 2, latency increase and option 3 overhead.
-	Service based reselection can solve the problem and you don’t need to tell the UE which orbit to to respond to.
Noted
Discussion
-	MEdiatek asks if the UE is expected to monitor the other orbit.   Interdigital thinks that there can be solution on where the GEO cell tells you rather than monitoring the other orbits.  There may be deployments where there is no LEO coverage.   ZTE thinks that anyways the UE will monitor other cells without needing to know whether it is GEO or LEO
-	Fraunhofer asks if this is like a redirection and can be similar to RACH case for TN.  .
-	Ericsson asks what problem do you see and what KPI do you expect to solve with this solution.     Nokia explains that coverage is a big problem, GEO can provide coverage by LEO provides better service.     Also power is a consideration.
-	Apple thinks that GEO and LEO are on different carriers so this is similar to multi carrier idle.   So We can consider one solution for TN and NTN.   CMCC thinks that the benefit is even higher than for TN as the satellites are moving very fast, so GEO should provide some information and the let the UEs camp there.    Xiaomi thinks that it is not necessary the case that cells are in different carrier.
-	Qualcomm explains that there are regulations that you have to avoid interference so it is likely for FR1 it is on different carriers.
-	Huawei asks if we intend to specify what services should go to which orbit.  Mediatek thinks that reselection should be UE behaviour and not specify too much.
-	Qualcomm would like to make sure that we shouldn’t override the reselection frequency priority.
Agreements on multi-orbit
-	Continue the discussion on multi-carrier idle mode in TN session and include multi-orbit as one of the scenarios to be discussed.
-	Study service-based reselection at least for inter-frequency scenario.
-	Understand the gains/benefits compared to option 1 and/or any specific NTN related problems/concerns after some discussions on TN session have taken place.
TN-NTN mobility

summary_zh: 针对 intra-RAT 6G TN-NTN cell reselection，将至少考虑以下测量启动机制：TN 到 NTN 时，以 RRM-based S-measure 作为基线；NTN 到 TN 时，可考虑 UE 与 reference location 的距离或 serving NTN cell 的 serving time。
text_en:
For intra-RAT 6G TN-NTN cell reselection, at least consider the following mechanism:
In case of TN to NTN mobility, RRM based S-measure for measurement initiation should be considered as baseline;
In case of NTN to TN mobility, the distance between UE and the reference location or the serving time of the serving NTN cell can be considered for measurement initiation.
-	China telecom thinks we can do better than 5G by not putting the restrictions.

summary_zh: 针对 TN/NTN 与 NTN/NTN mobility，将研究 idle/inactive 和 connected 状态下 NTN 特定的 measurement relaxation/initiation trigger conditions，例如 S-measure、reference location 和 time。原文列出了 TN 到 NTN 与 NTN 到 TN 的 measurement report 条件。
text_en:
For intra-RAT 6GR TN-NTN mobility, at least consider the following measurement report conditions:
For TN->NTN
Distance between UE and a reference location of the neighbor cell becomes shorter than configured threshold;
Serving cell becomes worse than the absolute threshold and distance between UE and a reference location of the neighbor cell becomes shorter than configured threshold;
For NTN->TN:
The distance between UE and a reference location of the serving cell becomes larger than configured threshold and neighbor cell become better than the absolute threshold.
Agreements on mobility
-	Study NTN specific trigger conditions for measurement relaxation/initiation for idle/inactive and connected (e.g. S-measure, reference location, time, etc) for mobility between TN/NTN and NTN/NTN.
Measurement enhancements
